en.27:8: Then, when he reached it, he was called: “Blessed is He who is within the fire, and He who is around it, and glorified be God, Lord of the Worlds.
en.27:9: O Moses, it is I, God, the Almighty, the Wise.
en.27:10: Throw down your staff.” But when he saw it quivering, as though it were a demon, he turned around not looking back. “O Moses, do not fear; the messengers do not fear in My presence.
en.27:11: But whoever has done wrong, and then substituted goodness in place of evil. I am Forgiving and Merciful.
en.27:12: Put your hand inside your pocket, and it will come out white, without blemish—among nine miracles to Pharaoh and his people, for they are immoral people.”
en.27:13: Yet when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, “This is obvious witchcraft.”
en.27:14: And they rejected them, although their souls were certain of them, out of wickedness and pride. So see how the outcome was for the mischief-makers.
en.27:15: And We gave David and Solomon knowledge. They said, “Praise God, who has favored us over many of His believing servants.”
en.27:16: And Solomon succeeded David. He said, “O people, we were taught the language of birds, and we were given from everything. This is indeed a real blessing.”
en.27:17: To the service of Solomon were mobilized his troops of sprites, and men, and birds—all held in strict order.
en.27:18: Until, when they came upon the Valley of Ants, an ant said, “O ants! Go into your nests, lest Solomon and his troops crush you without noticing.”
en.27:19: He smiled and laughed at her words, and said, “My Lord, direct me to be thankful for the blessings you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do good works that please You. And admit me, by Your grace, into the company of Your virtuous servants.”
en.27:20: Then he inspected the birds, and said, “Why do I not see the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?
en.27:21: I will punish him most severely, or slay him, unless he gives me a valid excuse.”
en.27:22: But he did not stay for long. He said, “I have learnt something you did not know. I have come to you from Sheba, with reliable information.
en.27:23: I found a woman ruling over them, and she was given of everything, and she has a magnificent throne.
en.27:24: I found her and her people worshiping the sun, instead of God. the Adversary made their conduct appear good to them, and diverted them from the path, so they are not guided.
en.27:25: If only they would worship God, who brings to light the mysteries of the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
en.27:26: God—There is no god but He, the Lord of the Sublime Throne.”
en.27:27: He said, “We will see, whether you have spoken the truth, or whether you are a liar.
en.27:28: Go with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them; then withdraw from them, and see how they respond.”
en.27:29: She said, “O Counselors, a gracious letter was delivered to me.
en.27:30: It is from Solomon, and it is, ‘In the Name of God, the Gracious, the Merciful.
en.27:31: Do not defy me, and come to me submissively.’”
en.27:32: She said, “O counselors, advise me in this matter of mine. I never make a decision unless you are present.”
en.27:33: They said, “We are a people of might and great courage, but the decision is yours, so consider what you wish to command.”
en.27:34: She said, “When kings enter a city, they devastate it, and subjugate its dignified people. Thus they always do.
en.27:35: I am sending them a gift, and will see what the envoys bring back.”
en.27:36: When he came to Solomon, he said, “Are you supplying me with money? What God has given me is better than what He has given you. It is you who delight in your gift.
en.27:37: Go back to them. We will come upon them with troops they cannot resist; and we will expel them from there, disgraced and humiliated.”
en.27:38: He said, “O notables, which one of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?”
en.27:39: An imp of the sprites said, “I will bring it to you before you rise from your seat. I am strong and reliable enough to do it.”
en.27:40: He who had knowledge from the Scripture said, “I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.” And when he saw it settled before him, he said, “This is from the grace of my Lord, to test me, whether I am grateful or ungrateful. He who is grateful, his gratitude is to his own credit; but he who is ungrateful—my Lord is Independent and Generous.”
en.27:41: He said, “Disguise her throne for her, and we shall see whether she will be guided, or remains one of the misguided.”
en.27:42: When she arrived, it was said, “Is your throne like this?” She said, “As if this is it.” “We were given knowledge before her, and we were submissive.”
en.27:43: But she was prevented by what she worshiped besides God; she belonged to a disbelieving people.
en.27:44: It was said to her, “Go inside the palace.” And when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pond, and she bared her legs. He said, “It is a palace paved with glass.” She said, “My Lord, I have done wrong to myself, and I have submitted with Solomon, to God, Lord of the Worlds.”
en.27:45: And We sent to Thamood their brother Saleh: “Worship God.” But they became two disputing factions.
en.27:46: He said, “O my people, why are you quick to do evil rather than good? If only you would seek God’s forgiveness, so that you may be shown mercy.”
en.27:47: They said, “We consider you an ill omen, and those with you.” He said, “Your omen is with God. In fact, you are a people being tested.”
en.27:48: In the city was a gang of nine who made mischief in the land and did no good.
en.27:49: They said, “Swear by God to one another that we will attack him and his family by night, and then tell his guardian, 'We did not witness the murder of his family, and we are being truthful.'“
en.27:50: They planned a plan, and We planned a plan, but they did not notice.
en.27:51: So note the outcome of their planning; We destroyed them and their people, altogether.
en.27:52: Here are their homes, in ruins, on account of their iniquities. Surely in this is a sign for people who know.
en.27:53: And We saved those who believed and were pious.
en.27:54: And Lot, when he said to his people, “Do you commit lewdness with open eyes?
en.27:55: Do you lust after men instead of women? You are truly ignorant people.”
en.27:56: But the only response of his people was to say, “Expel the family of Lot from your town. They are purist people.”
en.27:57: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife, whom We destined to be among the laggards.
en.27:58: And We rained upon them a rain. Miserable was the rain of those forewarned.
en.27:59: Say, “Praise God, and peace be upon His servants whom He has selected. Is God better, or what they associate?”
en.27:60: Or, who created the heavens and the earth, and rains down water from the sky for you? With it We produce gardens full of beauty, whose trees you could not have produced. Is there another god with God? But they are a people who equate.
en.27:61: Or, who made the earth habitable, and made rivers flow through it, and set mountains on it, and placed a partition between the two seas? Is there another god with God? But most of them do not know.
en.27:62: Or, who answers the one in need when he prays to Him, and relieves adversity, and makes you successors on earth? Is there another god with God? How hardly you pay attention.
en.27:63: Or, who guides you through the darkness of land and sea, and who sends the winds as heralds of His mercy? Is there another god with God? Most exalted is God, above what they associate.
en.27:64: Or, who originates the creation and then repeats it, and who gives you livelihood from the sky and the earth? Is there another god with God? Say, “Produce your evidence, if you are truthful.”
en.27:65: Say, “No one in the heavens or on earth knows the future except God; and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.”
en.27:66: In fact, their knowledge of the Hereafter is confused. In fact, they are in doubt about it. In fact, they are blind to it.
en.27:67: Those who disbelieve say, “When we have become dust, and our ancestors, shall we be brought out?
en.27:68: We were promised that before, we and our ancestors—these are nothing but legends of the ancients.”
en.27:69: Say, travel through the earth, and observe the fate of the guilty.”
en.27:70: But do not grieve over them, and do not be troubled by what they plot.
en.27:71: And they say, “When is this promise, if you are truthful?”
en.27:72: Say, “Perhaps some of what you are impatient for has drawn near.”
en.27:73: Your Lord is gracious towards humanity, but most of them are not thankful.
en.27:74: And your Lord knows what their hearts conceal, and what they reveal.
en.27:75: There is no mystery in the heaven and the earth, but it is in a Clear Book.
en.27:76: This Quran relates to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about.
en.27:77: And it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
en.27:78: Your Lord will judge between them by His wisdom. He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
en.27:79: So rely on God. You are upon the clear truth.
en.27:80: You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call if they turn their backs and flee.
en.27:81: Nor can you guide the blind out of their straying. You can make no one listen, except those who believe in Our verses; for they are Muslims.
en.27:82: And when the Word has fallen on them, We will bring out for them from the earth a creature which will say to them that the people are uncertain of Our revelations.
en.27:83: On the Day when We gather from every community a group of those who rejected Our revelations; and they will be restrained.
en.27:84: Until, when they arrive, He will say, “Did you reject My revelations without comprehending them? Or what is it you were doing?”
en.27:85: The Word will come down upon them for their wrongdoing, and they will not speak.
en.27:86: Do they not see that We made the night for them to rest therein, and the day for visibility? Surely in that are signs for people who believe.
en.27:87: On the Day when the Trumpet is blown, everyone in the heavens and the earth will be horrified, except whomever God wills; and everyone will come before Him in humility.
en.27:88: And you see the mountains, and imagine them fixed, yet they pass, as the passing of the clouds—the making of God, who has perfected everything. He is fully Informed of what you do.
en.27:89: Whoever brings a virtue will receive better than it—and they will be safe from the horrors of that Day.
en.27:90: But whoever brings evil—their faces will be tumbled into the Fire. Will you be rewarded except for what you used to do?
en.27:91: “I was commanded to worship the Lord of this town, who has sanctified it, and to Whom everything belongs; and I was commanded to be of those who submit.
en.27:92: And to recite the Quran.” Whoever is guided—is guided to his own advantage. And whoever goes astray, then say, “I am one of the warners.”
en.27:93: And say, “Praise belongs to God; He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. Your Lord is not heedless of what you do.”
en.28:2: These are the Verses of the Clear Book.
en.28:3: We narrate to you from the history of Moses and Pharaoh—in truth—for people who believe.
en.28:4: Pharaoh exalted himself in the land, and divided its people into factions. He persecuted a group of them, slaughtering their sons, while sparing their daughters. He was truly a corrupter.
en.28:5: But We desired to favor those who were oppressed in the land, and to make them leaders, and to make them the inheritors.
en.28:6: And to establish them in the land; and to show Pharaoh, Hamaan, and their troops, the very thing they feared.
en.28:7: We inspired the mother of Moses: “Nurse him; then, when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear, nor grieve; We will return him to you, and make him one of the messengers.”
en.28:8: Pharaoh’s household picked him up, to be an opponent and a sorrow for them. Pharaoh, Hamaan, and their troops were sinners.
en.28:9: Pharaoh’s wife said, “An eye's delight for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he will be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son.” But they did not foresee.
en.28:10: The heart of Moses’ mother became vacant. She was about to disclose him, had We not steadied her heart, that she may remain a believer.
en.28:11: She said to his sister, “Trail him.” So she watched him from afar, and they were unaware.
en.28:12: We forbade him breastfeeding at first. So she said, “Shall I tell you about a family that can raise him for you, and will look after him?”
en.28:13: Thus We returned him to his mother, that she may be comforted, and not grieve, and know that God’s promise is true. But most of them do not know.
en.28:14: And when he reached his maturity, and became established, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward the virtuous.
en.28:15: Once he entered the city, unnoticed by its people. He found in it two men fighting—one of his own sect, and one from his enemies. The one of his sect solicited his assistance against the one from his enemies; so Moses punched him, and put an end to him. He said, “This is of the Adversary's doing; he is an enemy that openly misleads.”
en.28:16: He said, “My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.” So He forgave him. He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.
en.28:17: He said, “My Lord, in as much as you have favored me, I will never be a supporter of the criminals.”
en.28:18: The next morning, he went about in the city, fearful and vigilant, when the man who had sought his assistance the day before was shouting out to him. Moses said to him, “You are clearly a troublemaker.”
en.28:19: As he was about to strike the one who was their enemy, he said, “O Moses, do you intend to kill me, as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a bully in the land, and do not want to be a peacemaker.”
en.28:20: And a man came from the farthest part of the city running. He said, “O Moses, the authorities are considering killing you, so leave; I am giving you good advice.”
en.28:21: So he left, fearful and vigilant. He said, “My Lord, deliver me from the wrongdoing people.”
en.28:22: As he headed towards Median, he said, “Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the right way.”
en.28:23: And when he arrived at the waters of Median, he found there a crowd of people drawing water, and he noticed two women waiting on the side. He said, “What is the matter with you?” They said, “We cannot draw water until the shepherds depart, and our father is a very old man.”
en.28:24: So he drew water for them, and then withdrew to the shade, and said, “My Lord, I am in dire need of whatever good you might send down to me.”
en.28:25: Then, one of the two women approached him, walking bashfully. She said, “My father is calling you, to reward you for drawing water for us.” And when he came to him, and told him the story, he said, “Do not fear, you have escaped from the wrongdoing people.”
en.28:26: One of the two women said, “Father, hire him; the best employee for you is the strong and trustworthy.”
en.28:27: He said, “I want to marry you to one of these two daughters of mine, provided you work for me for eight years. But if you complete ten, that is up to you. I do not intend to impose any hardship on you. You will find me, God willing, one of the virtuous.”
en.28:28: He said, “Let this be an agreement between you and me. Whichever of the two terms I fulfill, there shall be no reprisal against me; and God is witness over what we say.”
en.28:29: When Moses had completed the term, and departed with his family, he noticed a fire by the side of the Mount. He said to his family, “Stay here, I have glimpsed a fire. Perhaps I can bring you some information from there, or an ember from the fire, that you may warm yourselves.”
en.28:30: When he reached it, he was called from the right side of the valley, at the Blessed Spot, from the bush: “O Moses, it is I, God, the Lord of the Worlds.
en.28:31: Throw down your staff.” And when he saw it wiggling, as if it were possessed, he turned his back to flee, and did not look back. “O Moses, come forward, and do not fear, you are perfectly safe.
en.28:32: Put your hand inside your pocket, and it will come out white, without blemish. And press your arm to your side, against fear. These are two proofs from your Lord, to Pharaoh and his dignitaries. They are truly sinful people.”
en.28:33: He said, “My Lord, I have killed one of them, and I fear they will kill me.
en.28:34: And my brother Aaron, he is more eloquent than me, so send him with me, to help me, and to confirm my words, for I fear they will reject me.”
en.28:35: He said, “We will strengthen your arm with your brother, and We will give you authority, so they will not touch you. By virtue of Our signs, you and those who follow you will be the triumphant.”
en.28:36: But when Moses came to them with Our signs, clear and manifest, they said, “This is nothing but fabricated magic, and We never heard of this from our ancestors of old.”
en.28:37: Moses said, “My Lord is well aware of him who brings guidance from Him, and him who will have the sequel of the abode. The evildoers will not succeed.”
en.28:38: Pharaoh said, “O nobles, I know of no god for you other than me. So fire-up the bricks for me O Hamaan, and build me a tower, that I may ascend to the God of Moses, though I think he is a liar.”
en.28:39: He and his troops acted arrogantly in the land, with no justification. They thought they would not be returned to Us.
en.28:40: So We seized him, and his troops, and We threw them into the sea. Observe, therefore, what was the end of the oppressors.
en.28:41: And We made them leaders calling to the Fire. And on Resurrection Day, they will not be saved.
en.28:42: And We pursued them in this world with a curse. And on Resurrection Day, they will be among the despised.
en.28:43: We gave Moses the Scripture after We had annihilated the previous generations; as an illumination for mankind, and guidance, and mercy, so that they may remember.
en.28:44: You were not on the Western Side when We decreed the command to Moses, nor were you among the witnesses.
en.28:45: But We established many generations, and time took its toll on them. Nor were you among the people of Median, reciting Our revelations to them. But We kept sending messengers.
en.28:46: Nor were you by the side of the Mount when We proclaimed. Rather, it was a mercy from your Lord, that you may warn people who received no warner before you, so that they may take heed.
en.28:47: Otherwise, if a calamity befell them as a result of what their hands have perpetrated, they would say, “Our Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations, and been among the believers.”
en.28:48: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, “If only he was given the like of what was given to Moses.” Did they not disbelieve in what was given to Moses in the past? They said, “Two works of magic backing one another.” And they said, “We are disbelieving in both.”
en.28:49: Say, “Then bring a scripture from God, more conductive to guidance than both, and I will follow it, if you are truthful.”
en.28:50: But if they fail to respond to you, know that they follow their fancies. And who is more lost than him who follows his fancy without guidance from God? God does not guide the unjust people.
en.28:51: We have delivered the Word to them, that they may remember.
en.28:52: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it believe in it.
en.28:53: When it is recited to them, they say, “We have believed in it; it is the truth from our Lord; we were Muslims prior to it.”
en.28:54: These will be given their reward twice, because they persevered; and they counter evil with good; and from Our provisions to them, they give.
en.28:55: And when they hear vain talk, they avoid it, and say, “We have our deeds, and you have your deeds; peace be upon you; we do not desire the ignorant.”
en.28:56: You cannot guide whom you love, but God guides whom He wills, and He knows best those who are guided.
en.28:57: And they say, “If we follow the guidance with you, we will be snatched from our land.” Did We not establish for them a Safe Sanctuary, to which are brought all kinds of fruits, as provision from Ourselves? But most of them do not know.
en.28:58: And how many a city did We destroy for turning unappreciative of its livelihood? Here are their homes, uninhabited after them, except for a few. And We became the Inheritors.
en.28:59: Your Lord never destroys cities without first sending a messenger in their midst, reciting to them Our revelations. And We never destroy the cities, unless their people are evildoers.
en.28:60: Whatever thing you are given is but the material of this world, and its glitter. But what is with God is better, and longer lasting. Do you not comprehend?
en.28:61: Can someone to whom We have made a fine promise—which he will attain—be equal to someone to whom We have given enjoyments in this world, but who will be, on Resurrection Day, among the arraigned?
en.28:62: On the Day when He will call to them, and say, “Where are My associates whom you used to claim?”
en.28:63: Those against whom the sentence is justified will say, “Our Lord, these are they whom we misled. We misled them, as we were misled. We beg Your forgiveness; it was not us they used to worship.”
en.28:64: And it will be said, “Call on your partners.” And they will call on them, but they will not respond to them. And they will see the suffering. If only they were guided.
en.28:65: On the Day when He will call to them, and say, “What did you answer the Messengers?”
en.28:66: They will be blinded by the facts on that Day, and they will not question each other.
en.28:67: But he who repents, and believes, and does righteous deeds, may well be among the winners.
en.28:68: Your Lord creates whatever He wills, and He chooses. The choice is not theirs. Glory be to God, and exalted be He above the associations they make.
en.28:69: And your Lord knows what their hearts conceal, and what they reveal.
en.28:70: And He is God. There is no god but He. To Him belongs all praise in this life, and in the next. And His is the decision, and to Him you will be returned.
en.28:71: Say, “Have you considered? Had God made the night perpetual over you until the Day of Resurrection, which god other than God will bring you illumination? Do you not hear?”
en.28:72: Say, “Have you considered? Had God made the day perpetual over you until the Day of Resurrection, which god other than God will bring you night to rest in? Do you not see?”
en.28:73: It is out of His mercy that He made for you the night and the day, that you may rest in it, and seek some of His bounty; and that you may give thanks.
en.28:74: On the Day when He will call to them, and say, “Where are My associates whom you used to claim?”
en.28:75: And We will draw out from every community a witness, and say, “Produce your evidence.” Then they will realize that the truth is God’s, and those they used to invent have forsaken them.
en.28:76: Quaroon belonged to the clan of Moses, but he oppressed them. We had given him treasures, the keys of which would weigh down a group of strong men. His people said to him, “Do not exult; God does not love the exultant.
en.28:77: But seek, with what God has given you, the Home of the Hereafter, and do not neglect your share of this world. And be charitable, as God has been charitable to you. And do not seek corruption in the land. God does not like the seekers of corruption.”
en.28:78: He said, “I was given all this on account of knowledge I possess.” Did he not know that God destroyed many generations before him, who were stronger than he, and possessed greater riches? But the guilty will not be asked about their sins.
en.28:79: And he went out before his people in his splendor. Those who desired the worldly life said, “If only we possessed the likes of what Quaroon was given. He is indeed very fortunate.”
en.28:80: But those who were given knowledge said, “Woe to you! The reward of God is better for those who believe and do righteous deeds.” Yet none attains it except the steadfast.
en.28:81: So We caused the earth to cave in on him and his mansion. He had no company to save him from God, and he could not defend himself.
en.28:82: Those who had wished they were in his position the day before were saying, “Indeed, it is God who spreads the bounty to whomever He wills of His servants, and restricts it. Had God not been gracious to us, He would have caved in on us. No wonder the ungrateful never prosper.”
en.28:83: That Home of the Hereafter—We assign it for those who seek no superiority on earth, nor corruption. And the outcome is for the cautious.
en.28:84: Whoever brings a virtue will receive better than it. But whoever brings evil—the evildoers will be rewarded only according to what they used to do.
en.28:85: He Who ordained the Quran for you will return you Home. Say, “My Lord knows best who comes with guidance, and who is in manifest error.”
en.28:86: You did not expect the Scripture to be transmitted to you, except as mercy from your Lord. Therefore, do not be a supporter of the those who deny the truth.
en.28:87: And do not let them divert you from God’s revelations after they have been revealed to you. And pray to your Lord, and never be of the polytheists.
en.28:88: And do not invoke with God any other god. There is no god but He. All things perish, except His presence. His is the judgment, and to Him you will be returned.
en.29:2: Have the people supposed that they will be left alone to say, “We believe,” without being put to the test?
en.29:3: We have tested those before them. God will surely know the truthful, and He will surely know the liars.
en.29:4: Or do those who commit sins think they can fool Us? Terrible is their opinion!
en.29:5: Whoever looks forward to the meeting with God—the appointed time of God is coming. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
en.29:6: Whoever strives, strives only for himself. God is Independent of the beings.
en.29:7: Those who believe and do righteous deeds—We will remit their sins, and We will reward them according to the best of what they used to do.
en.29:8: We have advised the human being to be good to his parents. But if they urge you to associate with Me something you have no knowledge of, do not obey them. To Me is your return; and I will inform you of what you used to do.
en.29:9: Those who believe and do good works—We will admit them into the company of the virtuous.
en.29:10: Among the people is he who says, “We have believed in God.” Yet when he is harmed on God’s account, he equates the people's persecution with God’s retribution. And if help comes from your Lord, he says, “We were actually with you.” Is not God aware of what is inside the hearts of the people?
en.29:11: God certainly knows those who believe, and He certainly knows the the dissemblers.
en.29:12: Those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Follow our way, and we will carry your sins.” In no way can they carry any of their sins. They are liars.
en.29:13: They will carry their own loads, and other loads with their own. And they will be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning what they used to fabricate.
en.29:14: We sent Noah to his people, and He stayed among them for a thousand years minus fifty years. Then the Deluge swept them; for they were evildoers.
en.29:15: But We saved him, together with the company of the Ark, and We made it a sign for all peoples.
en.29:16: And Abraham, when he said to his people, “Worship God, and fear Him. That is better for you, if you only knew.
en.29:17: You worship idols besides God, and you fabricate falsehoods. Those you worship, instead of God, cannot provide you with livelihood. So seek your livelihood from God, and worship Him, and thank Him. To Him you will be returned.”
en.29:18: If you disbelieve, communities before you have also disbelieved. The Envoy is only responsible for clear transmission.
en.29:19: Have they not seen how God originates the creation, and then reproduces it? This is easy for God.
en.29:20: Say, “Roam the earth, and observe how He originated the creation.” Then God will bring about the next existence. God has power over all things.”
en.29:21: He punishes whom He wills, and He grants mercy to whom He wills, and to Him you will be restored.
en.29:22: You cannot escape, on earth or in the heaven; and you have no protector and no savior besides God.
en.29:23: Those who disbelieved in God’s signs and His encounter—these have despaired of My mercy. For them is a painful torment.
en.29:24: But the only response from his people was their saying, “Kill him, or burn him.” But God saved him from the fire. Surely in that are signs for people who believe.
en.29:25: And he said, “You have chosen idols instead of God, out of affection for one another in the worldly life. But then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will disown one another, and curse one another. Your destiny is the Inferno, and you will have no saviors.”
en.29:26: Then Lot believed in him, and said, “I am emigrating to my Lord. He is the Noble, the Wise.”
en.29:27: And We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and conferred on his descendants the Prophethood and the Scripture, and gave him his reward in this life; and in the Hereafter he will be among the upright.
en.29:28: And Lot, when he said to his people, “You are committing an obscenity not perpetrated before you by anyone in the whole world.
en.29:29: You approach men, and cut off the way, and commit lewdness in your gatherings.” But the only response from his people was to say, “Bring upon us God’s punishment, if you are truthful.”
en.29:30: He said, “My Lord, help me against the people of corruption.”
en.29:31: And when Our envoys brought Abraham the good news, they said, “We are going to destroy the people of this town; its people are evildoers.”
en.29:32: He said, “Yet Lot is in it.” They said, “We are well aware of who is in it. We will save him, and his family, except for his wife, who will remain behind.”
en.29:33: Then, when Our envoys came to Lot, they were mistreated, and he was troubled and distressed on their account. They said, “Do not fear, nor grieve. We will save you and your family, except for your wife, who will remain behind.”
en.29:34: “We will bring down upon the people of this town a scourge from heaven, because of their wickedness.”
en.29:35: And We left behind a clear trace of it, for people who understand.
en.29:36: And to Median, their brother Shuaib. He said, “O my people, worship God and anticipate the Last Day, and do not spread corruption in the land.”
en.29:37: But they rejected him, so the tremor overtook them, and they were left motionless in their homes.
en.29:38: And Aad and Thamood. It has become clear to you from their dwellings. the Adversary embellished for them their deeds, barring them from the path, even though they could see.
en.29:39: And Quaroon, and Pharaoh, and Hamaan—Moses went to them with clear arguments, but they acted arrogantly in the land. And they could not get ahead.
en.29:40: Each We seized by his sin. Against some We sent a sandstorm. Some were struck by the Blast. Some We caused the ground to cave in beneath them. And some We drowned. It was not God who wronged them, but it was they who wronged their own selves.
en.29:41: The likeness of those who take to themselves protectors other than God is that of the spider. It builds a house. But the most fragile of houses is the spider’s house. If they only knew.
en.29:42: God knows what they invoke besides Him. He is the Almighty, the Wise.
en.29:43: These examples—We put them forward to the people; but none grasps them except the learned.
en.29:44: God created the heavens and the earth with truth. Surely in that is a sign for the believers.
en.29:45: Recite what is revealed to you of the Scripture, and perform the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh). The devotional prayer (Ṣalāh) prevents indecencies and evils. And the remembrance of God is greater. And God knows what you do.
en.29:46: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in the best manner possible, except those who do wrong among them. And say, “We believe in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed to you; and our God and your God is One; and to Him we are submissive.”
en.29:47: Likewise, We revealed to you the Scripture. Those to whom We gave the Scripture believe in it, and some of these believe in it. None renounce Our communications except the those who deny the truth.
en.29:48: You did not read any scripture before this, nor did you write it down with your right hand; otherwise the falsifiers would have doubted.
en.29:49: In fact, it is clear signs in the hearts of those given knowledge. No one renounce Our signs except the unjust.
en.29:50: And they said, “If only a miracle from his Lord was sent down to him.” Say, “Miracles are only with God, and I am only a clear warner.”
en.29:51: Does it not suffice them that We revealed to you the Scripture, which is recited to them? In that is mercy and a reminder for people who believe.
en.29:52: Say, “God suffices as witness between you and me. He knows everything in the heavens and the Earth. Those who believe in vanity and reject God—it is they who are the losers.”
en.29:53: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. Were it not for a specified time, the punishment would have come to them. But it will come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware.
en.29:54: They urge you to hasten the punishment. But the Inferno will engulf the those who deny the truth.
en.29:55: On the Day when the punishment will envelop them, from above them, and from beneath their feet, He will say, “Taste what you used to do!”
en.29:56: O My servants who have believed: My earth is vast, so worship Me alone.
en.29:57: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us you will be returned.
en.29:58: Those who believe and work righteousness—We will settle them in the eternal Gardens, in mansions under which rivers flow, dwelling therein forever. Excellent is the compensation for the workers.
en.29:59: Those who endure patiently, and in their Lord they trust.
en.29:60: How many a creature there is that does not carry its provision? God provides for them, and for you. He is the Hearer, the Knowledgeable.
en.29:61: And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth and regulated the sun and the moon?” They would say, “God.” Why then do they deviate?
en.29:62: God expands the provision for whomever He wills of His servants, and restricts it. God is Cognizant of all things.
en.29:63: And if you asked them, “Who sends water down from the sky, with which He revives the earth after it had died?” They would say, “God.” Say, “Praise be to God.” But most of them do not understand.
en.29:64: The life of this world is nothing but diversion and play, and the Home of the Hereafter is the Life, if they only knew.
en.29:65: When they embark on a vessel, they pray to God, devoting their faith to Him; but once He has delivered them safely to land, they attribute partners to Him.
en.29:66: To be ungrateful for what We have given them, and to enjoy themselves. They will surely come to know.
en.29:67: Do they not see that We established a Secure Sanctuary, while all around them the people are being carried away? Do they believe in falsehood, and reject the blessings of God?
en.29:68: And who does greater wrong than he who fabricates lies and attributes them to God, or calls the truth a lie when it has come to him? Is there not in the Inferno a dwelling for the blasphemers?
en.29:69: As for those who strive for Us—We will guide them in Our ways. God is with the doers of good.
en.3:2: God, there is no god but He, the Living, the Eternal.
en.3:3: He sent down to you the Scripture with the Truth, confirming what came before it; and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel.
en.3:4: Aforetime, as guidance for mankind; and He sent down the Criterion. Those who have rejected God’s signs will have a severe punishment. God is Mighty, Able to take revenge.
en.3:5: Nothing is hidden from God, on earth or in the heaven.
en.3:6: It is He who forms you in the wombs as He wills. There is no god except He, the Almighty, the Wise.
en.3:7: It is He who revealed to you the Scripture. Some of its verses are definitive; they are the foundation of the Scripture, and others are unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation, they follow the unspecific part, seeking descent, and seeking to derive an interpretation. But none knows its interpretation except God and those firmly rooted in knowledge say, “We believe in it; all is from our Lord.” But none recollects except those with understanding.
en.3:8: “Our Lord, do not cause our hearts to swerve after You have guided us, and bestow on us mercy from Your presence; You are the Giver.”
en.3:9: “Our Lord, You will gather the people for a Day in which there is no doubt.” God will never break His promise.
en.3:10: As for those who disbelieve, neither their wealth nor their children will avail them anything against God. These will be fuel for the Fire.
en.3:11: Like the behavior of Pharaoh’s people and those before them. They rejected Our signs, so God seized them for their sins. God is Strict in retribution.
en.3:12: Say to those who disbelieve, “You will be defeated, and rounded up into the Inferno—an awful resting-place.”
en.3:13: There was a sign for you in the two parties that met. One party fighting in the way of God, and the other was disbelieving. They saw them with their own eyes twice their number. But God supports with His help whomever He wills. In that is a lesson for those with insight.
en.3:14: Adorned for the people is the love of desires, such as women, and children, and piles upon piles of gold and silver, and branded horses, and livestock, and fields. These are the conveniences of the worldly life, but with God lies the finest resort.
en.3:15: Say, “Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who are righteous, with their Lord are Gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will remain forever, and purified spouses, and acceptance from God.” God is Observant of the servants.
en.3:16: Those who say, “Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins, and save us from the suffering of the Fire.”
en.3:17: The patient, and the truthful, and the reverent, and the charitable, and the seekers of forgiveness at dawn.
en.3:18: God bears witness that there is no god but He, as do the divine messengers, and those endowed with knowledge—upholding justice. There is no god but He, the Mighty, the Wise.
en.3:19: Religion with God is Islam. Those to whom the Scripture was given differed only after knowledge came to them, out of envy among themselves. Whoever rejects the signs of God—God is quick to take account.
en.3:20: If they argue with you, say, “I have surrendered myself to God, and those who follow me.” And say to those who were given the Scripture, and to the unlearned, “Have you surrendered?” If they have surrendered, then they are guided; but if they turn away, then your duty is to convey. God is Seeing of the servants.
en.3:21: As for those who defy God’s revelations, and kill the messengers of God unjustly, and kill those who advocate justice among the people—promise them a painful retribution.
en.3:22: They are those whose deeds will come to nothing, in this world and in the Hereafter; and they will have no saviors.
en.3:23: Have you not considered those who were given a share of the Scripture, as they were called to the Scripture of God to arbitrate between them; then some of them turned back, and declined?
en.3:24: That is because they said, “The Fire will not touch us except for a limited number of days.” They have been misled in their religion by the lies they fabricated.
en.3:25: How about when We gather them for a Day in which there is no doubt, and each soul will be paid in full for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged?
en.3:26: Say, “O God, Owner of Sovereignty. You grant sovereignty to whom You will, and You strip sovereignty from whom you will. You honor whom you will, and You humiliate whom you will. In Your hand is all goodness. You are Capable of all things.”
en.3:27: “You merge the night into the day, and You merge the day into the night; and you bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living; and You provide for whom you will without measure.”
en.3:28: Believers are not to take those who deny the truth for friends instead of believers. Whoever does that has nothing to do with God, unless it is to protect your own selves against them. God warns you to beware of Him. To God is the destiny.
en.3:29: Say, “Whether you conceal what is in your hearts, or disclose it, God knows it.” He knows everything in the heavens and the earth. God is Powerful over everything.
en.3:30: On the Day when every soul finds all the good it has done presented. And as for the evil it has done, it will wish there were a great distance between them. God cautions you of Himself. God is Kind towards the servants.
en.3:31: Say, “If you love God, then follow me, and God will love you, and will forgive you your sins.” God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.3:32: Say, “Obey God and the Envoy.” But if they turn away—God does not love the faithless.
en.3:33: God chose Adam, and Noah, and the family of Abraham, and the family of Imran, over all mankind.
en.3:34: Offspring one of the other. God is Hearer and Knower.
en.3:35: The wife of Imran said, “My Lord, I have vowed to You what is in my womb, dedicated, so accept from me; You are the Hearer and Knower.”
en.3:36: And when she delivered her, she said, “My Lord, I have delivered a female,” and God was well aware of what she has delivered, “and the male is not like the female, and I have named her Mary, and have commended her and her descendants to Your protection, from the Adversary the outcast.”
en.3:37: Her Lord accepted her with a gracious reception, and brought her a beautiful upbringing, and entrusted her to the care of Zechariah. Whenever Zechariah entered upon her in the sanctuary, he found her with provision. He said, “O Mary, where did you get this from?” She said, “It is from God; God provides to whom He wills without reckoning.”
en.3:38: Thereupon Zechariah prayed to his Lord; he said, “My Lord, bestow on me good offspring from Your presence; You are the Hearer of Prayers.”
en.3:39: Then the divine messengers called out to him, as he stood praying in the sanctuary: “God gives you good news of John; confirming a Word from God, and honorable, and moral, and a messenger of God; one of the upright.”
en.3:40: He said, “My Lord, how will I have a son, when old age has overtaken me, and my wife is barren?” He said, “Even so, God does whatever He wills.”
en.3:41: He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you shall not speak to the people for three days, except by gestures. And remember your Lord much, and praise in the evening and the morning.”
en.3:42: The angels said, “O Mary, God has chosen you, and has purified you. He has chosen you over all the women of the world.
en.3:43: “O Mary, be devoted to your Lord, and bow down, and kneel with those who kneel.”
en.3:44: These are accounts from the Unseen, which We reveal to you. You were not with them when they cast their lots as to which of them would take charge of Mary; nor were you with them as they quarreled.
en.3:45: The Divine Messengers said, “O Mary, God gives you good news of a Word from Him. His name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, well-esteemed in this world and the next, and one of the nearest.
en.3:46: He will speak to the people from the crib, and in adulthood, and will be one of the virtuous.”
en.3:47: She said, “My Lord, how can I have a child, when no man has touched me?” He said, “It will be so. God creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He only says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.”
en.3:48: And He will teach him the Scripture and wisdom, and the Torah and the Gospel.
en.3:49: A messenger to the Children of Israel: “I have come to you with a sign from your Lord. I make for you out of clay the figure of a bird; then I breathe into it, and it becomes a bird by God’s leave. And I heal the blind and the leprous, and I revive the dead, by God’s leave. And I inform you concerning what you eat, and what you store in your homes. In that is a sign for you, if you are believers.”
en.3:50: “And verifying what lies before me of the Torah, and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. I have come to you with a sign from your Lord; so fear God, and obey me.”
en.3:51: “God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path.”
en.3:52: When Jesus sensed disbelief on their part, he said, “Who are my allies towards God?” The disciples said, “We are God’s allies; we have believed in God, and bear witness that we submit.”
en.3:53: “Our Lord, we have believed in what You have revealed, and we have followed the Envoy, so count us among the witnesses.”
en.3:54: They planned, and God planned; but God is the Best of planners.
en.3:55: God said, “O Jesus, I am terminating your life, and raising you to Me, and clearing you of those who disbelieve. And I will make those who follow you superior to those who disbelieve, until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return; then I will judge between you regarding what you were disputing.
en.3:56: As for those who disbelieve, I will punish them with a severe punishment, in this world and the next, and they will have no helpers.
en.3:57: And as for those who believe and do good works, He will give them their rewards in full. God does not love the unjust.”
en.3:58: This is what We recite to you of the Verses and the Wise Reminder.
en.3:59: The likeness of Jesus in God’s sight is that of Adam: He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he was.
en.3:60: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be of those who doubt.
en.3:61: And if anyone disputes with you about him, after the knowledge that has come to you, say, “Come, let us call our children and your children, and our women and your women, and ourselves and yourselves, and let us invoke God’s curse on the liars.”
en.3:62: This is the narrative of truth: there is no god but God. God is the Mighty, the Wise.
en.3:63: But if they turn away—God knows the corrupt.
en.3:64: Say, “O People of the Scripture, come to terms common between us and you: that we worship none but God, and that we associate nothing with Him, and that none of us takes others as lords besides God.” And if they turn away, say, “Bear witness that we have submitted.”
en.3:65: O People of the Scripture! Why do you argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Will you not reason?
en.3:66: Here you are—you argue about things you know, but why do you argue about things you do not know? God knows, and you do not know.
en.3:67: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was a Monotheist, a Muslim. And he was not of the Polytheists.
en.3:68: The people most deserving of Abraham are those who followed him, and this messenger of God, and those who believe. God is the Guardian of the believers.
en.3:69: A party of the People of the Scripture would love to lead you astray, but they only lead themselves astray, and they do not realize it.
en.3:70: O People of the Scripture! Why do you reject the revelations of God, even as you witness?
en.3:71: O People of the Scripture! Why do you confound the truth with falsehood, and knowingly conceal the truth?
en.3:72: Some of the People of the Scripture say, “Believe in what was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day, and reject it at its end, so that they may return.”
en.3:73: And trust none except those who follow your religion.” Say, “Guidance is God’s guidance. If someone is given the like of what you were given, or they argue with you before your Lord, say, “All grace is in God’s hand; He gives it to whomever He wills.” God is Bounteous and Knowing.
en.3:74: He specifies His mercy for whomever He wills. God is Possessor of Sublime Grace.
en.3:75: Among the People of the Scripture is he, who, if you entrust him with a heap of gold, he will give it back to you. And among them is he, who, if you entrust him with a single coin, he will not give it back to you, unless you keep after him. That is because they say, “We are under no obligation towards the gentiles.” They tell lies about God, and they know it.
en.3:76: Indeed, whoever fulfills his commitments and maintains piety—God loves the God-conscious.
en.3:77: Those who exchange the covenant of God, and their vows, for a small price, will have no share in the Hereafter, and God will not speak to them, nor will He look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They will have a painful punishment.
en.3:78: And among them are those who twist the Scripture with their tongues, that you may think it from the Scripture, when it is not from the Scripture. And they say, “It is from God,” when it is not from God. They tell lies and attribute them to God, knowingly.
en.3:79: No person to whom God has given the Scripture, and wisdom, and prophethood would ever say to the people, “Be my worshipers rather than God’s.” Rather, “Be people of the Lord, according to the Scripture you teach, and the teachings you learn.”
en.3:80: Nor would he command you to take the divine messengers and the messengers of God as lords. Would he command you to infidelity after you have submitted?
en.3:81: God received the covenant of the messengers of God, “Inasmuch as I have given you of scripture and wisdom; should a messenger come to you verifying what you have, you shall believe in him, and support him.” He said, “Do you affirm My covenant and take it upon yourselves?” They said, “We affirm it.” He said, “Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses.”
en.3:82: Whoever turns away after that—these are the deceitful.
en.3:83: Do they desire other than the religion of God, when to Him has submitted everything in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and to Him they will be returned?
en.3:84: Say, “We believe in God, and in what was revealed to us; and in what was revealed to Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the Patriarchs; and in what was given to Moses, and Jesus, and the messengers of God from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and to Him we submit.”
en.3:85: Whoever seeks other than Islam as a religion, it will not be accepted from him, and in the Hereafter he will be among the losers.
en.3:86: How will God guide a people who disbelieved after having believed, and had witnessed that the Envoy is true, and the clear proofs had come to them? God does not guide the unjust people.
en.3:87: Those—their penalty is that upon them falls the curse of God, and of the divine messengers, and of all mankind.
en.3:88: Remaining in it eternally, without their punishment being eased from them, and without being reprieved.
en.3:89: Except those who repent afterwards, and reform; for God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.3:90: As for those who disbelieve after having believed, then plunge deeper into disbelief, their repentance will not be accepted; these are the lost.
en.3:91: As for those who disbelieve and die those who deny the truth, even the earth full of gold would not be accepted from any of them, were he to offer it for ransom. These will have a painful torment, and will have no saviors.
en.3:92: You will not attain virtuous conduct until you give of what you cherish. Whatever you give away, God is aware of it.
en.3:93: All food was permissible to the Children of Israel, except what Israel forbade for itself before the Torah was revealed. Say, “Bring the Torah, and read it, if you are truthful.”
en.3:94: Whoever forges lies about God after that—these are the unjust.
en.3:95: Say, “God has spoken the truth, so follow the religion of Abraham the Monotheist; he was not a Pagan.”
en.3:96: The first house established for mankind is the one at Bekka; blessed, and guidance for all people.
en.3:97: In it are evident signs; the Station of Abraham. Whoever enters it attains security. Pilgrimage to the House is a duty to God for all who can make the journey. But as for those who refuse—God is Independent of the worlds.
en.3:98: Say, “O People of the Scripture, why do you reject the Revelations of God, when God witnesses what you do?”
en.3:99: Say, “O People of the Scripture, why do you hinder from God’s path those who believe, seeking to distort it, even though you are witnesses? God is not unaware of what you do.”
en.3:100: O you who believe! If you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they will turn you, after your belief, into those who deny the truth.
en.3:101: And how could you disbelieve, when God’s revelations are being recited to you, and among you is His Envoy? Whoever cleaves to God has been guided to a straight path.
en.3:102: O you who believe! Revere God with due reverence, and do not die except as Muslims.
en.3:103: And hold fast to the rope of God, altogether, and do not become divided. And remember God’s blessings upon you; how you were enemies, and He reconciled your hearts, and by His grace you became brethren. And you were on the brink of a pit of fire, and He saved you from it. God thus clarifies His revelations for you, so that you may be guided.
en.3:104: And let there be among you a community calling to virtue, and advocating righteousness, and deterring from evil. These are the successful.
en.3:105: And do not be like those who separated and disputed after the clear proofs came to them; for them is a great punishment.
en.3:106: On the Day when some faces will be whitened, and some faces will be blackened. As for those whose faces are blackened: “Did you disbelieve after your belief?” Then taste the punishment for having disbelieved.
en.3:107: But as for those whose faces are whitened: they are in God’s mercy, remaining in it forever.
en.3:108: These are the revelations of God. We recite them to you in truth. God desires no injustice for mankind.
en.3:109: To God belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth, and to God all events are referred.
en.3:110: You are the best community that ever emerged for humanity: you advocate what is moral, and forbid what is immoral, and believe in God. Had the People of the Scripture believed, it would have been better for them. Among them are the believers, but most of them are sinners.
en.3:111: They will do you no harm, beyond insulting you. And if they fight you, they will turn around and flee, then they will not be helped.
en.3:112: They shall be humiliated wherever they are encountered, except through a rope from God, and a rope from the people; and they incurred wrath from God, and were stricken with misery. That is because they rejected God’s revelations, and killed the messengers of God unjustly. That is because they rebelled and committed aggression.
en.3:113: They are not alike. Among the People of the Scripture is a community that is upright; they recite God’s revelations throughout the night, and they prostrate themselves.
en.3:114: They believe in God and the Last Day, and advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and are quick to do good deeds. These are among the virtuous.
en.3:115: Whatever good they do, they will not be denied it. God knows the virtuous.
en.3:116: As for those who disbelieve, neither their possessions nor their children will avail them anything against God. These are the inhabitants of the Fire, abiding therein forever.
en.3:117: The parable of what they spend in this worldly life is that of a frosty wind that strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged their souls, and destroys it. God did not wrong them, but they wronged their own selves.
en.3:118: O you who believe! Do not befriend outsiders who never cease to wish you harm. They love to see you suffer. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, but what their hearts conceal is worse. We have made the messages clear for you, if you understand.
en.3:119: There you are, you love them, but they do not love you, and you believe in the entire scripture. And when they meet you, they say, “We believe;” but when they are alone, they bite their fingers in rage at you. Say, “Die in your rage; God knows what is within the hearts.”
en.3:120: If something good happens to you, it upsets them; but if something bad befalls you, they rejoice at it. But if you persevere and maintain righteousness, their schemes will not harm you at all. God comprehends what they do.
en.3:121: Remember when you left your home in the morning, to assign battle-positions for the believers. God is Hearing and Knowing.
en.3:122: When two groups among you almost faltered, but God was their Protector. So in God let the believers put their trust.
en.3:123: God had given you victory at Badr, when you were weak. So fear God, that you may be thankful.
en.3:124: When you said to the believers, “Is it not enough for you that your Lord has reinforced you with three thousand angels, sent down?”
en.3:125: It is; but if you persevere and remain cautious, and they attack you suddenly, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand angels, well trained.
en.3:126: God made it but a message of hope for you, and to reassure your hearts thereby. Victory comes only from God the Almighty, the Wise.
en.3:127: He thus cuts off a section of those who disbelieved, or subdues them, so they retreat disappointed.
en.3:128: It is no concern of yours whether He redeems them or punishes them. They are evildoers.
en.3:129: To God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills, and He punishes whom He wills. God is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
en.3:130: O you who believe! Do not feed on usury, compounded over and over, and fear God, so that you may prosper.
en.3:131: And guard yourselves against the Fire that is prepared for the those who deny the truth.
en.3:132: And obey God and the Envoy, that you may obtain mercy.
en.3:133: And race towards forgiveness from your Lord, and a Garden as wide as the heavens and the earth, prepared for the virtuous.
en.3:134: Those who give in prosperity and adversity, and those who restrain anger, and those who forgive people. God loves the doers of good.
en.3:135: And those who, when they commit an indecency or wrong themselves, remember God and ask forgiveness for their sins—and who forgives sins except God? And they do not persist in their wrongdoing while they know.
en.3:136: Those—their reward is forgiveness from their Lord, and gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. How excellent is the reward of the workers.
en.3:137: Many societies have passed away before you. So travel the earth and note the fate of the deniers.
en.3:138: This is a proclamation to humanity, and guidance, and advice for the virtuous.
en.3:139: And do not waver, nor feel remorse. You are the superior ones, if you are believers.
en.3:140: If a wound afflicts you, a similar wound has afflicted the others. Such days We alternate between the people, that God may know those who believe, and take martyrs from among you. God does not love the evildoers.
en.3:141: So that God may prove those who believe, and eliminate the those who deny the truth.
en.3:142: Or do you expect to enter the eternal Gardens, before God has distinguished those among you who strive, and before He has distinguished the steadfast?
en.3:143: You used to wish for death before you have faced it. Now you have seen it before your own eyes.
en.3:144: Muhammad is no more than a messenger. Messengers have passed on before him. If he dies or gets killed, will you turn on your heels? He who turns on his heels will not harm God in any way. And God will reward the appreciative.
en.3:145: No soul can die except by God’s leave, at a predetermined time. Whoever desires the reward of the world, We will give him some of it; and whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter, We will give him some of it; and We will reward the appreciative.
en.3:146: How many a messenger of God fought alongside him numerous godly people? They did not waver for what afflicted them in the cause of God, nor did they weaken, nor did they give in. God loves those who endure.
en.3:147: Their only words were, “Our Lord, forgive us our offences, and our excesses in our conduct, and strengthen our foothold, and help us against the disbelieving people.”
en.3:148: So God gave them the reward of this world, and the excellent reward of the Hereafter. God loves the doers of good.
en.3:149: O you who believe! If you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, and you end up losers.
en.3:150: God is your Master, and He is the Best of Helpers.
en.3:151: We will throw terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve, because they attribute to God partners for which He revealed no sanction. Their lodging is the Fire. Miserable is the lodging of the evildoers.
en.3:152: God has fulfilled His promise to you, and you defeated them by His leave; until when you faltered, and disputed the command, and disobeyed after He had shown you what you like. Some of you want this world, and some of you want the next. Then He turned you away from them, to test you; but He pardoned you. God is Gracious towards the believers.
en.3:153: Remember when you fled, not caring for anyone, even though the Envoy was calling you from your rear. Then He repaid you with sorrow upon sorrow, so that you would not grieve over what you missed, or for what afflicted you. God is Informed of what you do.
en.3:154: Then after the setback, He sent down security upon you. Slumber overcame some of you, while others cared only for themselves, thinking of God thoughts that were untrue—thoughts of ignorance—saying, “Is anything up to us?” Say, “Everything is up to God.” They conceal within themselves what they do not reveal to you. And they say, “If it was up to us, none of us would have been killed here.” Say, “Even if you Had stayed in your homes, those destined to be killed would have marched into their death beds.” God thus tests what is in your minds, and purifies what is in your hearts. God knows what the hearts contain.
en.3:155: Those of you who turned back on the day when the two armies clashed—it was the Adversary who caused them to backslide, on account of some of what they have earned. But God has forgiven them. God is Forgiving and Prudent.
en.3:156: O you who believe! Do not be like those who disbelieved, and said of their brethren who marched in the land, or went on the offensive, “Had they stayed with us, they would not have died or been killed.” So that God may make it a cause of regret in their hearts. God gives life and causes death. God is Seeing of what you do.
en.3:157: If you are killed in the cause of God, or die—forgiveness and mercy from God are better than what they hoard.
en.3:158: If you die, or are killed—to God you will be gathered up.
en.3:159: It is by of grace from God that you were gentle with them. Had you been harsh, hardhearted, they would have dispersed from around you. So pardon them, and ask forgiveness for them, and consult them in the conduct of affairs. And when you make a decision, put your trust in God; God loves the trusting.
en.3:160: If God supports you, there is none who can overcome you. But if He fails you, who is there to help you after Him? So in God let the believers put their trust.
en.3:161: It is not for a messenger of God to act dishonestly. Whoever acts dishonestly will bring his dishonesty on the Day of Resurrection. Then every soul will be paid in full for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
en.3:162: Is someone who pursues God's approval the same as someone who incurs God's wrath and his refuge is the Inferno—the miserable destination?
en.3:163: They have different ranks with God, and God is Seeing of what they do.
en.3:164: God has blessed the believers, as He raised up among them a messenger from among themselves, who recites to them His revelations, and purifies them, and teaches them the Scripture and wisdom; although before that they were in evident error.
en.3:165: And when a calamity befell you, even after you had inflicted twice as much, you said, “How is this?” Say, “It is from your own selves.” God is Able to do all things.
en.3:166: What befell you on the day the two armies clashed was with God’s permission; that He may know the believers.
en.3:167: And that He may know the the dissemblers. And it was said to them, “Come, fight in the cause of God, or contribute.” They said, “If we knew how to fight, we would have followed you.” On that day they were closer to infidelity than they were to faith. They say with their mouths what is not in their hearts; but God knows what they hide.
en.3:168: Those who said of their brethren, as they stayed behind, “Had they obeyed us, they would not have been killed.” Say, “Then avert death from yourselves, if you are truthful.”
en.3:169: Do not consider those killed in the cause of God as dead. In fact, they are alive, at their Lord, well provided for.
en.3:170: Delighting in what God has given them out of His grace, and happy for those who have not yet joined them; that they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
en.3:171: They rejoice in grace from God, and bounty, and that God will not waste the reward of the faithful.
en.3:172: Those who responded to God and the Envoy, despite the persecution they had suffered. For the virtuous and the God-conscious among them is a great reward.
en.3:173: Those to whom the people have said, “The people have mobilized against you, so fear them.” But this only increased them in faith, and they said, “God is enough for us; He is the Excellent Protector.”
en.3:174: So they came back with grace from God, and bounty, and no harm having touched them. They pursued what pleases God. God possesses immense grace.
en.3:175: That is only the Adversary frightening his partisans; so do not fear them, but fear Me, if you are believers.
en.3:176: And do not be saddened by those who rush into disbelief. They will not harm God in the least. God desires to give them no share in the Hereafter. A terrible torment awaits them.
en.3:177: Those who exchange blasphemy for faith will not harm God in the least. A painful torment awaits them.
en.3:178: Those who disbelieve should not assume that We respite them for their own good. In fact, We only respite them so that they may increase in sinfulness. A humiliating torment awaits them.
en.3:179: God will not leave the believers as you are, without distinguishing the wicked from the sincere. Nor will God inform you of the future, but God elects from among His messengers whom He wills. So believe in God and His messengers. If you believe and practice piety, you will have a splendid reward.
en.3:180: Those who withhold what God has given them of his bounty should not assume that is good for them. In fact, it is bad for them. They will be encircled by their hoardings on the Day of Resurrection. To God belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth, and God is well acquainted with what you do.
en.3:181: God has heard the statement of those who said, “God is poor, and we are rich.” We will write down what they said, and their wrongful killing of the messengers of God; and We will say, “Taste the torment of the burning.”
en.3:182: “This is on account of what your hands have forwarded, and because God is not unjust towards the creatures.”
en.3:183: Those who said, “God has made a covenant with us, that we shall not believe in any messenger unless he brings us an offering to be consumed by fire.” Say, “Messengers have come to you before me with proofs, and with what you asked for; so why did you assassinate them, if you are truthful?”
en.3:184: If they accuse you of lying, messengers before you were accused of lying. They came with the proofs, and the Psalms, and the Illuminating Scripture.
en.3:185: Every soul will have a taste of death, and you will receive your recompense on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever is swayed from the Fire, and admitted to the eternal Gardens, has won. The life of this world is merely enjoyment of delusion.
en.3:186: You will be tested through your possessions and your persons; and you will hear from those who received the Scripture before you, and from the idol worshipers, much abuse. But if you persevere and lead a righteous life—that indeed is a mark of great determination.
en.3:187: God received a pledge from those who were given the Scripture: “You shall proclaim it to the people, and not conceal it.” But they disregarded it behind their backs, and exchanged it for a small price. What a miserable exchange they made.
en.3:188: Do not think that those who rejoice in what they have done, and love to be praised for what they have not done—do not think they can evade the punishment. They will have a painful punishment.
en.3:189: To God belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. God has power over all things.
en.3:190: In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, are signs for people of understanding.
en.3:191: Those who remember God while standing, and sitting, and on their sides; and they reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth: “Our Lord, You did not create this in vain, glory to You, so protect us from the punishment of the Fire.”
en.3:192: “Our Lord, whomever You commit to the Fire, You have disgraced. The evildoers will have no helpers.”
en.3:193: “Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling to the faith: `Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord! Forgive us our sins, and remit our misdeeds, and make us die in the company of the virtuous.”
en.3:194: “Our Lord, and give us what You have promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Surely You never break a promise.”
en.3:195: And so their Lord answered them: “I will not waste the work of any worker among you, whether male or female. You are one of another. For those who emigrated, and were expelled from their homes, and were persecuted because of Me, and fought and were killed—I will remit for them their sins, and will admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow—a reward from God. With God is the ultimate reward.”
en.3:196: Do not be impressed by the those who deny the truth’ movements in the land.
en.3:197: A brief enjoyment, then their abode is the Inferno. What a miserable resort.
en.3:198: As for those who feared their Lord: for them will be gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever—hospitality from God. What God possesses is best for the just.
en.3:199: Among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in God, and in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed to them. They are humble before God, and they do not sell God’s revelations for a cheap price. These will have their reward with their Lord. God is swift in reckoning.
en.3:200: O you who believe! Be patient, and advocate patience, and be united, and revere God, so that you may thrive.
en.30:3: In a nearby territory. But following their defeat, they will be victorious.
en.30:4: In a few years. The matter is up to God, in the past, and in the future. On that day, the believers will rejoice.
en.30:5: In God’s support. He supports whomever He wills. He is the Almighty, the Merciful.
en.30:6: The promise of God—God never breaks His promise, but most people do not know.
en.30:7: They know an outer aspect of the worldly life, but they are heedless of the Hereafter.
en.30:8: Do they not reflect within themselves? God did not create the heavens and the earth, and what is between them, except with reason, and for a specific duration. But most people, regarding meeting their Lord, are those who deny the truth.
en.30:9: Have they not travelled the earth and seen how those before them ended up? They were more powerful than them, and they cultivated the land and developed it more than they developed it, and their messengers came to them with clear signs. God would never wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves.
en.30:10: Then, evil was the end of those who committed evil. That is because they rejected God’s revelations, and used to ridicule them.
en.30:11: God originates creation, and then repeats it. Then to Him you will be returned.
en.30:12: On the Day when the Hour takes place, the guilty will despair.
en.30:13: They will have no intercessors from among their idols, and they will disown their partners.
en.30:14: On the Day when the Hour takes place—on that Day they will separate.
en.30:15: As for those who believed and did good deeds—they will be delighted in meadows.
en.30:16: But as for those who disbelieved, and rejected Our signs and the encounter of the Hereafter—those will be hauled into the torment.
en.30:17: So glorify God when you retire at night, and when you rise in the morning.
en.30:18: His is the praise in the heavens and on earth, and in the evening, and when you reach midday.
en.30:19: He brings the living out of the dead, and He brings the dead out of the living, and He revives the land after it had died. Likewise you will be resurrected.
en.30:20: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; and behold, you become humans spreading out.
en.30:21: And of His signs is that He created for you mates from among yourselves, so that you may find tranquility in them; and He planted love and compassion between you. In this are signs for people who reflect.
en.30:22: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the diversity of your languages and colors. In this are signs for those who know.
en.30:23: And of His signs are your sleep by night and day, and your pursuit of His bounty. In this are signs for people who listen.
en.30:24: And of His signs is that He shows you the lightning, causing fear and hope. And He brings down water from the sky, and with it He revives the earth after it was dead. In this are signs for people who understand.
en.30:25: And of His signs is that the heaven and the earth stand at His disposal. And then, when He calls you out of the earth, you will emerge at once.
en.30:26: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth. All are submissive to Him.
en.30:27: It is He who initiates creation, and then repeats it, something easy for Him. His is the highest attribute, in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Wise.
en.30:28: He illustrates an example for you, from your own selves: do you make your servants full partners in the wealth We have given you? Do you revere them as you revere one another? We thus explain the revelations for a people who understand.
en.30:29: Yet the evildoers follow their desires without knowledge. But who can guide whom God leaves astray? They will have no helpers.
en.30:30: So devote yourself to the religion of monotheism—the natural instinct God has instilled in mankind. There is no altering God’s creation. This is the true religion, but most people do not know.
en.30:31: Turning towards Him—and be conscious of Him, and perform the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh), and do not be of the idolaters.
en.30:32: Of those who divided their religion, and became sects; each faction pleased with what they have.
en.30:33: When affliction touches the people, they call on their Lord, turning to Him in repentance. But then, when He gives them a taste of His mercy, some of them attribute partners to their Lord.
en.30:34: To show ingratitude for what We have given them. Indulge yourselves—you will surely know.
en.30:35: Have We sent down to them any authority, which speaks in support of their idols?
en.30:36: When We give people a taste of mercy, they rejoice in it. But when adversity befalls them, because of what their hands have perpetrated, they begin to despair.
en.30:37: Do they not see that God expands the provision for whomever He wills, or restricts it? Surely in this are signs for people who believe.
en.30:38: So give the relative his rights, and the destitute, and the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek God’s presence. Those are the prosperous.
en.30:39: The usury you practice, seeking thereby to multiply people’s wealth, will not multiply with God. But what you give in charity, desiring God’s approval—these are the multipliers.
en.30:40: God is He who created you, then provides for you, then makes you die, then brings you back to life. Can any of your idols do any of that? Glorified is He, and Exalted above what they associate.
en.30:41: Corruption has appeared on land and sea, because of what people’s hands have earned, in order to make them taste some of what they have done, so that they might return.
en.30:42: Say, “Roam the earth, and observe the fate of those who came before. Most of them were idolaters.”
en.30:43: So devote yourself to the upright religion, before there comes from God a Day that cannot be averted. On that Day, they will be shocked.
en.30:44: Whoever disbelieves, upon him falls his disbelief. And whoever acts righteously—they are preparing for themselves.
en.30:45: So that He may reward those who have believed and done the virtuous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not love the ungrateful.
en.30:46: And of His signs is that He sends the winds bearing good news, to give you a taste of His mercy, and so that the ships may sail by His command, and so that you may seek of His bounty, and so that you may give thanks.
en.30:47: Before you, We sent messengers to their people. They came to them with clear proofs. Then We took revenge on those who sinned. It is incumbent on Us to help the believers.
en.30:48: God is He who sends the winds. They stir up clouds. Then He spreads them in the sky as He wills. And He breaks them apart. Then you see rain drops issuing from their midst. Then, when He makes it fall upon whom He wills of His servants, behold, they rejoice.
en.30:49: Although they were before this—before it was sent down upon them—in despair.
en.30:50: So observe the effects of God’s mercy—how He revives the earth after it was dead. Indeed, He is the Reviver of the dead. He is Capable of everything.
en.30:51: But if We send a wind, and they see it turning things yellow, they would continue thereafter to disbelieve.
en.30:52: You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn away.
en.30:53: Nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make hear only those who believe in Our signs, and so have submitted.
en.30:54: God is He Who created you weak, then after weakness gave you strength, then after strength gave you weakness and gray hair. He creates whatever He wills. He is the Omniscient, the Omnipotent.
en.30:55: On the Day when the Hour takes place, the sinners will swear they had stayed but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
en.30:56: But those endowed with knowledge and faith will say, “You remained in God’s Book until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not know.”
en.30:57: On that Day, the sinners’ excuses will not benefit them, nor will they be excused.
en.30:58: We have cited in this Quran for the people every sort of parable. But even if you bring them a miracle, those who disbelieve will say, “You are nothing but fakers.”
en.30:59: God thus seals the hearts of those who do not know.
en.30:60: So be patient. The promise of God is true. And do not let those who lack certainty belittle you.
en.31:2: These are the Verses of the Wise Book.
en.31:3: A guide and a mercy for the virtuous.
