en.31:4: Those who observe the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh), and pay the obligatory charity, and are certain of the Hereafter.
en.31:5: These are upon guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.
en.31:6: Among the people is he who trades in distracting tales; intending, without knowledge, to lead away from God’s way, and to make a mockery of it. These will have a humiliating punishment.
en.31:7: And when Our Verses are recited to him, he turns away in pride, as though he did not hear them, as though there is deafness in his ears. So inform him of a painful punishment.
en.31:8: As for those who believe and do good deeds—for them are the Gardens of Bliss.
en.31:9: Dwelling therein forever. The promise of God is true. He is the Mighty, the Wise.
en.31:10: He created the heavens without pillars that you can see, and placed stabilizers on earth lest it shifts with you, and scattered throughout it all kinds of creatures. And from the sky We sent down water, and caused to grow therein of every noble pair.
en.31:11: Such is God’s creation. Now show me what those besides Him have created. In fact, the wicked are in obvious error.
en.31:12: We endowed Luqman with wisdom: “Give thanks to God.” Whoever is appreciative—is appreciative for the benefit of his own soul. And whoever is unappreciative—God is Sufficient and Praiseworthy.
en.31:13: When Luqman said to his son, as he advised him, “O my son, do not associate anything with God, for idolatry is a terrible wrong.”
en.31:14: We have entrusted the human being with the care of his parents. His mother carried him through hardship upon hardship, weaning him in two years. So give thanks to Me, and to your parents. To Me is the destination.
en.31:15: But if they strive to have you associate with Me something of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. But keep them company in this life, in kindness, and follow the path of him who turns to Me. Then to Me is your return; and I will inform you of what you used to do.
en.31:16: “O my son, even if it were the weight of a mustard-seed, in a rock, or in the heavens, or on earth, God will bring it to light. God is Kind and Expert.
en.31:17: O my son, observe the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh), advocate righteousness, forbid evil, and be patient over what has befallen you. These are of the most honorable traits.
en.31:18: And do not treat people with arrogance, nor walk proudly on earth. God does not love the arrogant showoffs.
en.31:19: And moderate your stride, and lower your voice. The most repulsive of voices is the donkey’s voice.”
en.31:20: Do you not see how God placed at your service everything in the heavens and the earth? How He showered you with His blessings, both outward and inward? Yet among the people is he who argues about God without knowledge, without guidance, and without an enlightening Scripture.
en.31:21: And when it is said to them, “Follow what God has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we follow what we found our parents devoted to.” Even if the Adversary is calling them to the suffering of the Blaze?
en.31:22: Whoever submits himself wholly to God, and is a doer of good, has grasped the most trustworthy handle. With God rests the outcome of all events.
en.31:23: Whoever disbelieves—let not his disbelief sadden you. To Us is their return. Then We will inform them of what they did. God knows what lies within the hearts.
en.31:24: We give them a little comfort; then We compel them to a harsh torment.
en.31:25: And if you ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They will say, “God.” Say, “Praise be to God.” But most of them do not know.
en.31:26: To God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. God is the Rich, the Praised.
en.31:27: If all the trees on earth were pens, filled by the ocean, with seven more oceans besides, the Words of God would not run out. God is Majestic and Wise.
en.31:28: Your creation and your resurrection are only as a single soul. God is Hearing and Seeing.
en.31:29: Have you not seen how God merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night? That He subjected the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term? And that God is Cognizant of everything you do?
en.31:30: That is because God is the Reality, and what they worship besides Him is falsehood, and because God is the Exalted, the Supreme.
en.31:31: Have you not seen how the ships sail through the sea, by the grace of God, to show you of His wonders? In that are signs for every persevering, thankful person.
en.31:32: When waves, like canopies, cover them, they call upon God, devoting their religion to Him. But when He has delivered them to dry land, some of them waver. No one renounces Our revelations except the treacherous blasphemer.
en.31:33: O people! Be conscious of your Lord, and dread a Day when no parent can avail his child, nor can a child avail his parent, in anything. The promise of God is true. Therefore, do not let this life deceive you, nor let illusions deceive you regarding God.
en.31:34: With God rests the knowledge of the Hour. He sends down the rain, and He knows what the wombs contain. No soul knows what it will reap tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die. God is All-Knowing, Well-Informed.
en.32:2: The revelation of the Scripture, without a doubt, is from the Lord of the Universe.
en.32:3: Yet they say, “He made it up.” In fact, it is the Truth from your Lord, to warn a people who received no warner before you, that they may be guided.
en.32:4: God is He who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, and then established Himself on the Throne. Apart from Him, you have no master and no intercessor. Will you not reflect?
en.32:5: He regulates all affairs, from the heavens, to the earth. Then it ascends to Him on a Day the length of which is a thousand years by your count.
en.32:6: That is the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Powerful, the Merciful.
en.32:7: He who perfected everything He created, and originated the creation of man from clay.
en.32:8: Then made his reproduction from an extract of an insignificant fluid.
en.32:9: Then He proportioned him, and breathed into him of His Spirit. Then He gave you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the brains—but rarely do you give thanks.
en.32:10: And they say, “When we are lost into the earth, shall we be in a new creation?” In fact, they deny the meeting with their Lord.
en.32:11: Say, “The angel of death put in charge of you will reclaim you. Then to your Lord you will be returned.”
en.32:12: If only you could see the guilty, bowing their heads before their Lord: “Our Lord, we have seen and we have heard, so send us back, and we will act righteously; we are now convinced.”
en.32:13: Had We willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the declaration from Me will come true: “I will fill the Inferno with jinn and humans, altogether.”
en.32:14: So taste, because you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours; We have forgotten you; so taste the eternal torment for what you used to do.
en.32:15: They believe in Our communications, those who, when reminded of them, fall down prostrate, and glorify their Lord with praise, and are not proud.
en.32:16: Their sides shun their beds, as they pray to their Lord, out of reverence and hope; and from Our provisions to them, they give.
en.32:17: No soul knows what eye’s delight awaits them—a reward for what they used to do.
en.32:18: Is someone who is faithful like someone who is a sinner? They are not equal.
en.32:19: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them are the Gardens of Shelter—hospitality for what they used to do.
en.32:20: But as for those who transgressed, their shelter is the Fire. Every time they try to get out of it, they will be brought back into it, and it will be said to them, “Taste the suffering of the Fire which you used to deny.”
en.32:21: We will make them taste the lesser torment, prior to the greater torment, so that they may return.
en.32:22: Who is more wrong than he, who, when reminded of his Lord’s revelations, turns away from them? We will certainly wreak vengeance upon the criminals.
en.32:23: We gave Moses the Scripture; so do not be in doubt regarding His encounter; and We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel.
en.32:24: And We appointed leaders from among them, guiding by Our command, as long as they persevered and were certain of Our communications.
en.32:25: Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they had disputed.
en.32:26: Is it not a lesson for them, how many generations We have destroyed before them, in whose habitations they walk? Surely in that are signs. Do they not hear?
en.32:27: Do they not see how We conduct the water to a dry land, and with it We produce vegetation, from which their livestock eat, and themselves? Do they not see?
en.32:28: And they say, “When is this victory, if you are truthful?”
en.32:29: Say, “On the day of victory, the faith of those who disbelieved will be of no avail to them, and they will not be granted respite.”
en.32:30: So turn away from them, and wait. They too are waiting.
en.33:1: O messenger of God! Fear God, and do not obey the unbelievers and the the dissemblers. God is Knowledgeable and Wise.
en.33:2: And follow what is revealed to you from your Lord. God is fully aware of what you do.
en.33:3: And put your trust in God. God is enough as a trustee.
en.33:4: God did not place two hearts inside any man's body. Nor did He make your wives whom you equate with your mothers, your actual mothers. Nor did He make your adopted sons, your actual sons. These are your words coming out of your mouths. God speaks the truth, and guides to the path.
en.33:5: Call them after their fathers; that is more equitable with God. But if you do not know their fathers, then your brethren in faith and your friends. There is no blame on you if you err therein, barring what your hearts premeditates. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.33:6: The messenger of God is more caring of the believers than they are of themselves, and his wives are mothers to them. And blood-relatives are closer to one another in God’s Book than the believers or the emigrants, though you should do good to your friends. That is inscribed in the Scripture.
en.33:7: Recall that We received a pledge from the messengers of God, and from you, and from Noah, and Abraham, and Moses, and Jesus son of Mary. We received from them a solemn pledge.
en.33:8: That He may ask the sincere about their sincerity. He has prepared for the those who deny the truth a painful punishment.
en.33:9: O you who believe! Remember God’s blessings upon you, when forces came against you, and We sent against them a wind, and forces you did not see. God is Observant of what you do.
en.33:10: When they came upon you, from above you, and from beneath you; and the eyes became dazed, and the hearts reached the throats, and you harbored doubts about God.
en.33:11: There and then the believers were tested, and were shaken most severely.
en.33:12: When the the dissemblers and those in whose hearts is sickness said, “God and His Envoy promised us nothing but illusion.”
en.33:13: And when a group of them said, “O people of Yathrib, you cannot make a stand, so retreat.” And a faction of them asked the messenger of God to excuse them, saying, “Our homes are exposed,” although they were not exposed. They only wanted to flee.
en.33:14: Had it been invaded from its sides, and they were asked to dissent, they would have done so with little hesitation.
en.33:15: Although they had made a pledged to God, in the past, that they will not turn their backs. A pledge to God is a responsibility.
en.33:16: Say, “Flight will not benefit you, if you flee from death or killing, even then you will be given only brief enjoyment.”
en.33:17: Say, “Who is it who will shield you from God, if He intends adversity for you, or intends mercy for you?” Besides God, they will find for themselves neither friend nor helper.
en.33:18: God already knows the hinderers among you, and those who say to their brethren, “Come and join us.” Rarely do they mobilize for battle.
en.33:19: Being stingy towards you. And when fear approaches, you see them staring at you—their eyes rolling—like someone fainting at death. Then, when panic is over, they whip you with sharp tongues. They resent you any good. These have never believed, so God has nullified their works; a matter easy for God.
en.33:20: They assumed that the confederates had not withdrawn. But were the confederates to advance, they would wish they were in the desert with the Bedouins, inquiring about your news. And if they were among you, they would have done little fighting.
en.33:21: You have an excellent example in the Envoy of God; for anyone who seeks God and the Last Day, and remembers God frequently.
en.33:22: And when the believers saw the confederates, they said, “This is what God and His messenger have promised us; and God and His messenger have told the truth.” And it only increased them in faith and submission.
en.33:23: Of the believers are men who are true to what they pledged to God. Some of them have fulfilled their vows; and some are still waiting, and never wavering.
en.33:24: That God may reward the truthful for their truthfulness; and punish the the dissemblers, if He wills, or pardon them. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.33:25: God repelled the those who deny the truth in their rage; they gained no advantage. God thus spared the believers combat. God is Strong and Mighty.
en.33:26: And He brought down from their strongholds those of the People of the Scripture who backed them, and He threw terror into their hearts. Some of them you killed, and others you took captive.
en.33:27: And He made you inherit their land, and their homes, and their possessions, and a region you have never stepped on. God has power over all things.
en.33:28: O messenger of God! Say to your wives, “If you desire the life of this world and its finery, then let me compensate you, and release you kindly.
en.33:29: But if you desire God, His Envoy, and the Home of the Hereafter, then God has prepared for the virtuous among you a magnificent compensation.”
en.33:30: O wives of the messenger of God! Whoever of you commits a proven indecency, the punishment for her will be doubled. And that would be easy for God.
en.33:31: But whoever of you remains obedient to God and His Envoy, and acts righteously, We will give her a double reward; and We have prepared for her a generous provision.
en.33:32: O wives of the messenger of God! You are not like any other women, if you observe piety. So do not speak too softly, lest the sick at heart lusts after you, but speak in an appropriate manner.
en.33:33: And settle in your homes; and do not display yourselves, as in the former days of ignorance. And perform the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh), and give regular charity, and obey God and His Envoy. God desires to remove all impurity from you, O People of the Household, and to purify you thoroughly.
en.33:34: And remember what is recited in your homes of God's revelations and wisdom. God is Kind and Informed.
en.33:35: Muslim men and Muslim women, believing men and believing women, obedient men and obedient women, truthful men and truthful women, patient men and patient women, humble men and humble women, charitable men and charitable women, fasting men and fasting women, men who guard their chastity and women who guard, men who remember God frequently and women who remember—God has prepared for them a pardon, and an immense reward.
en.33:36: It is not for any believer, man or woman, when God and His Envoy have decided a matter, to have liberty of choice in their decision. Whoever disobeys God and His Envoy has gone far astray.
en.33:37: When you said to him whom God had blessed, and you had favored, “Keep your wife to yourself, and fear God.” But you hid within yourself what God was to reveal. And you feared the people, but it was God you were supposed to fear. Then, when Zaid ended his relationship with her, We gave her to you in marriage, that there may be no restriction for believers regarding the wives of their adopted sons, when their relationship has ended. The command of God was fulfilled.
en.33:38: There is no blame on the messenger of God regarding what God has ordained for him. Such is the pattern of God among those who passed before. The command of God is an absolute decree.
en.33:39: Those who deliver the messages of God, and fear Him, and never fear anyone except God. God is sufficient as a reckoner.
en.33:40: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men; but he is the Envoy of God, and the seal of the messengers of God. God is Cognizant of everything.
en.33:41: O you who believe, remember God with frequent remembrance.
en.33:42: And glorify Him morning and evening.
en.33:43: It is He who reaches out to you, and His angels, to bring you out of darkness into the light. And He is Ever-Merciful towards the believers.
en.33:44: Their greeting on the Day they meet Him is, “Peace,” and He has prepared for them a generous reward.
en.33:45: O messenger of God! We have sent you as a witness, and a bearer of good news, and a warner.
en.33:46: And a caller towards God by His leave, and an illuminating beacon.
en.33:47: And give the believers the good news that for them is a great reward.
en.33:48: And do not obey the blasphemers and the the dissemblers, and ignore their insults, and rely on God. God is a sufficient protector.
en.33:49: O you who believe! When you marry believing women, but then divorce them before you have touched them, there is no waiting period for you to observe in respect to them; but compensate them, and release them in a graceful manner.
en.33:50: O messenger of God! We have permitted to you your wives to whom you have given their dowries, and those you already have, as granted to you by God, and the daughters of your paternal uncle, and the daughters of your paternal aunts, and the daughters of your maternal uncle, and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you, and a believing woman who has offered herself to the messenger of God, if the messenger of God desires to marry her, exclusively for you, and not for the believers. We know what We have ordained for them regarding their wives and those their right-hands possess. This is to spare you any difficulty. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.33:51: You may defer any of them you wish, and receive any of them you wish. Should you desire any of those you had deferred, there is no blame on you. This is more proper, so that they will be comforted, and not be grieved, and be content with what you have given each one of them. God knows what is within your hearts. God is Omniscient and Clement.
en.33:52: Beyond that, no other women are permissible for you, nor can you exchange them for other wives, even if you admire their beauty, except those you already have. God is Watchful over all things.
en.33:53: O you who believe! Do not enter the homes of the messenger of God, unless you are given permission to come for a meal; and do not wait for its preparation. And when you are invited, go in. And when you have eaten, disperse, without lingering for conversation. This irritates the messenger of God, and he shies away from you, but God does not shy away from the truth. And when you ask his wives for something, ask them from behind a screen; that is purer for your hearts and their hearts. You must never offend the Envoy of God, nor must you ever marry his wives after him, for that would be an enormity with God.
en.33:54: Whether you declare a thing, or hide it, God is Aware of all things.
en.33:55: There is no blame on them concerning their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers’ sons, or their sisters’ sons, or their women, or their female servants. But they should remain conscious of God. God is Witness over all things.
en.33:56: God and His angels give blessings to the messenger of God. O you who believe, call for blessings on him, and greet him with a devotional prayer (Ṣalāh) of peace.
en.33:57: Those who insult God and His Envoy, God has cursed them in this life and in the Hereafter, and has prepared for them a demeaning punishment.
en.33:58: Those who harm believing men and believing women, for acts they did not commit, bear the burden of perjury and a flagrant sin.
en.33:59: O messenger of God! Tell your wives, and your daughters, and the women of the believers, to lengthen their garments. That is more proper, so they will be recognized and not harassed. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.33:60: If the the dissemblers, and those with sickness in their hearts, and the rumormongers in the City, do not desist, We will incite you against them; then they will not be your neighbors there except for a short while.
en.33:61: They are cursed; wherever they are found, they should be captured and killed outright.
en.33:62: Such has been God’s precedent with those who passed away before. You will find no change in God’s system.
en.33:63: The people ask you about the Hour. Say, “The knowledge thereof rests with God. But what do you know? Perhaps the hour is near.”
en.33:64: God has cursed the those who deny the truth, and has prepared for them a Blaze.
en.33:65: Dwelling therein forever, not finding a protector or a savior.
en.33:66: The Day when their faces are flipped into the Fire, they will say, “If only we had obeyed God and obeyed the Envoy.”
en.33:67: And they will say, “Lord, we have obeyed our superiors and our dignitaries, but they led us away from the way.
en.33:68: Lord, give them double the punishment, and curse them with a great curse.”
en.33:69: O you who believe! Do not be like those who abused Moses; but God cleared him of what they said. He was distinguished with God.
en.33:70: O you who believe! Be conscious of God, and speak in a straightforward manner.
en.33:71: He will rectify your conduct for you, and will forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys God and His Envoy has won a great victory.
en.33:72: We offered the Trust to the heavens, and the earth, and the mountains; but they refused to bear it, and were apprehensive of it; but the human being accepted it. He was unfair and ignorant.
en.33:73: God will punish the the dissemblers, men and women, and the idolaters, men and women. And God will redeem the believers, men and women. God is Ever-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
en.34:1: Praise be to God, to Whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; and praise be to Him in the Hereafter. He is the Wise, the Expert.
en.34:2: He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky, and what ascends to it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
en.34:3: Those who disbelieve say, “The Hour will not come upon us.” Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, it will come upon you. He is the Knower of the unseen.” Not an atom's weight in the heavens and the earth, or anything smaller or larger, escapes His knowledge. All are in a Clear Record.
en.34:4: That He may recompense those who believe and do good works. Those will have forgiveness, and a generous provision.
en.34:5: As for those who strive against Our revelations, seeking to undermine them—for them is a punishment of a painful plague.
en.34:6: Those who received knowledge know that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth; and it guides to the path of the Majestic, the Praiseworthy.
en.34:7: Those who disbelieved said, “Shall we point out to you a man, who will tell you that, once torn into shreds, you will be in a new creation?
en.34:8: Did he invent a lie about God, or is there madness in him?” Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are in torment, and far astray.
en.34:9: Do they not reflect upon what lies before them and behind them, of the heaven and the earth? If We will, We can make the earth cave in beneath them, or make pieces of the sky fall down on them. In that is a sign for every devout servant.
en.34:10: We bestowed upon David favor from Us: “O mountains, and birds: echo with him.” And We softened iron for him.
en.34:11: “Make coats of armor, and measure the links well; and work righteousness. I am Observant of everything you do.”
en.34:12: And for Solomon the wind—its outward journey was one month, and its return journey was one month. And We made a spring of tar flow for him. And there were sprites that worked under him, by the leave of his Lord. But whoever of them swerved from Our command, We make him taste of the punishment of the Inferno.
en.34:13: They made for him whatever he wished: sanctuaries, statues, bowls like pools, and heavy cauldrons. “O House of David, work with appreciation,” but a few of My servants are appreciative.
en.34:14: Then, when We decreed death for him, nothing indicated his death to them except an earthworm eating at his staff. Then, when he fell down, it became clear to the sprites that, had they known the unseen, they would not have remained in the demeaning torment.
en.34:15: In Sheba’s homeland there used to be a wonder: two gardens, on the right, and on the left. “Eat of your Lord’s provision, and give thanks to Him.” A good land, and a forgiving Lord.
en.34:16: But they turned away, so We unleashed against them the flood of the dam; and We substituted their two gardens with two gardens of bitter fruits, thorny shrubs, and meager harvest.
en.34:17: We thus penalized them for their ingratitude. Would We penalize any but the ungrateful?
en.34:18: Between them and the towns We had blessed, We placed prominent towns, and We made the travel between them easy. “Travel between them by night and day, in safety.”
en.34:19: But they said, “Our Lord, lengthen the distances of our journeys.” They wronged themselves; so We made them history, and We scattered them in every direction. In this are lessons for every steadfast and appreciative person.
en.34:20: the Adversary was correct in his assessment of them. They followed him, except for a group of believers.
en.34:21: He had no authority over them; except that We willed to distinguish him who believes in the Hereafter, from him who is doubtful about it. Your Lord is Guardian over all things.
en.34:22: Say, “Call upon those whom you claim besides God. They possess not an atom's weight in the heavens or the earth, and they possess no share of either, and He has no backers from among them.”
en.34:23: Intercession with Him is of no value, except for someone He has permitted. Until, when fear has subsided from their hearts, they will say, “What did your Lord say?” They will say, “The truth, and He is the High, the Great.”
en.34:24: Say, “Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “God. And Either you, or we, are rightly guided, or in evident error.”
en.34:25: Say, “You will not be asked about our misdeeds, nor will we be asked about what you do.”
en.34:26: Say, “Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us equitably. He is the All-Knowing Judge.”
en.34:27: Say, “Show me those you have attached to Him as associates. No indeed! But He is God, the Powerful, the Wise.”
en.34:28: We sent you only universally to all people, a herald and warner, but most people do not know.
en.34:29: And they say, “When is this promise due, if you are truthful?”
en.34:30: Say, “You are promised a Day, which you cannot postpone by one hour, nor bring forward.”
en.34:31: Those who disbelieve say, “We will never believe in this Quran, nor in what came before it.” If you could only see the evildoers, captive before their Lord, throwing back allegations at one another. Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, “Were it not for you, we would have been believers.”
en.34:32: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, “Was it us who turned you away from guidance when it came to you? No indeed, you yourselves were sinful.”
en.34:33: And those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, “It was your scheming by night and day; as you instructed us to reject God, and to set up rivals to Him.” They will hide their remorse when they see the retribution. We will put yokes around the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be repaid for anything other than what they used to do?
en.34:34: We sent no warner to any town, without its affluent saying, “We reject what you are sent with.”
en.34:35: And they say, “We have more wealth and more children, and we will not be punished.”
en.34:36: Say, “My Lord spreads out His bounty to whomever He wills, or restricts it; but most people do not know.”
en.34:37: It is neither your wealth nor your children that bring you closer to Us, but it is he who believes and does good deeds. These will have a double reward for what they did; and they will reside in the Chambers, in peace and security.
en.34:38: But those who work against Our revelations, seeking to undermine them—those will be summoned to the punishment.
en.34:39: Say, “My Lord extends the provision to whomever He wills of His servants, or withholds it. Anything you spend, He will replace it. He is the Best of providers.”
en.34:40: On the Day when He gathers them all together, then say to the divine messengers, “Was it you these used to worship?”
en.34:41: They will say, “Be You glorified; You are our Master, not them. In fact, they used to worship the jinn, and most of them had faith in them.”
en.34:42: “Today, none of you has the power to profit or harm the other.” And We will say to those who did wrong, “Taste the agony of the Fire which you used to deny.”
en.34:43: And when Our enlightening Verses are recited to them, they say, “This is nothing but a man who wants to divert you from what your ancestors used to worship.” And they say, “This is nothing but a fabricated lie.” And when the Truth comes to them, the blasphemers say of the Truth, “This is nothing but plain magic.”
en.34:44: But We gave them no book to study, and We did not send them any warner before you.
en.34:45: Those before them also denied the Truth, yet they have not attained one-tenth of what We had given them. They rejected My messengers, so how was My disapproval?
en.34:46: Say, “I offer you a single advice: devote yourselves to God, in pairs, or individually; and reflect. There is no madness in your friend. He is just a warner to you, before the advent of a severe punishment.”
en.34:47: Say, “Whatever compensation I have asked of you, is yours. My compensation comes only from God, and He is Witness over all things.”
en.34:48: Say, “My Lord projects the truth. He is the Knower of the Unseen.”
en.34:49: Say, “The Truth has come; while falsehood can neither originate, nor regenerate.”
en.34:50: Say, “If I err, I err only to my own loss; but if I am guided, it is by what my Lord inspires me. He is Hearing and Near.”
en.34:51: If you could only see when they are terrified, and there is no escape, and they are seized from a nearby place.
en.34:52: And they say, “We have believed in it.” But how can they attain it from a distant place?
en.34:53: They have rejected it in the past, and made allegations from a far-off place.
en.34:54: A barrier will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done formerly with their counterparts. They were in disturbing doubt.
en.35:1: Praise be to God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Maker of the divine messengers messengers with wings—double, triple, and quadruple. He adds to creation as He wills. God is Able to do all things.
en.35:2: Whatever mercy God unfolds for the people, none can withhold it. And if He withholds it, none can release it thereafter. He is the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
en.35:3: O people! Remember God’s blessings upon you. Is there a creator other than God who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no god but He. So how are you misled?
en.35:4: If they reject you, messengers before you were also rejected. To God all matters are returned.
en.35:5: O people! The promise of God is true; so let not the lowly life seduce you, and let not the Tempter tempt you away from God.
en.35:6: the Adversary is an enemy to you, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his gang to be among the inmates of the Inferno.
en.35:7: Those who disbelieve will suffer a harsh punishment, but those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and a great reward.
en.35:8: What of him whose evil deed was made attractive to him, and so he regards it as good? God leads astray whomever He wills, and He guides whomever He wills. Therefore, do not waste yourself sorrowing over them. God knows exactly what they do.
en.35:9: God is He who sends the winds, which agitate clouds, which We drive to a dead land, and thereby revive the ground after it had died. Likewise is the Resurrection.
en.35:10: Whoever desires honor—all honor belongs to God. To Him ascends speech that is pure, and He elevates righteous conduct. As for those who plot evil, a terrible punishment awaits them, and the planning of these will fail.
en.35:11: God created you from dust, then from a small drop; then He made you pairs. No female conceives, or delivers, except with His knowledge. No living thing advances in years, or its life is shortened, except it be in a Record. That is surely easy for God.
en.35:12: The two seas are not the same. One is fresh, sweet, good to drink, while the other is salty and bitter. Yet from each you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through them, so that you may seek of His bounty, so that you may give thanks.
en.35:13: He merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night; and He regulates the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term. Such is God, your Lord; His is the sovereignty. As for those you call upon besides Him, they do not possess a speck.
en.35:14: If you pray to them, they cannot hear your devotional prayer (Ṣalāh). And even if they heard, they would not answer you. And on the Day of Resurrection, they will reject your partnership. None informs you like an Expert.
en.35:15: O people! It is you who are the poor, in need of God; while God is the Rich, the Praiseworthy.
en.35:16: If He wills, He can do away with you, and produce a new creation.
en.35:17: And that would not be difficult for God.
en.35:18: No burdened soul can carry the burden of another. Even if one weighted down calls for help with its burden, nothing can be lifted from it, even if they were related. You are to warn those who fear their Lord inwardly, and perform the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh). He who purifies himself purifies himself for his own good. To God is the ultimate return.
en.35:19: Not equal are the blind and the seeing.
en.35:20: Nor are the darkness and the light.
en.35:21: Nor are the shade and the torrid heat.
en.35:22: Nor are equal the living and the dead. God causes whomever He wills to hear, but you cannot make those in the graves hear.
en.35:24: We sent you with the truth; a bearer of good news, and a warner. There is no community but a warner has passed through it.
en.35:25: If they disbelieve you, those before them also disbelieved. Their messengers came to them with the clear proofs, with the Psalms, and with the Enlightening Scripture.
en.35:26: Then I seized those who disbelieved—so how was My rejection?
en.35:27: Have you not seen that God sends down water from the sky? With it We produce fruits of various colors. And in the mountains are streaks of white and red—varying in their hue—and pitch-black.
en.35:28: Likewise, human beings, animals, and livestock come in various colors. From among His servants, the learned fear God. God is Almighty, Oft-Forgiving.
en.35:29: Those who recite the Scripture of God, and perform the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh), and spend of what We have provided for them, secretly and publicly, expect a trade that will not fail.
en.35:30: He will pay them their dues in full, and will increase them from His bounty. He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
en.35:31: What We inspired in you, of the Scripture, is the truth, confirming what preceded it. God is Well-Informed of His servants, All-Seeing.
en.35:32: Then We passed the Scripture to those of Our servants whom We chose. Some of them wrong their souls, and some follow a middle course, and some are in the foremost in good deeds by God’s leave; that is the greatest blessing.
en.35:33: The Gardens of Eden, which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with gold bracelets and pearls, and their garments therein will be of silk.
en.35:34: And they will say, “Praise God, who has lifted all sorrow from us. Our Lord is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative.
en.35:35: He Who settled us in the Home of Permanence, by His grace, where boredom will not touch us, and fatigue will not afflict us.”
en.35:36: As for those who disbelieve, for them is the Fire of the Inferno, wherein they will never be finished off and die, nor will its punishment be lightened for them. Thus We will repay every ingrate.
en.35:37: And they will scream therein, “Our Lord, let us out, and we will act righteously, differently from the way we used to act.” Did We not give you a life long enough, in which anyone who wanted to understand would have understood? And the warner did come to you. So taste. The evildoers will have no helper.
en.35:38: God is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He knows what the hearts contain.
en.35:39: It is He who made you successors on earth. Whoever disbelieves, his disbelief will recoil upon him. The disbelief of the those who deny the truth adds only to their Lord's disfavor of them. The disbelief of the those who deny the truth adds only to their perdition.
en.35:40: Say, “Have you considered those partners of yours that you worship instead of God? Show me what they have created on earth. Or do they have any share in the heavens?” Or have We given them a book whose clear teachings they follow? In fact, the evildoers promise one another nothing but delusions.
en.35:41: God holds the heavens and the earth, lest they fall apart. And were they to fall apart, there is none to hold them together except He. He is Most Clement, Most Forgiving.
en.35:42: And they swore by God with their solemn oaths, that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any other people. Yet when a warner came to them, it only increased them in aversion.
en.35:43: Priding themselves on earth, and scheming evil. But evil scheming overwhelms none but its authors. Do they expect anything but the precedent of the ancients? You will not find any change in God’s practice, and you will not find any substitute to God’s practice.
en.35:44: Have they not journeyed in the land and observed the fate of those who preceded them? They were superior to them in strength. But nothing can defeat God in the heavens or on Earth. He is indeed Omniscient and Omnipotent.
en.35:45: If God were to punish the people for what they have earned, He would not leave a single living creature on its surface. But He defers them until a stated time. Then, when their time has arrived—God is Observant of His creatures.
en.36:3: You are one of the messengers.
en.36:5: The revelation of the Almighty, the Merciful.
en.36:6: To warn a people whose ancestors were not warned, and so they are unaware.
en.36:7: The Word was realized against most of them, for they do not believe.
en.36:8: We placed shackles around their necks, up to their chins, so they are stiff-necked.
en.36:9: And We placed a barrier in front of them, and a barrier behind them, and We have enshrouded them, so they cannot see.
en.36:10: It is the same for them, whether you warn them, or do not warn them—they will not believe.
en.36:11: You warn only him who follows the Message, and fears the Most Gracious inwardly. So give him good news of forgiveness, and a generous reward.
en.36:12: It is We who revive the dead; and We write down what they have forwarded, and their traces. We have tallied all things in a Clear Record.
en.36:13: And cite for them the parable of the landlords of the town—when the messengers came to it.
en.36:14: We sent them two messengers, but they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third. They said, “We are messengers to you.”
en.36:15: They said, “You are nothing but humans like us, and the Gracious did not send down anything; you are only lying.”
en.36:16: They said, “Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you.
en.36:17: And our only duty is clear communication.”
en.36:18: They said, “We see an evil omen in you; if you do not give up, we will stone you, and a painful punishment from us will befall you.”
en.36:19: They said, “Your evil omen is upon you. Is it because you were reminded? But you are an extravagant people.”
en.36:20: Then a man came running from the remotest part of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the messengers.
en.36:21: Follow those who ask you of no wage, and are themselves guided.
en.36:22: “And why should I not worship Him Who created me, and to Whom you will be returned?
en.36:23: Shall I take other gods instead of Him? If the Merciful desires harm for me, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor will they save me.
en.36:24: In that case, I would be completely lost.
en.36:25: I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.”
en.36:26: It was said, “Enter the eternal Gardens.” He said, “If only my people knew.
en.36:27: How my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honored.”
en.36:28: After him, We sent down no hosts from heaven to his people; nor would We ever send any down.
en.36:29: It was just one Cry, and they were stilled.
en.36:30: Alas for the servants. No messenger ever came to them, but they ridiculed him.
en.36:31: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them; and that unto them they will not return?
en.36:32: All of them, every single one of them, will be arraigned before Us.
en.36:33: And there is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life, and produce from it grains from which they eat.
en.36:34: And We place in it gardens of palm-trees and vines, and cause springs to gush out of it.
en.36:35: That they may eat from its fruits, although their hands did not make it. Will they not be appreciative?
en.36:36: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs; of what the earth produces, and of their own selves, and of what they do not know.
en.36:37: Another sign for them is the night: We strip the day out of it—and they are in darkness.
en.36:38: And the sun runs towards its destination. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
en.36:39: And the moon: We have disposed it in phases, until it returns like the old twig.
en.36:40: The sun is not to overtake the moon, nor is the night to outpace the day. Each floats in an orbit.
en.36:41: Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden Ark.
en.36:42: And We created for them the like of it, in which they ride.
en.36:43: If We will, We can drown them—with no screaming to be heard from them, nor will they be saved.
en.36:44: Except by a mercy from Us, and enjoyment for a while.
en.36:45: Yet when it is said to them, “Beware of what lies before you, and what lies behind you, that you may receive mercy.”
en.36:46: Yet never came to them a sign of their Lord’s signs, but they turned away from it.
en.36:47: And when it is said to them, “Spend of what God has provided for you,” those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Shall we feed someone whom God could feed, if He so willed? You must be deeply misguided.”
en.36:48: And they say, “When will this promise be, if you are truthful?”
en.36:49: All they can expect is a single blast, which will seize them while they feud.
en.36:50: They will not be able to make a will, nor will they return to their families.
en.36:51: The Trumpet will be blown, then behold, they will rush from the tombs to their Lord.
en.36:52: They will say, “Woe to us! Who resurrected us from our resting-place?” This is what the Most Gracious had promised, and the messengers have spoken the truth.”
en.36:53: It will be but a single scream; and behold, they will all be brought before Us.
en.36:54: On that Day, no soul will be wronged in the least, and you will be recompensed only for what you used to do.
en.36:55: The inhabitants of the eternal Gardens, on that Day, will be happily busy.
en.36:56: They and their spouses, in shades, reclining on couches.
en.36:57: They will have therein fruits. They will have whatever they call for.
en.36:58: Peace—a saying from a Most Merciful Lord.
en.36:59: But step aside today, you criminals.
en.36:60: Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not serve the devil? That he is your sworn enemy?
en.36:61: And that you shall serve Me? This is a straight path.
en.36:62: He has misled a great multitude of you. Did you not understand?
en.36:63: This is Hellfire, which you were promised.
en.36:64: Roast in it today, because you persistently disbelieved.
en.36:65: On this Day, We will seal their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to everything they had done.
en.36:66: If We will, We can blind their eyes as they rush towards the path—but how will they see?
en.36:67: And if We will, We can cripple them in their place; so they can neither move forward, nor go back.
en.36:68: Whomever We grant old age, We reverse his development. Do they not understand?
en.36:69: We did not teach him poetry, nor is it proper for him. It is only a reminder, and a Clear Quran.
en.36:70: That he may warn whoever is alive, and prove the Word against the faithless.
en.36:71: Have they not seen that We created for them, of Our Handiwork, livestock that they own?
en.36:72: And We subdued them for them. Some they ride, and some they eat.
en.36:73: And they have in them other benefits, and drinks. Will they not give thanks?
en.36:74: Yet they have taken to themselves gods other than God, that perhaps they may be helped.
en.36:75: They cannot help them, although they are arrayed as troops for them.
en.36:76: So let their words not sadden you. We know what they conceal, and what they reveal.
en.36:77: Does the human being not consider that We created him from a seed? Yet he becomes a fierce adversary.
en.36:78: And he produces arguments against Us, and he forgets his own creation. He says, “Who will revive the bones when they have decayed?”
en.36:79: Say, “He who initiated them in the first instance will revive them. He has knowledge of every creation.”
en.36:80: He who produced fuel for you from the green trees, with which you kindle a fire.
en.36:81: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Certainly. He is the Supreme All-Knowing Creator.
en.36:82: His command, when He wills a thing, is to say to it, “Be,” and it comes to be.
en.36:83: So glory be to Him in whose hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will be returned.
en.37:3: And the reciters of the Reminder.
en.37:5: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; and Lord of the Easts.
en.37:6: We have adorned the lower heaven with the beauty of the planets.
en.37:7: And guarded it against every defiant devil.
en.37:8: They cannot eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite, for they get bombarded from every side.
en.37:9: Repelled—they will have a lingering torment.
en.37:10: Except for him who snatches a fragment—he gets pursued by a piercing projectile.
en.37:11: Inquire of them, “Are they more difficult to create, or the others We created?” We created them from sticky clay.
en.37:12: But you wonder, and they ridicule.
en.37:13: And when reminded, they pay no attention.
en.37:14: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
en.37:15: And they say, “This is nothing but plain magic.
en.37:16: When we have died and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?
en.37:18: Say, “Yes indeed, and you will be totally subdued.”
en.37:19: It will be a single nudge, and they will be staring.
en.37:20: They will say, “Woe to us. This is the Day of Judgment.”
en.37:21: “This is the Day of Separation which you used to deny.
en.37:22: Gather those who did wrong, and their mates, and what they used to worship.
en.37:23: Besides God, and lead them to the way to the Inferno.
en.37:24: And stop them. They are to be questioned.”
en.37:25: What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another?
en.37:26: In fact, on that Day, they will be submissive.
en.37:27: They will come to one another, questioning one another.
en.37:28: They will say, “You used to come at us from the right.”
en.37:29: They will say, “You yourselves were not believers.
en.37:30: We had no authority over you. You yourselves were rebellious people.
en.37:31: The Word of our Lord has been realized against us. We are tasting it.
en.37:32: We seduced you. We were seducers.”
en.37:33: On that Day, they will share in the punishment.
en.37:34: Thus We deal with the sinners.
en.37:35: When it was said to them, “There is no god except God,” they grew arrogant.
en.37:36: And said, “Are we to abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
en.37:37: In fact, he came with the truth, and he confirmed the messengers.
en.37:38: Most assuredly, you will taste the painful punishment.
en.37:39: And you will be repaid only for what you used to do.
en.37:41: For them is a known provision.
en.37:42: Fruits; and they will be honored.
en.37:45: They will be offered a cup of pure drink.
en.37:46: White; a delight to those who drink.
en.37:48: With them will be bashful women with lovely eyes.
en.37:49: As if they were closely guarded pearls.
en.37:50: Then they will approach one another, questioning.
en.37:51: One of them will say, “I used to have a friend.
en.37:52: Who used to say, “Are you of those who believe?
en.37:53: That after we die and become dust and bones, we will be called to account?”
en.37:54: He will say, “Will you have a look?”
en.37:55: He will look, and will see him in the pit of the Inferno.
en.37:56: He will say, “By God, you almost ruined me.
en.37:57: Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among the arraigned.”
en.37:59: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished.”
en.37:61: For the like of this let the workers work.
en.37:62: Is this a better hospitality, or the Tree of Bitterness?
en.37:63: We made it an ordeal for the unjust.
en.37:64: It is a tree that grows from the bottom of the Inferno.
en.37:65: Its fruits are like the devils’ heads.
en.37:66: They will eat from it, and fill their bellies with it.
en.37:67: Then, on top of it, they will have a brew of boiling liquid.
en.37:68: Then their return will be to the Blaze.
en.37:69: They had found their parents astray.
en.37:70: And rushed along in their footsteps.
en.37:71: And most of the ancients before them went astray.
en.37:72: Even though We sent messengers to warn them.
en.37:73: So observe the end of those who were warned.
en.37:74: Except for the sincere servants of God.
en.37:75: And Noah called out to Us, and We are the Best of responders.
en.37:76: And We saved him and his family from the great calamity.
en.37:77: And We made his descendants the survivors.
en.37:78: And We left mention of him among those who succeeded.
en.37:79: Peace be upon Noah among all people.
en.37:81: He was one of Our believing servants.
en.37:84: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart.
en.37:85: He said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?
en.37:86: Is it falsified gods, instead of God, that you want?
en.37:87: So what is your opinion about the Lord of the Worlds?”
en.37:88: Then he took a glance at the stars.
en.37:90: But they turned their backs on him, and went away.
en.37:91: Then he turned to their gods, and said, “will you not eat?
en.37:92: What is it with you, that you do not speak?”
en.37:93: Then he turned on them, striking with his right hand.
en.37:94: And they came running towards him.
en.37:95: He said, “Do you worship what you carve?
en.37:96: When God created you, and what you manufacture?”
en.37:97: They said, “Build a pyre for him, and throw him into the furnace.”
en.37:98: They wished him ill, but We made them the losers.
en.37:99: He said, “I am going towards my Lord, and He will guide me.”
en.37:100: “My Lord, give me one of the virtuous.”
en.37:101: So We gave him good news of a clement boy.
en.37:102: Then, when he was old enough to accompany him, he said, “O My son, I see in a dream that I am sacrificing you; see what you think.” He said, “O my Father, do as you are commanded; you will find me, God willing, one of the steadfast.”
en.37:103: Then, when they had submitted, and he put his forehead down.
en.37:104: We called out to him, “O Abraham!
en.37:105: You have fulfilled the vision.” Thus We reward the doers of good.
en.37:106: This was certainly an evident test.
en.37:107: And We redeemed him with a great sacrifice.
en.37:108: And We left with him for later generations.
en.37:110: Thus We reward the doers of good.
en.37:111: He was one of Our believing servants.
en.37:112: And We gave him good news of Isaac, a messenger of God, one of the virtuous.
en.37:113: And We blessed him, and Isaac. But among their descendants are some who are righteous, and some who are clearly unjust to themselves.
en.37:114: And We blessed Moses and Aaron.
en.37:115: And We delivered them and their people from the terrible disaster.
en.37:116: And We supported them, and so they were the victors.
en.37:117: And We gave them the Clarifying Scripture.
en.37:118: And We guided them upon the straight path.
en.37:119: And We left with them for later generations.
en.37:120: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
en.37:122: They were of Our believing servants.
en.37:123: Also Elijah was one of the messengers.
en.37:124: He said to his people, “Do you not fear?
en.37:125: Do you call on Baal, and forsake the Best of creators?
en.37:126: God is your Lord, and the Lord of your ancestors.”
en.37:127: But they called him a liar, and thus they will be brought forward.
en.37:129: And We left with him for later generations.
en.37:130: Peace be upon the House of Elijah.
en.37:132: He was one of Our believing servants.
en.37:133: And Lot was one of the messengers.
en.37:134: We saved him and his family, all of them.
en.37:135: Except for an old woman who lagged behind.
en.37:137: You pass by them in the morning.
en.37:138: And at night. Do you not understand?
en.37:139: And Jonah was one of the messengers.
en.37:140: When he fled to the laden boat.
en.37:142: Then the fish swallowed him, and he was to blame.
en.37:143: Had he not been one of those who praised.
en.37:144: He would have stayed in its belly until the Day they are raised.
en.37:145: Then We threw him into the wilderness, and he was sick.
en.37:146: And We made a gourd tree grow over him.
en.37:147: Then We sent him to a hundred thousand, or more.
en.37:148: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment for a while.
en.37:149: Ask them, “Are the daughters for your Lord, while for them the sons?”
en.37:150: Or did We create the divine messengers females, as they witnessed?”
en.37:151: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say.
en.37:152: “God has begotten.” They are indeed lying.
en.37:153: So He preferred girls over boys?
en.37:154: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
en.37:156: Or do you have some clear proof?
en.37:157: Then bring your book, if you are telling the truth.
en.37:158: And they invented a relationship between Him and the jinn. But the jinn know that they will be arraigned.
en.37:159: God be glorified, far above what they allege.
en.37:161: Surely, you and what you serve.
en.37:163: Except for he who will be roasting in the Inferno.
en.37:164: “There is not one of us but has an assigned position.
en.37:167: Even though they used to say.
en.37:168: “Had we received advice from the ancients.
en.37:169: We would have been God's faithful servants.”
en.37:170: But they rejected it, so they will find out.
en.37:171: Our Word has already gone out to our servant messengers.
en.37:172: It is they who will be supported.
en.37:173: And Our troops will be the victors.
en.37:174: So disregard them for a while.
en.37:175: And watch them—they will soon see.
en.37:176: Are they seeking to hasten Our punishment?
en.37:177: When it descends into their yard, miserable will be the morning of those forewarned.
en.37:178: So avoid them for a while.
en.37:180: Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, beyond their allegations.
en.37:181: And peace be upon the messengers.
en.37:182: And praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
en.38:2: Those who disbelieve are steeped in arrogance and defiance.
en.38:3: How many generations have We destroyed before them? They cried out when it was too late to escape.
en.38:4: And they marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The those who deny the truth said, “This is a lying magician.”
en.38:5: “Did he turn all the gods into one God? This is something strange.”
en.38:6: The notables among them announced: “Go on, and hold fast to your gods. This is something planned.
en.38:7: We never heard of this in the former faith. This is nothing but a fabrication.
en.38:8: Was the message sent down to him, out of all of us?” In fact, they are doubtful of My warning. In fact, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
en.38:9: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Majestic, the Giver?
en.38:10: Or do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend the ropes.
en.38:11: An army of confederates with be defeated there.
en.38:12: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth; as did Aad, and Pharaoh of the Stakes.
en.38:13: And Thamood, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Woods—these were the confederates.
en.38:14: None of them but denied the messengers, so My retribution was deserved.
en.38:15: These can expect only a single scream, from which there is no recovery.
en.38:16: And they say, “Our Lord, hasten Your writ upon us, before the Day of Account.”
en.38:17: Be patient in the face of what they say, and mention Our servant David, the resourceful. He was obedient.
en.38:18: We committed the mountains to glorify with him, in the evening and at daybreak.
en.38:19: And the birds, gathered together. All obedient to him.
en.38:20: And We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
en.38:21: Has the story of the two disputants reached you? When they scaled the sanctuary?
en.38:22: When they entered upon David, and he was startled by them. They said, “Do not fear. Two disputants; one of us has wronged the other; so judge between us fairly, and do not be biased, and guide us to the straight way.”
en.38:23: “This brother of mine has ninety nine ewes, and I have one ewe, and he said, ‘Entrust it to me,’ and he pressured me with words.”
en.38:24: He said, “He has done you wrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes. Many partners take advantage of one another, except those who believe and do good deeds, but these are so few.” David realized that We were testing him, so he sought forgiveness from his Lord, and fell down to his knees, and repented.
en.38:25: So We forgave him that. And for him is nearness to Us, and a good place of return.
en.38:26: “O David, We made you a ruler in the land, so judge between the people with justice, and do not follow desire, lest it diverts you from God’s path. Those who stray from God’s path will have a painful punishment, for having ignored the Day of Account.”
en.38:27: We did not create the heaven and the earth and everything between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve—so woe to those who disbelieve because of the Fire.
en.38:28: Or are We to treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like those who make trouble on earth? Or are We to treat the God-conscious like the shameless?
en.38:29: A blessed Book that We sent down to you, that they may ponder its Verses, and for those with intelligence to take heed.
en.38:30: And We granted David, Solomon, an excellent servant. He was penitent.
en.38:31: When the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening.
en.38:32: He said, “I have preferred the love of niceties to the remembrance of my Lord—until it disappeared behind the veil.
en.38:33: Bring them back to me.” And he began caressing their legs and necks.
en.38:34: We tested Solomon, and placed a body on his throne; then he repented.
en.38:35: He said, “My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingdom never to be attained by anyone after me. You are the Giver.”
en.38:36: So We placed the wind at his service, blowing gently by his command, wherever he directed.
en.38:37: And the demons—every builder and diver.
en.38:39: “This is Our gift; so give generously, or withhold; without account.”
en.38:40: For him is nearness to Us, and a beautiful resort.
en.38:41: And mention Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, “the Adversary has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”
en.38:42: “Stamp with your foot—here is cool water to wash with, and to drink.”
en.38:43: And We restored his family for him, and their like with them; as a mercy from Us, and a lesson for those who possess insight.
en.38:44: “Take with your hand a bundle, and strike with it, and do not break your oath.” We found him patient. What an excellent servant! He was obedient.
en.38:45: And mention Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—endowed with ability and vision.
en.38:46: We distinguished them with a distinct quality: the remembrance of the Home.
en.38:47: To Us they are among the chosen, the outstanding.
en.38:48: And mention Ishmael, Elisha, and Ezekiel; all are among the outstanding.
en.38:49: This is a reminder. The devout will have a good place of return.
en.38:50: The Gardens of Eden, with their doors wide-open for them.
en.38:51: Relaxing therein, and calling for abundant fruit and beverage.
en.38:52: With them will be attendants with modest gaze, of same age.
en.38:53: This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.
en.38:55: All This. But the transgressors will have a miserable return.
en.38:56: the Inferno; in which they will roast; what a miserable abode!
en.38:57: All this. Let them taste it—boiling and bitter cold.
en.38:58: And similar torments of diverse kinds.
en.38:59: “This is a crowd rushing headlong with you.” There is no welcome for them. They will be scorched by the Fire.
en.38:60: They will say, “But it is you! There is no welcome for you! It is you who brought it upon us! What a miserable end!”
en.38:61: They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, give him double torment in the Fire.”
en.38:62: And they will say, “What is it with us that we do not see men we used to count among the wicked?
en.38:63: Did we take them for mockery, or have our eyes swerved from them?
en.38:64: This is certainly true—the feuding of the people of the Fire.
en.38:65: Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god except God—the One, the Conqueror.
en.38:66: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Mighty, the Forgiver.”
en.38:67: Say, “It is a message of great importance.
en.38:68: From which you are turning away.
en.38:69: I have no knowledge of the Highest Assembly as they dispute.
en.38:70: It is only revealed to me that I am a clear warner.”
en.38:71: Your Lord said to the divine messengers, “I am creating a human being from clay.
en.38:72: When I have formed him, and breathed into him of My spirit, fall prostrate before him.
en.38:73: So the divine messengers fell prostrate, all of them.
en.38:74: Except for the Adversary. He was too proud, and one of the faithless.
en.38:75: He said, “O the Adversary, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My Own hands? Are you too proud, or were you one of the exalted?”
en.38:76: He said, “I am better than he; You created me from fire, and You created him from clay.”
en.38:77: He said, “Then get out of here! You are an outcast!
en.38:78: And My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”
en.38:79: He said, “Lord, defer me until the Day they are resurrected.”
en.38:80: He said, “You are one of those deferred.
en.38:81: Until the Day of the Time Appointed.”
en.38:82: He said, “By Your majesty, I will seduce them all.
en.38:83: Except for your loyal servants among them.”
en.38:84: He said, “The truth is, and I say the truth.
en.38:85: I will fill the Inferno with you, and with every one of them who follows you.”
en.38:86: Say, “I ask of you no wage for this, and I am not a pretender.
en.38:87: It is but a reminder to mankind.
en.38:88: And you will know its message after a while.”
en.39:1: The revelation of the Scripture is from God, the Mighty and Wise.
en.39:2: We sent down to you the Scripture with the truth, so serve God, devoting your religion to Him.
en.39:3: Is not to God that sincere faith is due? As for those who take guardians besides Him, “We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to God.” God will judge between them regarding their differences. God does not guide the lying blasphemer.
en.39:4: If God wanted to have a son, He could have selected from His creation at will. Glory be to Him. He is God, the One, the Prevailing.
en.39:5: He created the heavens and the earth with reason. He wraps the night around the day, and He wraps the day around the night. And He regulates the sun and the moon, each running along a specific course. He is indeed the Almighty, the Forgiver.
en.39:6: He created you from one person, then made from it its mate, and brought down livestock for you—eight kinds in pairs. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, in successive formations, in a triple darkness. Such is God, your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god but He. So what made you deviate?
en.39:7: If you disbelieve, God is Independent of you, yet He does not approve ingratitude on the part of His servants. And if you are thankful, He will approve that in you. No bearer of burden can bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return; and He will inform you of what you used to do. He is aware of what the hearts contain.
en.39:8: When some adversity touches the human being, he prays to his Lord, repenting to Him. But then, when He confers on him a grace of His, he forgets what he was praying for before, and he attributes rivals to God, in order to lead astray from His way. Say, “Enjoy your disbelief for a little while; you will be among the inmates of the Fire.”
en.39:9: Is he who worships devoutly during the watches of the night, prostrating himself and standing up, mindful of the Hereafter, and placing his hope in the mercy of his Lord? Say, “Are those who know and those who do not know equal?” Only those possessed of reason will remember.
en.39:10: Say, “O My devotees who have believed, keep your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world, is goodness. And God’s earth is vast. The steadfast will be paid their wages in full, without reckoning.”
en.39:11: Say, “I was commanded to serve God, devoting my religion exclusively to Him.
en.39:12: And I was commanded to be the first of those who submit.”
en.39:13: Say, “I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the punishment of a horrendous Day.”
en.39:14: Say, “It is God I worship, sincere in my faith in Him.”
en.39:15: “But you can worship whatever you wish besides Him.” Say, “The losers are those who lose their souls and their people on the Day of Resurrection.” That is indeed the obvious loss.
en.39:16: They will have layers of Fire above them, and layers beneath them. That is how God strikes fear into His servants—“O My servants! Beware of Me!”
en.39:17: As for those who avoid the worship of idols, and devote themselves to God—theirs is the good news. So give good news to My servants.
en.39:18: Those who listen to the Word, and follow the best of it. These are they whom God has guided. These are they who possess intellect.
en.39:19: What about someone who has deserved the sentence of punishment? Is it you who can save those in the Fire?
en.39:20: But those who fear their Lord will have mansions upon mansions, built high, with streams flowing beneath them. The promise of God; and God never breaks a promise.
en.39:21: Have you not considered how God sends down water from the sky, then He makes it flow into underground wells, then He produces with it plants of various colors, then they wither and you see them yellowing, then He turns them into debris? Surely in this is a reminder for those with understanding.
en.39:22: What about someone whose heart God has opened to Islam, so that he follows a light from His Lord? Woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the mention of God. Those are in manifest error.
en.39:23: God has sent down the best of narrations: a Scripture consistent and paired. The skins of those who reverence their Lord shiver from it, then their skins and their hearts soften up to the remembrance of God. Such is God’s guidance; He guides with it whomever He wills. But whomever God leaves astray, for him there is no guide.
en.39:24: What about someone who covers his face against the terrible misery of the Day of Resurrection? To the evildoers it will be said, “Taste what you used to earn.”
en.39:25: Those before them also denied the truth, so the penalty came upon them from where they did not perceive.
en.39:26: God made them taste disgrace in the present life, but the punishment of the Hereafter is worse, if they only knew.
en.39:27: We have cited in this Quran for mankind every ideal, that they may take heed.
en.39:28: An Arabic Quran, without any defect, so they may become righteous.
en.39:29: God cites the example of a man shared by partners at odds, and a man belonging exclusively to one man. Are they equal in status? Praise be to God, but most of them do not know.
en.39:30: You will die, and they will die.
en.39:31: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be quarrelling before your Lord.
en.39:32: Who is more evil than he who lies about God, and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in the Inferno room for the ungrateful?
en.39:33: But he who promotes the truth, and testifies to it—these are the virtuous.
en.39:34: They will have whatever they please with their Lord. Such is the reward for the virtuous.
en.39:35: God will acquit them of the worst of their deeds, and will reward them according to the best of what they used to do.
en.39:36: Is God not enough for His servant? And they frighten you with those besides Him. Whomever God sends astray, for him there is no guide.
en.39:37: And whomever God guides, for him there is no misleader. Is God not Powerful and Vengeful?
en.39:38: And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they would say, “God.” Say, “Have you seen those you pray to instead of God? If God willed any harm for me, can they lift His harm? And if He willed a blessing for me, can they hold back His mercy?” Say, “God suffices for me. On Him the reliant rely.”
en.39:39: Say: “O my people, work according to your ability; and so will I. Then you will know.
en.39:40: Who will receive a humiliating punishment, and on whom will fall a lasting torment.”
en.39:41: We sent down upon you the Scripture for mankind in truth. He who follows guidance does so for the good of his soul. And he who strays in error does so to its detriment. You are not their overseer.
en.39:42: God takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that have not died during their sleep. He retains those for which He has decreed death, and He releases the others until a predetermined time. In that are signs for people who reflect.
en.39:43: Or have they chosen intercessors other than God? Say, “Even though they have no power over anything, and are devoid of reason?”
en.39:44: Say, “All intercession is up to God. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned.”
en.39:45: When God alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with resentment. But when those other than Him are mentioned, they become filled with joy.
en.39:46: Say, “Our God, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of all secrets and declarations. You will judge between your servants regarding what they had differed about.”
en.39:47: If those who did wrong owned everything on earth, and the like of it with it, they would redeem themselves with it from the terrible suffering on the Day of Resurrection. But there will appear to them from God what they never anticipated.
en.39:48: There will appear to them the evils of their deeds, and they will be surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
en.39:49: When adversity touches the human being, he calls on Us. But then, when We favor him with a blessing from Us, he says, “I have attained this by virtue of my knowledge.” However, it is a test, but most of them do not know.
en.39:50: Those before them said it, but what they had earned did not avail them.
en.39:51: The evils of their deeds caught up with them. And the evildoers among these will also be afflicted by the evils of what they earned, and they cannot prevent it.
en.39:52: Do they not know that God extends the provision to whomever He wills, and constricts it? In that are signs for people who believe.
en.39:53: Say, “O My servants who have transgressed against themselves: do not despair of God’s mercy, for God forgives all sins. He is indeed the Forgiver, the Clement.”
en.39:54: And turn to your Lord, and submit to Him, before the retribution comes upon you. Then you will not be helped.
en.39:55: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord, before the punishment comes upon you suddenly, while you are unaware.
en.39:56: So that a soul may not say, “How sorry I am, for having neglected my duty to God, and for having been of the scoffers.”
en.39:57: Or say, “Had God guided me; I would have been of the God-conscious.”
en.39:58: Or say, when it sees the penalty, “If only I had another chance, I would be of the virtuous.”
en.39:59: Yes indeed! My Verses did come to you, but you called them lies, turned arrogant, and were of the faithless.
en.39:60: On the Day of Resurrection, you will see those who told lies about God with their faces blackened. Is there not a place in the Inferno for the arrogant?
en.39:61: And God will save those who maintained righteousness to their place of salvation. No harm will touch them, nor will they grieve.
en.39:62: God is the Creator of all things, and He is in Charge of all things.
en.39:63: To Him belong the reins of the heavens and the earth. But those who blaspheme against the revelations of God—it is they who are the losers.
en.39:64: Say, “Is it other than God you instruct me to worship, you ignorant ones?”
en.39:65: It was revealed to you, and to those before you, that if you idolize, your works will be in vain, and you will be of the losers.
en.39:66: Rather, worship God, and be of the appreciative.
en.39:67: They have not esteemed God as He ought to be esteemed. The entire earth will be in His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His righ. Immaculate is He, and Transcendent He is beyond the associations they make.
en.39:68: And the Trumpet will be sounded, whereupon everyone in the heavens and the earth will be stunned, except whomever God wills. Then it will be sounded another time, whereupon they will rise up, looking on.
en.39:69: And the earth will shine with the Light of its Lord; and the Scripture will be put in place; and the messengers of God and the witnesses will be brought in; and Judgment will be passed among them equitably, and they will not be wronged.
en.39:70: And every soul will be fully compensated for what it had done. He is well aware of what they do.
en.39:71: Those who disbelieved will be driven to the Inferno in throngs. Until, when they have reached it, and its gates are opened, its keepers will say to them, “Did not messengers from among you come to you, reciting to you the revelations of your Lord, and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?” They will say, “Yes, but the verdict of punishment is justified against the those who deny the truth.”
en.39:72: It will be said, “Enter the gates of the Inferno, to abide therein eternally.” How wretched is the destination of the arrogant.
en.39:73: And those who feared their Lord will be led to the eternal Gardens in throngs. Until, when they have reached it, and its gates are opened, its keepers will say to them, “Peace be upon you, you have been good, so enter it, to abide therein eternally.”
en.39:74: And they will say, “Praise be to God, who has fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the land, enjoying the eternal Gardens as we please.” How excellent is the reward of the workers.
en.39:75: And you will see the divine messengers hovering around the Throne, glorifying their Lord with praise. And it will be judged between them equitably, and it will be said, “Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds.”
en.4:1: O people! Fear your Lord, who created you from a single soul, and created from it its mate, and propagated from them many men and women. And revere God whom you ask about, and the parents. Surely, God is Watchful over you.
en.4:2: And give orphans their properties, and do not substitute the bad for the good. And do not consume their properties by combining them with yours, for that would be a serious sin.
en.4:3: If you fear you cannot act fairly towards the orphans—then marry the women you like—two, or three, or four. But if you fear you will not be fair, then one, or what you already have. That makes it more likely that you avoid bias.
en.4:4: Give women their dowries graciously. But if they willingly forego some of it, then consume it with enjoyment and pleasure.
en.4:5: Do not give the immature your money which God has assigned to you for support. But provide for them from it, and clothe them, and speak to them with kind words.
en.4:6: Test the orphans until they reach the age of marriage. If you find them to be mature enough, hand over their properties to them. And do not consume it extravagantly or hastily before they grow up. The rich shall not charge any wage, but the poor may charge fairly. When you hand over their properties to them, have it witnessed for them. God suffices as a Reckoner.
en.4:7: Men receive a share of what their parents and relatives leave, and women receive a share of what their parents and relatives leave; be it little or much—a legal share.
en.4:8: If the distribution is attended by the relatives, and the orphans, and the needy, give them something out of it, and speak to them kindly.
en.4:9: Those who are concerned about the fate of their weak children, in case they leave them behind, should fear God, and speak appropriate words.
en.4:10: Those who consume the wealth of orphans illicitly consume only fire into their bellies; and they will roast in a Blaze.
en.4:11: God instructs you regarding your children: The male receives the equivalent of the share of two females. If they are daughters, more than two, they get two-thirds of what he leaves. If there is only one, she gets one-half. As for the parents, each gets one-sixth of what he leaves, if he had children. If he had no children, and his parents inherit from him, his mother gets one-third. If he has siblings, his mother gets one-sixth. After fulfilling any bequest and paying off debts. Your parents and your children—you do not know which are closer to you in welfare. This is God's Law. God is Knowing and Judicious.
en.4:12: You get one-half of what your wives leave behind, if they had no children. If they had children, you get one-fourth of what they leave. After fulfilling any bequest and paying off debts.
