en.45:22: God created the heavens and the earth with justice, so that every soul will be repaid for what it has earned. And they will not be wronged.
en.45:23: Have you considered him who has taken his desire for his god? God has knowingly led him astray, and has sealed his hearing and his heart, and has placed a veil over his vision. Who will guide him after God? Will you not reflect?
en.45:24: And they say, “There is nothing but this our present life; we die and we live, and nothing destroys us except time.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are only guessing.
en.45:25: When Our clarifying Verses are recited to them, their only argument is to say, “Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful.”
en.45:26: Say, “God gives you life, then He makes you die; then He gathers you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”
en.45:27: To God belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. On the Day when the Hour takes place, on that Day the falsifiers will lose.
en.45:28: You will see every community on its knees; every community will be called to its Book: “Today you are being repaid for what you used to do.
en.45:29: This Book of Ours speaks about you in truth. We have been transcribing what you have been doing.”
en.45:30: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is the clear triumph.
en.45:31: But as for those who disbelieved: “Were My revelations not recited to you? But you turned arrogant, and were guilty people.”
en.45:32: And when it was said, “The promise of God is true, and of the Hour there is no doubt,” you said, “We do not know what the Hour is; we think it is only speculation; we are not convinced.”
en.45:33: The evils of what they did will become evident to them, and the very thing they ridiculed will haunt them.
en.45:34: And it will be said, “Today We forget you, as you forgot the encounter of this Day of yours. Your abode is the Fire, and there are no saviors for you.
en.45:35: That is because you took God’s revelations for a joke, and the worldly life lured you.” So today they will not be brought out of it, and they will not be allowed to repent.
en.45:36: Praise belongs to God; Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, Lord of humanity.
en.45:37: To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth. He is the Majestic, the Wise.
en.46:2: The sending down of the Scripture is from God, the Honorable, the Wise.
en.46:3: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what lies between them except with reason, and for a finite period. But the blasphemers continue to ignore the warnings they receive.
en.46:4: Say, “Have you considered those you worship instead of God? Show me which portion of the earth they have created. Or do they own a share of the heavens? Bring me a scripture prior to this one, or some trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.”
en.46:5: Who is more wrong than him who invokes, besides God, those who will not answer him until the Day of Resurrection, and are heedless of their prayers?
en.46:6: And when humanity is gathered, they will be enemies to them, and will renounce their worship of them.
en.46:7: When Our revelations are recited to them, plain and clear, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is obviously magic.”
en.46:8: Or do they say, “He invented it himself”? Say, “If I invented it myself, there is nothing you can do to protect me from God. He knows well what you are engaged in. He is sufficient witness between me and you. He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.”
en.46:9: Say, “I am not different from the other messengers; and I do not know what will be done with me, or with you. I only follow what is inspired in me, and I am only a clear warner.”
en.46:10: Say, “Have you considered? What if it is from God and you disbelieve in it? A witness from the Children of Israel testified to its like, and has believed, while you turned arrogant. God does not guide the unjust people.”
en.46:11: Those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “If it were anything good, they would not have preceded us to it.” And since they were not guided by it, they will say, “This is an ancient lie.”
en.46:12: And before it was the Scripture of Moses, a model and a mercy. And this is a confirming Book, in the Arabic language, to warn those who do wrong—and good news for the doers of good.
en.46:13: Those who say, “Our Lord is God,” then lead a righteous life—they have nothing to fear, nor shall they grieve.
en.46:14: These are the inhabitants of the eternal Gardens, where they will dwell forever—a reward for what they used to do.
en.46:15: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents. His mother carried him with difficulty, and delivered him with difficulty. His bearing and weaning takes thirty months. Until, when he has attained his maturity, and has reached forty years, he says, “Lord, enable me to appreciate the blessings You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to act with righteousness, pleasing You. And improve my children for me. I have sincerely repented to You, and I am of those who have surrendered.”
en.46:16: Those are they from whom We accept the best of their deeds, and We overlook their misdeeds, among the dwellers of the eternal Gardens—the promise of truth which they are promised.
en.46:17: As for him who says to his parents, “Enough of you! Are you promising me that I will be raised up, when generations have passed away before me?” While they cry for God’s help, “Woe to you! Believe! The promise of God is true!” But he says, “These are nothing but tales of the ancients.”
en.46:18: Those are they upon whom the sentence is justified, among the communities that have passed away before them, of jinn and humans. They are truly losers.
en.46:19: There are degrees for everyone, according to what they have done, and He will repay them for their works in full, and they will not be wronged.
en.46:20: On the Day when the faithless will be paraded before the Fire: “You have squandered your good in your worldly life, and you took pleasure in them. So today you are being repaid with the torment of shame, because of your unjust arrogance on earth, and because you used to sin.”
en.46:21: And mention the brother of Aad, as he warned his people at the dunes. Warnings have passed away before him, and after him: “Worship none but God; I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day.”
en.46:22: They said, “Did you come to us to divert us from our gods? Then bring us what you threaten us with, if you are being truthful.”
en.46:23: He said, “The knowledge is only with God, and I inform you of what I was sent with; but I see you are an ignorant people.”
en.46:24: Then, when they saw a cloud approaching their valley, they said, “This is a cloud that will bring us rain.” “In fact, it is what you were impatient for: a wind in which is grievous suffering.”
en.46:25: It will destroy everything by the command of its Lord. And when the morning came upon them, there was nothing to be seen except their dwellings. Thus We requite the guilty people.
en.46:26: We had empowered them in the same way as We empowered you; and We gave them the hearing, and the sight, and the minds. But neither their hearing, nor their sight, nor their minds availed them in any way. That is because they disregarded the revelations of God; and so they became surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
en.46:27: We have destroyed many townships around you, and diversified the signs, so that they may return.
en.46:28: Why then did the idols, whom they worshiped as means of nearness to God, not help them? In fact, they abandoned them. It was their lie, a fabrication of their own making.
en.46:29: Recall when We dispatched towards you a number of jinn, to listen to the Quran. When they came in its presence, they said, “Pay attention!” Then, when it was concluded, they rushed to their people, warning them.
en.46:30: They said, “O our people, we have heard a Scripture, sent down after Moses, confirming what came before it. It guides to the truth, and to a straight path.
en.46:31: O our people! Answer the caller to God, and believe in Him; and He will forgive you your sins, and will save you from a painful punishment.”
en.46:32: He who does not answer the caller to God will not escape on earth, and has no protectors besides Him. Those are in obvious error.
en.46:33: Do they not realize that God, who created the heavens and the earth, and was never tired by creating them, is Able to revive the dead? Yes indeed; He is Capable of everything.
en.46:34: On the Day when those who disbelieved are presented to the Fire: “Is this not real?” They will say, “Yes, indeed, by our Lord.” He will say, “Then taste the suffering for having disbelieved.”
en.46:35: So be patient, as the messengers with resolve were patient, and do not be hasty regarding them. On the Day when they witness what they are promised, it will seem as if they had lasted only for an hour of a day. A proclamation: Will any be destroyed except the sinful people?
en.47:1: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of God—He nullifies their works.
en.47:2: While those who believe, and work righteousness, and believe in what was sent down to Muhammad—and it is the truth from their Lord—He remits their sins, and relieves their concerns.
en.47:3: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehoods, while those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. God thus cites for the people their examples.
en.47:4: When you encounter those who disbelieve, strike at their necks. Then, when you have routed them, bind them firmly. Then, either release them by grace, or by ransom, until war lays down its burdens. Had God willed, He could have defeated them Himself, but He thus tests some of you by means of others. As for those who are killed in the way of God, He will not let their deeds go to waste.
en.47:5: He will guide them, and will improve their state of mind.
en.47:6: And will admit them into the eternal Gardens, which He has identified for them.
en.47:7: O you who believe! If you support God, He will support you, and will strengthen your foothold.
en.47:8: But as for those who disbelieve, for them is perdition, and He will waste their deeds.
en.47:9: That is because they hated what God revealed, so He nullified their deeds.
en.47:10: Have they not journeyed through the earth and seen the consequences for those before them? God poured destruction upon them, and for the unbelievers is something comparable.
en.47:11: That is because God is the Master of those who believe, while the those who deny the truth have no master.
en.47:12: God will admit those who believe and do good deeds into gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy themselves, and eat as cattle eat, and the Fire will be their dwelling.
en.47:13: How many a town was more powerful than your town which evicted you? We destroyed them, and there was no helper for them.
en.47:14: Is he who stands upon evidence from his Lord, like someone whose evil deed is made to appear good to him? And they follow their own desires?
en.47:15: The likeness of the Garden of Paradise promised to the virtuous: in it are rivers of pure water, and rivers of milk forever fresh, and rivers of wine delightful to the drinkers, and rivers of strained honey. And therein they will have of every fruit, and forgiveness from their Lord. Like one abiding in the Fire forever, and are given to drink boiling water, that cuts-up their bowels?
en.47:16: Among them are those who listen to you, but when they leave your presence, they say to those given knowledge, “What did he say just now?” Those are they whose hearts God has sealed, and they follow their own desires.
en.47:17: As for those who are guided, He increases them in guidance, and He has granted them their righteousness.
en.47:18: Are they just waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? Its tokens have already come. But how will they be reminded when it has come to them?
en.47:19: Know that there is no god but God, and ask forgiveness for your sin, and for the believing men and believing women. God knows your movements, and your resting-place.
en.47:20: Those who believe say, “If only a chapter is sent down.” Yet when a decisive chapter is sent down, and fighting is mentioned in it, you see those in whose hearts is sickness looking at you with the look of someone fainting at death. So woe to them!
en.47:21: Obedience and upright speech. Then, when the matter is settled, being true to God would have been better for them.
en.47:22: If you turn away, you are likely to make mischief on earth, and sever your family ties.
en.47:23: Those are they whom God has cursed. He made them deaf, and blinded their sight.
en.47:24: Will they not ponder the Quran? Or are there locks upon their hearts?
en.47:25: Those who reverted after the guidance became clear to them—the Adversary has enticed them, and has given them latitude.
en.47:26: That is because they said to those who hated what God has revealed, “We will obey you in certain matters.” But God knows their secret thoughts.
en.47:27: How about when the divine messengers take them at death, beating their faces and their backs?
en.47:28: That is because they pursued what displeases God, and they disliked His approval, so He nullified their works.
en.47:29: Do those in whose hearts is sickness think that God will not expose their malice?
en.47:30: Had We willed, We could have shown them to you, and you would have recognized them by their marks. Yet you will recognize them by their tone of speech. And God knows your actions.
en.47:31: We will certainly test you, until We know those among you who strive, and those who are steadfast, and We will test your reactions.
en.47:32: Those who disbelieve, and hinder from the path of God, and oppose the Envoy after guidance has become clear to them—they will not hurt God in the least, but He will nullify their deeds.
en.47:33: O you who believe! obey God, and obey the Envoy, and do not let your deeds go to waste.
en.47:34: Those who disbelieve, and hinder from God’s path, and then die as those who deny the truth—God will not forgive them.
en.47:35: So do not waver and call for peace while you have the upper hand. God is with you, and He will not waste your efforts.
en.47:36: The life of this word is nothing but play and pastime. But if you have faith and lead a righteous life, He will grant you your rewards, and He will not ask you for your possessions.
en.47:37: Were He to ask you for it, and press you, you would become tightfisted, and He would expose your unwillingness.
en.47:38: Here you are, being called to spend in the cause of God. Among you are those who withhold; but whoever withholds is withholding against his own soul. God is the Rich, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people, and they will not be like you.
en.48:1: We have granted you a conspicuous victory.
en.48:2: That God may forgive you your sin, past and to come, and complete His favors upon you, and guide you in a straight path.
en.48:3: And help you with an unwavering support.
en.48:4: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers, to add faith to their faith. To God belong the forces of the heavens and the earth. God is Knowing and Wise.
en.48:5: He will admit the believers, male and female, into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, to abide therein forever, and He will remit their sins. That, with God, is a great triumph.
en.48:6: And He will punish the the dissemblers, male and female, and the idolaters, male and female, those who harbor evil thoughts about God. They are surrounded by evil; and God is angry with them, and has cursed them, and has prepared for them the Inferno—a miserable destination.
en.48:7: To God belong the troops of the heavens and the earth. God is Mighty and Wise.
en.48:8: We sent you as a witness, and a bearer of good news, and a warner.
en.48:9: That you may believe in God and His Envoy, and support Him, and honor Him, and praise Him morning and evening.
en.48:10: Those who pledge allegiance to you are pledging allegiance to God. The hand of God is over their hands. Whoever breaks his pledge breaks it to his own loss. And whoever fulfills his covenant with God, He will grant him a great reward.
en.48:11: The Desert-Arabs who remained behind will say to you, “Our belongings and our families have preoccupied us, so ask forgiveness for us.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, “Who can avail you anything against God, if He desires loss for you, or desires gain for you?” In fact, God is Informed of what you do.
en.48:12: But you thought that the Envoy and the believers will never return to their families, and this seemed fine to your hearts; and you harbored evil thoughts, and were uncivilized people.
en.48:13: He who does not believe in God and His Envoy—We have prepared for the those who deny the truth a Blazing Fire.
en.48:14: To God belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and He punishes whomever He wills. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.48:15: Those who lagged behind will say when you depart to collect the gains, “Let us follow you.” They want to change the Word of God. Say, “You will not follow us; God has said so before.” Then they will say, “But you are jealous of us.” In fact, they understand only a little.
en.48:16: Say to the Desert-Arabs who lagged behind, “You will be called against a people of great might; you will fight them, unless they submit. If you obey, God will give you a fine reward. But if you turn away, as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.”
en.48:17: There is no blame on the blind, nor any blame on the lame, nor any blame on the sick. Whoever obeys God and His Envoy—He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away—He will punish him with a painful punishment.
en.48:18: God was pleased with the believers, when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, and sent down serenity upon them, and rewarded them with an imminent conquest.
en.48:19: And abundant gains for them to capture. God is Mighty and Wise.
en.48:20: God has promised you abundant gains, which you will capture. He has expedited this for you, and has restrained people’s hands from you; that it may be a sign to the believers, and that He may guide you on a straight path.
en.48:21: And other things, of which you were incapable, but God has encompassed them. God is Capable of everything.
en.48:22: If those who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned back and fled, then found neither protector nor helper.
en.48:23: It is God’s pattern, ongoing since the past. You will never find any change in God’s pattern.
en.48:24: It is He who withheld their hands from you, and your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after giving you advantage over them. God is Observer of what you do.
en.48:25: It is they who disbelieved, and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and prevented the offering from reaching its destination. Were it not for faithful men and faithful women, whom you did not know, you were about to hurt them, and became guilty of an unintentional crime. Thus God admits into His mercy whomever He wills. Had they dispersed, We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with a painful penalty.
en.48:26: Those who disbelieved filled their hearts with rage—the rage of the days of ignorance. But God sent His serenity down upon His Envoy, and upon the believers, and imposed on them the words of righteousness—of which they were most worthy and deserving. God is aware of everything.
en.48:27: God has fulfilled His Envoy’s vision in truth: “You will enter the Sacred Mosque, God willing, in security, heads shaven, or hair cut short, not fearing. He knew what you did not know, and has granted besides that an imminent victory.”
en.48:28: It is He who sent His Envoy with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all religions. God suffices as Witness.
en.48:29: Muhammad is the Envoy of God. Those with him are stern against the those who deny the truth, yet compassionate amongst themselves. You see them kneeling, prostrating, seeking blessings from God and approval. Their marks are on their faces from the effects of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah, and their description in the Gospel: like a plant that sprouts, becomes strong, grows thick, and rests on its stem, impressing the farmers. Through them He enrages the those who deny the truth. God has promised those among them who believe and do good deeds forgiveness and a great reward.
en.49:1: O you who believe! Do not place your opinions above that of God and His Envoy, and fear God. God is Hearing and Knowing.
en.49:2: O you who believe! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the messenger of God, and do not speak loudly to him, as you speak loudly to one another, lest your works be in vain without you realizing.
en.49:3: Those who lower their voices before God’s Envoy—those are they whose hearts God has tested for piety. They will have forgiveness and a great reward.
en.49:4: Those who call you from behind the chambers—most of them do not understand.
en.49:5: Had they remained patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. But God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.49:6: O you who believe! If a troublemaker brings you any news, investigate, lest you harm people out of ignorance, and you become regretful for what you have done.
en.49:7: And know that among you is the Envoy of God. Had he obeyed you in many things, you would have suffered hardship. But God has given you the love of faith, and adorned it in your hearts, and made disbelief, mischief, and rebellion hateful to you. These are the rightly guided.
en.49:8: A Grace and Favor from God. God is Knowing and Wise.
en.49:9: If two groups of believers fight each other, reconcile between them. But if one group aggresses against the other, fight the aggressing group until it complies with God’s command. Once it has complied, reconcile between them with justice, and be equitable. God loves the equitable.
en.49:10: The believers are brothers, so reconcile between your brothers, and remain conscious of God, so that you may receive mercy.
en.49:11: O you who believe! No people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than they. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than they. Nor shall you slander one another, nor shall you insult one another with names. Evil is the return to wickedness after having attained faith. Whoever does not repent—these are the evildoers.
en.49:12: O you who believe! Avoid most suspicion—some suspicion is sinful. And do not spy on one another, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would detest it. So remain mindful of God. God is Most Relenting, Most Merciful.
en.49:13: O people! We created you from a male and a female, and made you races and tribes, that you may know one another. The best among you in the sight of God is the most righteous. God is All-Knowing, Well-Experienced.
en.49:14: The Desert-Arabs say, “We have believed.” Say, “You have not believed; but say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. But if you obey God and His Envoy, He will not diminish any of your deeds. God is Forgiving and Merciful.”
en.49:15: The believers are those who believe in God and His Envoy, and then have not doubted, and strive for God’s cause with their wealth and their persons. These are the sincere.
en.49:16: Say, “Are you going to teach God about your religion, when God knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and God is aware of all things?”
en.49:17: They regarded it a favor to you that they have submitted. Say, “Do not consider your submission a favor to me; it is God who has done you a favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are sincere.”
en.49:18: God knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth, and God is seeing of everything you do.
en.5:1: O you who believe! Fulfill your commitments. Livestock animals are permitted for you, except those specified to you; but not wild game while you are in pilgrim sanctity. God decrees whatever He wills.
en.5:2: O you who believe! Do not violate God’s sacraments, nor the Sacred Month, nor the offerings, nor the garlanded, nor those heading for the Sacred House seeking blessings from their Lord and approval. When you have left the pilgrim sanctity, you may hunt. And let not the hatred of people who barred you from the Sacred Mosque incite you to aggression. And cooperate with one another in virtuous conduct and conscience, and do not cooperate with one another in sin and hostility. And fear God. God is severe in punishment.
en.5:3: Prohibited for you are carrion, blood, the flesh of swine, and animals dedicated to other than God; also the flesh of animals strangled, killed violently, killed by a fall, gored to death, mangled by wild animals—except what you rescue, and animals sacrificed on altars; and the practice of drawing lots. For it is immoral. Today, those who disbelieve have despaired of your religion, so do not fear them, but fear Me. Today I have perfected your religion for you, and have completed My favor upon you, and have approved Islam as a religion for you. But whoever is compelled by hunger, with no intent of wrongdoing—God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.5:4: They ask you what is permitted for them. Say, “Permitted for you are all good things, including what trained dogs and falcons catch for you.” You train them according to what God has taught you. So eat from what they catch for you, and pronounce God’s name over it. And fear God. God is Swift in reckoning.
en.5:5: Today all good things are made lawful for you. And the food of those given the Scripture is lawful for you, and your food is lawful for them. So are chaste believing women, and chaste women from the people who were given the Scripture before you, provided you give them their dowries, and take them in marriage, not in adultery, nor as mistresses. But whoever rejects faith, his work will be in vain, and in the Hereafter he will be among the losers.
en.5:6: O you who believe! When you rise to pray, wash your faces and your hands and arms to the elbows, and wipe your heads, and your feet to the ankles. If you had intercourse, then purify yourselves. If you are ill, or travelling, or one of you returns from the toilet, or you had contact with women, and could not find water, then use some clean sand and wipe your faces and hands with it. God does not intend to burden you, but He intends to purify you, and to complete His blessing upon you, that you may be thankful.
en.5:7: And Remember God’s blessings upon you, and His covenant which He covenanted with you; when you said, “We hear and we obey.” And remain conscious of God, for God knows what the hearts contain.
en.5:8: O you who believe! Be upright to God, witnessing with justice; and let not the hatred of a certain people prevent you from acting justly. Adhere to justice, for that is nearer to piety; and fear God. God is informed of what you do.
en.5:9: God has promised those who believe and work righteousness: they will have forgiveness and a great reward.
en.5:10: As for those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations—these are the inmates of the Inferno.
en.5:11: O you who believe! Remember God's blessings upon you; when certain people intended to extend their hands against you, and He restrained their hands from you. So reverence God, and in God let the believers put their trust.
en.5:12: God received a pledge from the Children of Israel, and We raised among them twelve chiefs. God said, “I am with you; if you perform the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh), and pay the alms, and believe in My messengers and support them, and lend God a loan of righteousness; I will remit your sins, and admit you into Gardens beneath which rivers flow. But whoever among you disbelieves afterwards has strayed from the right way.”
en.5:13: Because of their breaking their pledge, We cursed them, and made their hearts hard. They twist the words out of their context, and they disregarded some of what they were reminded of. You will always witness deceit from them, except for a few of them. But pardon them, and overlook. God loves the doers of good.
en.5:14: And from those who say, “We are Christians,” We received their pledge, but they neglected some of what they were reminded of. So We provoked enmity and hatred among them until the Day of Resurrection; God will then inform them of what they used to craft.
en.5:15: O People of the Scripture! Our Envoy has come to you, clarifying for you much of what you kept hidden of the Scripture, and overlooking much. A light from God has come to you, and a clear Book.
en.5:16: God guides with it whoever follows His approval to the ways of peace, and He brings them out of darkness into light, by His permission, and He guides them in a straight path.
en.5:17: They disbelieve those who say, “God is the Christ, the son of Mary.” Say, “Who can prevent God, if He willed, from annihilating the Christ son of Mary, and his mother, and everyone on earth?” To God belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what is between them. He creates whatever He wills, and God has power over everything.
en.5:18: The Jews and the Christians say, “We are the children of God, and His beloved.” Say, “Why then does He punish you for your sins?” In fact, you are humans from among those He created. He forgives whom He wills, and He punishes whom He wills. To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what lies between them, and to Him is the return.
en.5:19: O People of the Scripture! Our Envoy has come to you, making things clear to you—after a cessation of messengers—so that you cannot say, “No preacher has come to us, and no warner.” In fact, a preacher has come to you, and a warner; and God is Capable of everything.
en.5:20: When Moses said to his people, “O my people, remember God’s blessings upon you, when He placed prophets among you, and made you kings, and gave you what He never gave any other people.”
en.5:21: “O my people, enter the Holy Land which God has assigned for you, and do not turn back, lest you return as losers.”
en.5:22: They said, “O Moses, there are tyrannical people in it; we will not enter it until they leave it. If they leave it, we will be entering.”
en.5:23: Two men of those who feared, but whom God had blessed, said, “Go at them by the gate; and when you have entered it, you will prevail. And put your trust in God, if you are believers.”
en.5:24: They said, “O Moses, we will not enter it, ever, as long as they are in it. So go ahead, you and your Lord, and fight. We are staying right here.”
en.5:25: He said, “My Lord! I have control only over myself and my brother, so separate between us and between the wicked people.”
en.5:26: He said, “It is forbidden for them for forty years. They will wander aimlessly in the land. So do not grieve over the defiant people.”
en.5:27: And relate to them the true story of Adam's two sons: when they offered an offering, and it was accepted from one of them, but it was not accepted from the other. He Said, “I will kill you.” He Said, “God accepts only from the virtuous.”
en.5:28: “If you extend your hand to kill me, I will not extend my hand to kill you; for I fear God, Lord of the Worlds.”
en.5:29: “I would rather you bear my sin and your sin, and you become among the inmates of the Fire. Such is the reward for the evildoers.”
en.5:30: Then His soul prompted him to kill his brother, so he killed him, and became one of the losers.
en.5:31: Then God sent a raven digging the ground, to show him how to cover his brother's corpse. He said, “Woe to me! I was unable to be like this raven, and bury my brother's corpse.” So he became full of regrets.
en.5:32: Because of that We ordained for the Children of Israel: that whoever kills a person—unless it is for murder or corruption on earth—it is as if he killed the whole of mankind; and whoever saves it, it is as if he saved the whole of mankind. Our messengers came to them with clarifications, but even after that, many of them continue to commit excesses in the land.
en.5:33: The punishment for those who fight God and His Envoy, and strive to spread corruption on earth, is that they be killed, or crucified, or have their hands and feet cut off on opposite sides, or be banished from the land. That is to disgrace them in this life; and in the Hereafter they will have a terrible punishment.
en.5:34: Except for those who repent before you apprehend them. So know that God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.5:35: O you who believe! Be conscious of God, and seek the means of approach to Him, and strive in His cause, so that you may succeed.
en.5:36: As for those who disbelieve, even if they owned everything on earth, and the like of it with it, and they offered it to ransom themselves from the torment of the Day of Resurrection, it will not be accepted from them. For them is a painful punishment.
en.5:37: They will want to leave the Fire, but they will not leave it. For them is a lasting punishment.
en.5:38: As for the thief, whether male or female, cut their hands as a penalty for what they have reaped—a deterrent from God. God is Mighty and Wise.
en.5:39: But whoever repents after his crime, and reforms, God will accept his repentance. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.5:40: Do you not know that to God belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth? He punishes whom He wills, and He forgives whom He wills. And God is Capable of everything.
en.5:41: O Envoy! Do not let those who are quick to disbelief grieve you—from among those who say with their mouths, “We believe,” but their hearts do not believe; and from among the Jews—listeners to lies, listeners to other people who did not come to you. They distort words from their places, and they say, “If you are given this, accept it; but if you are not given it, beware.” Whomever God has willed to divert, you have nothing for him from God. Those are they whose hearts God does not intend to purify. For them is disgrace in this world, and for them is a great punishment in the Hereafter.
en.5:42: Listeners to falsehoods, eaters of illicit earnings. If they come to you, judge between them, or turn away from them. If you turn away from them, they will not harm you in the least. But if you judge, judge between them equitably. God loves the equitable.
en.5:43: But why do they come to you for judgment, when they have the Torah, in which is God’s Law? Yet they turn away after that. These are not believers.
en.5:44: We have revealed the Torah, wherein is guidance and light. The submissive prophets ruled the Jews according to it, so did the rabbis and the scholars, as they were required to protect God’s Book, and were witnesses to it. So do not fear people, but fear Me. And do not sell My revelations for a cheap price. Those who do not rule according to what God revealed are the unbelievers.
en.5:45: And We wrote for them in it: a life for a life, an eye for an eye, a nose for a nose, an ear for an ear, a tooth for a tooth, and an equal wound for a wound; but whoever forgoes it in charity, it will serve as atonement for him. Those who do not rule according to what God revealed are the evildoers.
en.5:46: In their footsteps, We sent Jesus son of Mary, fulfilling the Torah that preceded him; and We gave him the Gospel, wherein is guidance and light, and confirming the Torah that preceded him, and guidance and counsel for the virtuous.
en.5:47: So let the people of the Gospel rule according to what God revealed in it. Those who do not rule according to what God revealed are the sinners.
en.5:48: And We revealed to you the Scripture, with truth, confirming the Scripture that preceded it, and superseding it. So judge between them according to what God revealed, and do not follow their desires if they differ from the truth that has come to you. For each of you We have assigned a law and a method. Had God willed, He could have made you a single nation, but He tests you through what He has given you. So compete in righteousness. To God is your return, all of you; then He will inform you of what you had disputed.
en.5:49: And judge between them according to what God revealed, and do not follow their desires. And beware of them, lest they lure you away from some of what God has revealed to you. But if they turn away, know that God intends to strike them with some of their sins. In fact, a great many people are corrupt.
en.5:50: Is it the laws of the time of ignorance that they desire? Who is better than God in judgment for people who are certain?
en.5:51: O you who believe! Do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies; some of them are allies of one another. Whoever of you allies himself with them is one of them. God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
en.5:52: You will see those in whose hearts is sickness racing towards them. They say, “We fear the wheel of fate may turn against us.” But perhaps God will bring about victory, or some event of His making; thereupon they will regret what they concealed within themselves.
en.5:53: Those who believe will say, “Are these the ones who swore by God with their strongest oaths that they are with you?” Their works have failed, so they became losers.
en.5:54: O you who believe! Whoever of you goes back on his religion—God will bring a people whom He loves and who love Him, kind towards the believers, stern with the those who deny the truth. They strive in the way of God, and do not fear the blame of the critic. That is the grace of God; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. God is Embracing and Knowing.
en.5:55: Your allies are God, and His Envoy, and those who believe—those who pray regularly, and give charity, and bow down.
en.5:56: Whoever allies himself with God, and His Envoy, and those who believe—surely the Party of God is the victorious.
en.5:57: O you who believe! Do not befriend those who take your religion in mockery and as a sport, be they from among those who were given the Scripture before you, or the those who deny the truth. And obey God, if you are believers.
en.5:58: When you call to the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh), they take it as a joke and a trifle. That is because they are people who do not reason.
en.5:59: Say, “O People of the Scripture! Do you resent us only because we believe in God, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed previously; and most of you are sinners?”
en.5:60: Say, “Shall I inform you of worse than that for retribution from God? He whom God has cursed, and with whom He became angry; and He turned some of them into apes, and swine, and idol worshipers. These are in a worse position, and further away from the right way.”
en.5:61: When they come to you, they say, “We believe,” though they have entered with disbelief, and they have departed with it. But God is well aware of what they hide.
en.5:62: You see many of them competing with one another in sin and hostility, and their consuming of what is illicit. What they have been doing is truly evil.
en.5:63: Why do the rabbis and the priests not prevent them from speaking sinfully and from consuming forbidden wealth? Evil is what they have been doing.
en.5:64: The Jews say, “God’s hand is tied.” It is their hands that are tied, and they are cursed for what they say. In fact, His hands are outstretched; He gives as He wills. Certainly, what was revealed to your from your Lord will increase many of them in defiance and blasphemy. And We placed between them enmity and hatred, until the Day of Resurrection. Whenever they kindle the fire of war, God extinguishes it. And they strive to spread corruption on earth. God does not love the corrupters.
en.5:65: Had the People of the Scriputure believed and been righteous, We would have remitted their sins, and admitted them into the Gardens of Bliss.
en.5:66: Had they observed the Torah, and the Gospel, and what was revealed to them from their Lord, they would have consumed amply from above them, and from beneath their feet. Among them is a moderate community, but evil is what many of them are doing.
en.5:67: O Envoy, convey what was revealed to you from your Lord. But if you do not, then you would not have delivered His message. And God will protect you from the people. God does not guide the disbelieving people.
en.5:68: Say, “O People of the Scripture! You have no basis until you uphold the Torah, and the Gospel, and what is revealed to you from your Lord.” But what is revealed to you from your Lord will increase many of them in rebellion and disbelief, so do not be sorry for the disbelieving people.
en.5:69: Those who believe, and the Jews, and the Sabians, and the Christians—whoever believes in God and the Last Day, and does what is right—they have nothing to fear, nor shall they grieve.
en.5:70: We made a covenant with the Children of Israel, and We sent to them messengers. Whenever a messenger came to them with what their souls did not desire, some of them they accused of lying, and others they put to death.
en.5:71: They assumed there would be no punishment, so they turned blind and deaf. Then God redeemed them, but then again many of them turned blind and deaf. But God is Seeing of what they do.
en.5:72: They disbelieve those who say, “God is the Messiah the son of Mary.” But the Messiah himself said, “O Children of Israel, worship God, my Lord and your Lord. Whoever associates others with God, God has forbidden him the eternal Gardens, and his dwelling is the Fire. The evildoers have no saviors.”
en.5:73: They disbelieve those who say, “God is the third of three.” But there is no deity except the One God. If they do not refrain from what they say, a painful torment will befall those among them who disbelieve.
en.5:74: Will they not repent to God and ask His forgiveness? God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.5:75: The Messiah son of Mary was only a messenger, before whom other Messengers had passed away, and his mother was a woman of truth. They both used to eat food. Note how We make clear the revelations to them; then note how deluded they are.
en.5:76: Say, “Do you worship, besides God, what has no power to harm or benefit you?” But God: He is the Hearer, the Knower.
en.5:77: Say, “O People of the Scripture! Do not exaggerate in your religion beyond the truth; and do not follow the opinions of people who went astray before, and misled many, and themselves strayed off the balanced way.”
en.5:78: Cursed were those who disbelieved from among the Children of Israel by the tongue of David and Jesus son of Mary. That is because they rebelled and used to transgress.
en.5:79: They used not to prevent one another from the wrongs they used to commit. Evil is what they used to do.
en.5:80: You will see many of them befriending those who disbelieve. Terrible is what their souls prompts them to do. The wrath of God fell upon them, and in the torment they will remain.
en.5:81: Had they believed in God and the messenger of God, and in what was revealed to him, they would not have befriended them. But many of them are immoral.
en.5:82: You will find that the people most hostile towards the believers are the Jews and the polytheists. And you will find that the nearest in affection towards the believers are those who say, “We are Christians.” That is because among them are priests and monks, and they are not arrogant.
en.5:83: And when they hear what was revealed to the Envoy, you see their eyes overflowing with tears, as they recognize the truth in it. They say, “Our Lord, we have believed, so count us among the witnesses.”
en.5:84: “And why should we not believe in God, and in the truth that has come to us, and hope that our Lord will include us among the virtuous people?”
en.5:85: God will reward them for what they say—Gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will stay forever. Such is the reward of the virtuous.
en.5:86: But as for those who disbelieve and deny Our signs—these are the inmates of the Fire.
en.5:87: O you who believe! Do not prohibit the good things God has permitted for you, and do not commit aggression. God does not love the aggressors.
en.5:88: And eat of the lawful and good things God has provided for you; and be conscious of God, in whom you are believers.
en.5:89: God does not hold you accountable for your unintended oaths, but He holds you accountable for your binding oaths. The atonement for it is by feeding ten needy people from the average of what you feed your families, or by clothing them, or by freeing a slave. Anyone who lacks the means shall fast for three days. That is the atonement for breaking your oaths when you have sworn them. So keep your oaths. Thus God makes clear His Revelations to you, that you may be grateful.
en.5:90: O you who believe! Intoxicants, gambling, idolatry, and divination are abominations of the Adversary’s doing. Avoid them, so that you may prosper.
en.5:91: the Adversary wants to provoke strife and hatred among you through intoxicants and gambling, and to prevent you from the remembrance of God, and from devotional prayer (Ṣalāh). Will you not desist?
en.5:92: Obey God and obey the Envoy, and be cautious. If you turn away—know that the duty of Our Envoy is clear communication.
en.5:93: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will not be blamed for what they may have eaten, provided they obey, and believe, and do good deeds, then maintain piety and faith, then remain righteous and charitable. God loves the charitable.
en.5:94: O you who believe! God will test you with something of the game your hands and spears obtain, that God may know who fears Him at heart. Whoever commits aggression after that will have a painful punishment.
en.5:95: O you who believe! do not kill game while you are in pilgrim sanctity. Whoever of you kills any intentionally, its penalty shall be a domestic animal comparable to what he killed, as determined by two honest persons among you—an offering delivered to the Kaabah. Or he may atone by feeding the needy, or its equivalent in fasting, so that he may taste the consequences of his conduct. God forgives what is past. But whoever repeats, God will take revenge on him. God is Almighty, Avenger.
en.5:96: Permitted for you is the catch of sea, and its food—as sustenance for you and for travelers. But forbidden for you is the game of land while you are in pilgrim sanctity. And fear God, to whom you will be gathered.
en.5:97: God has appointed the Kaabah, the Sacred House, a sanctuary for the people, and the Sacred Month, and the offerings, and the garlanded. That you may know that God knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and that God is Cognizant of all things.
en.5:98: Know that God is severe in retribution, and that God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.5:99: The Envoy’s sole duty is to convey. God knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
en.5:100: Say: “The bad and the good are not equal, even though the abundance of the bad may impress you. So be conscious of God, O you who possess intelligence, that you may succeed.”
en.5:101: O you who believe! Do not ask about things that would trouble you if disclosed to you. But if you were to ask about them while the Quran is being revealed, they will become obvious to you. God forgives that. God is Forgiving and Clement.
en.5:102: A people before you asked about them, but then came to reject them.
en.5:103: God did not institute the superstitions of Bahirah, Saibah, Wasilah, or of Hami; but those who disbelieve fabricate lies about God—most of them do not understand.
en.5:104: And when it is said to them, “Come to what God has revealed, and to the Envoy,” they say, “Sufficient for us is what we found our forefathers upon.” Even if their forefathers knew nothing, and were not guided?
en.5:105: O you who believe! You are responsible for your own souls. He who has strayed cannot harm you if you are guided. To God is you return, all of you, and He will inform you of what you used to do.
en.5:106: O you who believe! When death approaches one of you, let two reliable persons from among you act as witnesses to the making of a bequest, or two persons from another people if you are travelling in the land and the event of death approaches you. Engage them after the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh). If you have doubts, let them swear by God: “We will not sell our testimony for any price, even if he was a near relative, and we will not conceal God’s testimony, for then we would be sinners.”
en.5:107: If it is discovered that they are guilty of perjury: let two others take their place, two from among those responsible for the claim, and have them swear by God, “Our testimony is more truthful than their testimony, and we will not be biased, for then we would be evildoers.”
en.5:108: That makes it more likely that they will give true testimony, fearing that their oaths might be contradicted by subsequent oaths. So fear God, and listen. God does not guide the disobedient people.
en.5:109: On the Day when God will gather the messengers, then say, “What response were you given?” They will say, “We have no knowledge; it is you who are the Knower of the unseen.”
en.5:110: When God will say, “O Jesus son of Mary, recall My favor upon you and upon your mother, how I supported you with the Holy Spirit. You spoke to the people from the crib, and in maturity. How I taught you the Scripture and wisdom, and the Torah and the Gospel. And recall that you molded from clay the shape of a bird, by My leave, and then you breathed into it, and it became a bird, by My leave. And you healed the blind and the leprous, by My leave; and you revived the dead, by My leave. And recall that I restrained the Children of Israel from you when you brought them the clear miracles. But those who disbelieved among them said, `This is nothing but obvious sorcery.'“
en.5:111: “And when I inspired the disciples: `Believe in Me and in My Envoy.' They said, `We have believed, so bear witness that We have submitted.'“
en.5:112: “And when the disciples said, 'O Jesus son of Mary, is your Lord able to bring down for us a feast from heaven?' He said, 'Fear God, if you are believers.'“
en.5:113: They said, “We wish to eat from it, so that our hearts may be reassured, and know that you have told us the truth, and be among those who witness it.”
en.5:114: Jesus son of Mary said, “O God, our Lord, send down for us a table from heaven, to be a festival for us, for the first of us, and the last of us, and a sign from You; and provide for us; You are the Best of providers.”
en.5:115: God said, “I will send it down to you. But whoever among you disbelieves thereafter, I will punish him with a punishment the like of which I never punish any other being.”
en.5:116: And God will say, “O Jesus son of Mary, did you say to the people, `Take me and my mother as gods rather than God?'“ He will say, “Glory be to You! It is not for me to say what I have no right to. Had I said it, You would have known it. You know what is in my soul, and I do not know what is in your soul. You are the Knower of the hidden.
en.5:117: I only told them what You commanded me: that you shall worship God, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them while I was among them; but when You took me to Yourself, you became the Watcher over them—You are Witness over everything.
en.5:118: If You punish them, they are Your servants; but if You forgive them, You are the Mighty and Wise.”
en.5:119: God will say, “This is a Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness.” They will have Gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will remain forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is the great attainment.
en.5:120: To God belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what lies in them, and He has power over everything.
en.50:2: They marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The those who deny the truth say, “This is something strange.
en.50:3: When we have died and become dust? This is a farfetched return.”
en.50:4: We know what the earth consumes of them, and with Us is a comprehensive book.
en.50:5: But they denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state.
en.50:6: Have they not observed the sky above them, how We constructed it, and decorated it, and it has no cracks?
en.50:7: And the earth, how We spread it out, and set on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of delightful pairs?
en.50:8: A lesson and a reminder for every penitent worshiper.
en.50:9: And We brought down from the sky blessed water, and produced with it gardens and grain to harvest.
en.50:10: And the soaring palm trees, with clustered dates.
en.50:11: As sustenance for the servants. And We revive thereby a dead town. Likewise is the resurrection.
en.50:12: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth, and so did the dwellers of Russ, and Thamood.
en.50:13: And Aad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.
en.50:14: And the Dwellers of the Woods, and the people of Tubba. They all rejected the messengers, so My threat came true.
en.50:15: Were We fatigued by the first creation? But they are in doubt of a new creation.
en.50:16: We created the human being, and We know what his soul whispers to him. We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
en.50:17: As the two receivers receive, seated to the right and to the left.
en.50:18: Not a word does he utter, but there is a watcher by him, ready.
en.50:19: The daze of death has come in truth: “This is what you tried to evade.”
en.50:20: And the Trumpet is blown: “This is the Promised Day.”
en.50:21: And every soul will come forward, accompanied by a driver and a witness.
en.50:22: “You were in neglect of this, so We lifted your screen from you, and your vision today is keen.”
en.50:23: And His escort will say, “This is what I have ready with me.”
en.50:24: “Throw into the Inferno every stubborn disbeliever.
en.50:26: Who fabricated another god with God; toss him into the intense agony.”
en.50:27: His escort will say, “Our Lord, I did not make him rebel, but he was far astray.”
en.50:28: He will say, “Do not feud in My presence—I had warned you in advance.
en.50:29: The decree from Me will not be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants.”
en.50:30: On the Day when We will say to the Inferno, “Are you full?” And it will say, “Are there any more?”
en.50:31: And the eternal Gardens will be brought closer to the God-conscious, not far away.
en.50:32: “This is what you were promised—for every careful penitent.
en.50:33: Who inwardly feared the Most Gracious, and came with a repentant heart.
en.50:34: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity.”
en.50:35: Therein they will have whatever they desire—and We have even more.
en.50:36: How many generations before them, who were more powerful than they, did We destroy? They explored the lands—was there any escape?
en.50:37: In that is a reminder for whoever possesses a heart, or cares to listen and witness.
en.50:38: We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and no fatigue touched Us.
en.50:39: So endure what they say, and proclaim the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before sunset.
en.50:40: And glorify Him during the night, and at the end of devotions.
en.50:41: And listen for the Day when the caller calls from a nearby place.
en.50:42: The Day when they will hear the Shout in all truth. That is the Day of Emergence.
en.50:43: It is We who control life and death, and to Us is the destination.
en.50:44: The Day when the earth will crack for them at once. That is an easy gathering for Us.
en.50:45: We are fully aware of what they say, and you are not a dictator over them. So remind by the Quran whoever fears My warning.
en.51:5: What you are promised is true.
en.51:7: By the sky that is woven.
en.51:8: You differ in what you say.
en.51:9: Averted from it is he who is averted.
en.51:11: Those who are dazed in ignorance.
en.51:12: They ask, “When is the Day of Judgment?”
en.51:13: The Day they are presented to the Fire.
en.51:14: “Taste your ordeal. This is what you used to challenge.”
en.51:15: But the God-conscious are amidst gardens and springs.
en.51:16: Receiving what their Lord has given them. They were virtuous before that.
en.51:17: They used to sleep a little at night.
en.51:18: And at dawn, they would pray for pardon.
en.51:19: And in their wealth, there was a share for the beggar and the deprived.
en.51:20: And on earth are signs for the convinced.
en.51:21: And within yourselves. Do you not see?
en.51:22: And in the heaven is your livelihood, and what you are promised.
en.51:23: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is as true as the fact that you speak.
en.51:24: Has the story of Abraham’s honorable guests reached you?
en.51:25: When they entered upon him, they said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace, strangers.”
en.51:26: Then he slipped away to his family, and brought a fatted calf.
en.51:27: He set it before them. He said, “Will you not eat?”
en.51:28: And he harbored fear of them. They said, “Do not fear,” and they announced to him the good news of a knowledgeable boy.
en.51:29: His wife came forward crying. She clasped her face, and said, “A barren old woman?”
en.51:30: They said, “Thus spoke your Lord. He is the Wise, the Knowing.”
en.51:31: He said, “What is your business, O envoys?”
en.51:32: They said, “We are sent to a people guilty of sin.”
en.51:33: “To unleash upon them rocks of clay.”
en.51:34: “Marked by your Lord for the excessive.”
en.51:35: We evacuated all the believers who were in it.
en.51:36: But found in it only one household of Muslims.
en.51:37: And We left in it a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
en.51:38: And in Moses. We sent him to Pharaoh with a clear authority.
en.51:39: But he turned away with his warlords, and said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
en.51:40: So We seized him and his troops, and threw them into the sea, and He was to blame.
en.51:41: And in Aad. We unleashed against them the devastating wind.
en.51:42: It spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like decayed ruins.
en.51:43: And in Thamood. They were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
en.51:44: But they defied the command of their Lord, so the lightning struck them as they looked on.
en.51:45: They could not rise up, nor could they find help.
en.51:46: And before that, the people of Noah. They were immoral people.
en.51:47: We constructed the universe with power, and We are expanding it.
en.51:48: And the earth—We spread it out—How well We prepared it!
en.51:49: We created all things in pairs, so that you may reflect and ponder.
en.51:50: “So flee towards God. I am to you from Him a clear warner.”
en.51:51: “And do not set up any other god with God. I am to you from Him a clear warner.”
en.51:52: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them, but they said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
en.51:53: Did they recommend it to one another? In fact, they are rebellious people.
en.51:54: So turn away from them; you are not to blame.
en.51:55: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.
en.51:56: I did not create the jinn and the humans except to worship Me.
en.51:57: I need no livelihood from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
en.51:58: God is the Provider, the One with Power, the Strong.
en.51:59: Those who do wrong will have their turn, like the turn of their counterparts, so let them not rush Me.
en.51:60: So woe to those who disbelieve because of that Day of theirs which they are promised.
en.52:7: The punishment of your Lord is coming.
en.52:8: There is nothing to avert it.
en.52:9: On the Day when the heaven sways in agitation.
en.52:10: And the mountains go into motion.
en.52:11: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
en.52:13: The Day when they are shoved into the Fire of the Inferno forcefully.
en.52:14: “This is the Fire which you used to deny.
en.52:15: Is this magic, or do you not see?
en.52:16: Burn in it. Whether you are patient, or impatient, it is the same for you. You are only being repaid for what you used to do.”
en.52:17: But the virtuous will be amid gardens and bliss.
en.52:18: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord has spared them the suffering of the Inferno.
en.52:19: Eat and drink happily, for what you used to do.
en.52:20: Relaxing on luxurious furnishings; and We will couple them with gorgeous spouses.
en.52:21: Those who believed and their offspring followed them in faith—We will unite them with their offspring, and We will not deprive them of any of their works. Every person is hostage to what he has earned.
en.52:22: And We will supply them with fruit, and meat; such as they desire.
en.52:23: They will exchange therein a cup; wherein is neither harm, nor sin.
en.52:24: Serving them will be youths like hidden pearls.
en.52:25: And they will approach one another, inquiring.
en.52:26: They will say, “Before this, we were fearful for our families.
en.52:27: But God blessed us, and spared us the agony of the Fiery Winds.
en.52:28: Before this, we used to pray to Him. He is the Good, the Compassionate.”
en.52:29: So remind. By the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.
en.52:30: Or do they say, “A poet—we await for him a calamity of time”?
en.52:31: Say, “Go on waiting; I will be waiting with you.”
en.52:32: Or is it that their dreams compel them to this? Or are they aggressive people?
en.52:33: Or do they say, “He made it up”? Rather, they do not believe.
en.52:34: So let them produce a discourse like it, if they are truthful.
en.52:35: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?
en.52:36: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain.
en.52:37: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers?
en.52:38: Or do they have a stairway by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear proof.
en.52:39: Or for Him the daughters, and for you the sons?
en.52:40: Or do you demand a payment from them, and they are burdened by debt?
en.52:41: Or do they know the future, and they are writing it down?
en.52:42: Or are they planning a conspiracy? The conspiracy will befall the those who deny the truth.
en.52:43: Or do they have a god besides God? God transcends what they associate.
en.52:44: Even if they were to see lumps of the sky falling down, they would say, “A mass of clouds.”
en.52:45: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be stunned.
en.52:46: The Day when their ploys will avail them nothing; and they will not be helped.
en.52:47: For those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that; but most of them do not know.
en.52:48: So patiently await the decision of your Lord, for you are before Our Eyes; and proclaim the praises of your Lord when you arise.
en.52:49: And glorify Him during the night, and at the receding of the stars.
en.53:1: By the star as it goes down.
en.53:2: Your friend has not gone astray, nor has he erred.
en.53:3: Nor does he speak out of desire.
en.53:4: It is but a revelation revealed.
en.53:5: Taught to him by the Extremely Powerful.
en.53:6: The one of vigor. He settled.
en.53:7: While he was at the highest horizon.
en.53:8: Then he came near, and hovered around.
en.53:9: He was within two bows’ length, or closer.
en.53:10: Then He revealed to His servant what He revealed.
en.53:11: The heart did not lie about what it saw.
en.53:12: Will you dispute with him concerning what he saw?
en.53:13: He saw him on another descent.
en.53:14: At the Lotus Tree of the Extremity.
en.53:15: Near which is the Garden of Paradise of Repose.
en.53:16: As there covered the Lotus Tree what covered it.
en.53:17: The sight did not waver, nor did it exceed.
en.53:18: He saw some of the Great Signs of his Lord.
en.53:19: Have you considered al-Lat and al-Uzza?
en.53:20: And Manat, the third one, the other?
en.53:21: Are you to have the males, and He the females?
en.53:23: These are nothing but names, which you have devised, you and your ancestors, for which God sent down no authority. They follow nothing but assumptions, and what the ego desires, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
en.53:24: Or is the human being to have whatever he desires?
en.53:25: To God belong the Last and the First.
en.53:26: How many an angel is there in the heavens whose intercession avails nothing, except after God gives permission to whomever He wills, and approves?
en.53:27: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the divine messengers the names of females.
en.53:28: They have no knowledge of that. They only follow assumptions, and assumptions are no substitute for the truth.
en.53:29: So avoid him who has turned away from Our remembrance, and desires nothing but the present life.
en.53:30: That is the extent of their knowledge. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who has accepted guidance.
en.53:31: To God belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and recompense those who do good with the best.
en.53:32: Those who avoid gross sins and indecencies—except for minor lapses—your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well, ever since He created you from the earth, and ever since you were embryos in your mothers’ wombs. So do not acclaim your own virtue; He is fully aware of the virtuous.
en.53:33: Have you considered him who turned away?
en.53:34: And gave a little, and held back?
en.53:35: Does he possess knowledge of the unseen, and can therefore foresee?
en.53:36: Or was he not informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses?
en.53:38: That no soul bears the burdens of another soul.
en.53:39: And that the human being attains only what he strives for.
en.53:40: And that his efforts will be witnessed.
en.53:41: Then he will be rewarded for it the fullest reward.
en.53:42: And that to your Lord is the finality.
en.53:43: And that it is He who causes laughter and weeping.
en.53:44: And that it is He who gives death and life.
en.53:45: And that it is He who created the two kinds—the male and the female.
en.53:46: From a sperm drop, when emitted.
en.53:47: And that upon Him is the next existence.
en.53:48: And that it is He who enriches and impoverishes.
en.53:49: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.
en.53:50: And that it is He who destroyed the first Aad.
en.53:52: And the people of Noah before that; for they were most unjust and most oppressive.
en.53:53: And He toppled the ruined cities.
en.53:54: And covered them with whatever covered them.
en.53:55: So which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
en.53:56: This is a warning, just like the first warnings.
en.53:58: None besides God can unveil it.
en.53:59: Do you marvel at this discourse?
en.53:60: And laugh, and do not weep?
en.53:62: So bow down to God, and worship!
en.54:1: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.
en.54:2: Yet whenever they see a miracle, they turn away, and say, “Continuous magic.”
en.54:3: They lied, and followed their opinions, but everything has its time.
en.54:4: And there came to them news containing a deterrent.
en.54:5: Profound wisdom—but warnings are of no avail.
en.54:6: So turn away from them. On the Day when the Caller calls to something terrible.
en.54:7: Their eyes humiliated, they will emerge from the graves, as if they were swarming locusts.
en.54:8: Scrambling towards the Caller, the those who deny the truth will say, “This is a difficult Day.”
en.54:9: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved. They rejected Our servant, and said, “Crazy,” and he was rebuked.
en.54:10: So he appealed to his Lord, “I am overwhelmed, so help me.”
en.54:11: So We opened the floodgates of heaven with water pouring down.
en.54:12: And We made the earth burst with springs, and the waters met for a purpose already destined.
en.54:13: And We carried him on a craft of planks and nails.
en.54:14: Sailing before Our eyes; a reward for him who was rejected.
en.54:15: And We left it as a sign. Is there anyone who would take heed?
en.54:16: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
en.54:17: We made the Quran easy to learn. Is there anyone who would learn?
en.54:18: Aad denied the truth. So how were My punishment and My warnings?
en.54:19: We unleashed upon them a screaming wind, on a day of unrelenting misery.
en.54:20: Plucking the people away, as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
en.54:21: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
en.54:22: We made the Quran easy to remember. Is there anyone who would remember?
en.54:24: They said, “Are we to follow one of us, a human being? We would then go astray, and end up in the Inferno.
en.54:25: Was the message given to him, out of all of us? In fact, he is a wicked liar.”
en.54:26: They will know tomorrow who the wicked liar is.
en.54:27: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and be patient.
en.54:28: And inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each share of drink made available.
en.54:29: But they called their friend, and he dared, and he slaughtered.
en.54:30: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
en.54:31: We sent against them a single Scream, and they became like crushed hay.
en.54:32: We made the Quran easy to understand. Is there anyone who would understand?
en.54:33: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
en.54:34: We unleashed upon them a shower of stones, except for the family of Lot; We rescued them at dawn.
en.54:35: A blessing from Us. Thus We reward the thankful.
en.54:36: He had warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warnings.
en.54:37: They even lusted for his guest, so We obliterated their eyes. “So taste My punishment and My warnings.”
en.54:38: Early morning brought upon them enduring punishment.
en.54:39: So taste My punishment and My warnings.
en.54:40: We made the Quran easy to memorize. Is there anyone who would memorize?
en.54:41: The warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh.
en.54:42: They rejected Our signs, all of them, so We seized them—the seizure of an Almighty Omnipotent.
en.54:43: Are your unbelievers better than all those? Or do you have immunity in the scriptures?
en.54:44: Or do they say, “We are united, and we will be victorious”?
en.54:45: The multitude will be defeated, and they will turn their backs.
en.54:46: The Hour is their appointed time—the Hour is more disastrous, and most bitter.
en.54:47: The wicked are in confusion and madness.
en.54:48: The Day when they are dragged upon their faces into the Fire: “Taste the touch of Saqar.”
en.54:49: Everything We created is precisely measured.
en.54:50: And Our command is but once, like the twinkling of an eye.
en.54:51: We have destroyed your likes. Is there anyone who would ponder?
en.54:52: Everything they have done is in the Books.
en.54:53: Everything, small or large, is written down.
en.54:54: The righteous will be amidst gardens and rivers.
en.54:55: In an assembly of virtue, in the presence of an Omnipotent King.
en.55:5: The sun and the moon move according to plan.
en.55:6: And the stars and the trees prostrate themselves.
en.55:7: And the sky, He raised; and He set up the balance.
en.55:8: So do not transgress in the balance.
en.55:9: But maintain the weights with justice, and do not violate the balance.
en.55:10: And the earth; He set up for the creatures.
en.55:11: In it are fruits, and palms in clusters.
en.55:12: And grains in the blades, and fragrant plants.
en.55:13: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:14: He created man from hard clay, like bricks.
en.55:15: And created the jinn from a fusion of fire.
en.55:16: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:17: Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests.
en.55:18: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:19: He merged the two seas, converging together.
en.55:20: Between them is a barrier, which they do not overrun.
en.55:21: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:22: From them emerge pearls and coral.
en.55:23: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:24: His are the ships, raised above the sea like landmarks.
en.55:25: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:27: But will remain the Presence of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Splendor.
en.55:28: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:29: Everyone in the heavens and the earth asks Him. Every day He is managing.
en.55:30: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:31: We will attend to you, O prominent two.
en.55:32: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:33: O society of jinn and humans! If you can pass through the bounds of the heavens and the earth, go ahead and pass. But you will not pass except with authorization.
en.55:34: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:35: You will be bombarded with flares of fire and brass, and you will not succeed.
en.55:36: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:37: When the sky splits apart, and becomes rose, like paint.
en.55:38: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:39: On that Day, no human and no jinn will be asked about his sins.
en.55:40: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:41: The guilty will be recognized by their marks; they will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
en.55:42: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:43: This is the Inferno that the guilty denied.
en.55:44: They circulate between it and between a seething bath.
en.55:45: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:46: But for him who feared the standing of his Lord are two gardens.
en.55:47: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:49: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:50: In them are two flowing springs.
en.55:51: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:52: In them are fruits of every kind, in pairs.
en.55:53: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:54: Reclining on furnishings lined with brocade, and the fruits of the two gardens are near at hand.
en.55:55: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:56: In them are maidens restraining their glances, untouched before by any man or jinn.
en.55:57: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:58: As though they were rubies and corals.
en.55:59: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:60: Is the reward of goodness anything but goodness?
en.55:61: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:62: And beneath them are two gardens.
en.55:63: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:65: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:66: In them are two gushing springs.
en.55:67: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:68: In them are fruits, and date-palms, and pomegranates.
en.55:69: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:70: In them are good and beautiful ones.
en.55:71: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:73: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:74: Whom no human has touched before, nor jinn.
en.55:75: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:76: Reclining on green cushions, and exquisite carpets.
en.55:77: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
en.55:78: Blessed be the name of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Splendor.
en.56:2: Of its occurrence, there is no denial.
en.56:4: When the earth is shaken with a shock.
en.56:5: And the mountains are crushed and crumbled.
en.56:8: Those on the Right—what of those on the Right?
en.56:9: And those on the Left—what of those on the Left?
en.56:14: And a small band from the latecomers.
en.56:16: Reclining on them, facing one another.
en.56:17: Serving them will be immortalized youth.
en.56:18: With cups, pitchers, and sparkling drinks.
en.56:19: Causing them neither headache, nor intoxication.
en.56:21: And meat of birds that they may desire.
en.56:24: As a reward for what they used to do.
en.56:25: Therein they will hear no nonsense, and no accusations.
en.56:27: And those on the Right—what of those on the Right?
en.56:35: We have created them of special creation.
en.56:40: And a throng from the latecomers.
en.56:41: And those on the Left—what of those on the Left?
en.56:42: Amid searing wind and boiling water.
en.56:43: And a shadow of thick smoke.
en.56:45: They had lived before that in luxury.
en.56:46: And they used to persist in immense wrongdoing.
en.56:47: And they used to say, “When we are dead and turned into dust and bones, are we to be resurrected?
en.56:50: Will be gathered for the appointment of a familiar Day.”
en.56:51: Then you, you misguided, who deny the truth.
en.56:52: Will be eating from the Tree of Bitterness.
en.56:53: Will be filling your bellies with it.
en.56:54: Will be drinking on top of it boiling water.
en.56:56: That is their hospitality on the Day of Retribution.
en.56:57: We created you—if only you would believe!
en.56:58: Have you seen what you ejaculate?
en.56:59: Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator?
en.56:60: We have decreed death among you, and We will not be outstripped.
en.56:61: In replacing you with your likes, and transforming you into what you do not know.
en.56:62: You have known the first formation; if only you would remember.
en.56:63: Have you seen what you cultivate?
en.56:64: Is it you who make it grow, or are We the Grower?
en.56:65: If We will, We can turn it into rubble; then you will lament.
en.56:68: Have you seen the water you drink?
en.56:69: Is it you who sent it down from the clouds, or are We the Sender?
en.56:70: If We will, We can make it salty. Will you not be thankful?
en.56:71: Have you seen the fire you kindle?
en.56:72: Is it you who produce its tree, or are We the Producer?
en.56:73: We have made it a reminder, and a comfort for the users.
en.56:74: So glorify the Name of your Great Lord.
en.56:75: I swear by the locations of the stars.
en.56:76: It is an oath, if you only knew, that is tremendous.
en.56:79: None can grasp it except the purified.
en.56:80: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
en.56:81: Is it this discourse that you take so lightly?
en.56:82: And you make it your livelihood to deny it?
en.56:83: So when it has reached the throat.
en.56:85: We are nearer to it than you are, but you do not see.
en.56:86: If you are not held to account.
en.56:87: Then bring it back, if you are truthful.
en.56:88: But if he is one of those brought near.
en.56:89: Then happiness, and flowers, and Garden of Delights.
en.56:90: And if he is one of those on the Right.
en.56:91: Then, “Peace upon you,” from those on the Right.
en.56:92: But if he is one of the deniers, the mistaken.
en.56:96: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Magnificent
en.57:1: Glorifying God is everything in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Wise.
en.57:2: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things.
en.57:3: He is the First and the Last, and the Outer and the Inner, and He has knowledge of all things.
en.57:4: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then settled over the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky, and what ascends to it. And He is with you wherever you may be. God is Seeing of everything you do.
en.57:5: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and to God all matters are referred.
