en.57:6: He merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night; and He knows what the hearts contains.
en.57:7: Believe in God and His Envoy, and spend from what He made you inherit. Those among you who believe and give will have a great reward.
en.57:8: What is the matter with you that you do not believe in God, when the Envoy calls you to believe in your Lord, and He has received a pledge from you, if you are believers?
en.57:9: It is He who sends down upon His servant clear revelations, to bring you out of darkness into the light. God is Gentle towards you, Most Compassionate.
en.57:10: And why is it that you do not spend in the cause of God, when to God belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who contributed before the conquest, and fought. Those are higher in rank than those who contributed afterwards, and fought. But God promises both a good reward. God is Well Experienced in what you do.
en.57:11: Who is he who will lend God a loan of goodness, that He may double it for him, and will have a generous reward?
en.57:12: On the Day when you see the believing men and believing women—their light radiating ahead of them, and to their right: “Good news for you today: gardens beneath which rivers flow, dwelling therein forever. That is the great triumph.”
en.57:13: On the Day when the hypocritical men and hypocritical women will say to those who believed, “Wait for us; let us absorb some of your light.” It will be said, “Go back behind you, and seek light.” A wall will be raised between them, in which is a door; within it is mercy, and outside it is agony.
en.57:14: They will call to them, “Were we not with you?” They will say, “Yes, but you cheated your souls, and waited, and doubted, and became deluded by wishful thinking, until the command of God arrived; and arrogance deceived you regarding God.”
en.57:15: “Therefore, today no ransom will be accepted from you, nor from those who disbelieved. The Fire is your refuge. It is your companion—what an evil fate!”
en.57:16: Is it not time for those who believe to surrender their hearts to the remembrance of God, and to the truth that has come down, and not be like those who were given the Scripture previously, but time became prolonged for them, so their hearts hardened, and many of them are sinners?
en.57:17: Know that God revives the earth after its death. We thus explain the revelations for you, so that you may understand.
en.57:18: The charitable men and charitable women, who have loaned God a loan of righteousness—it will be multiplied for them, and for them is a generous reward.
en.57:19: Those who believe in God and His messengers—these are the sincere and the witnesses with their Lord; they will have their reward and their light. But as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations—these are the inmates of the Blaze.
en.57:20: Know that the worldly life is only play, and distraction, and glitter, and boasting among you, and rivalry in wealth and children. It is like a rainfall that produces plants, and delights the those who deny the truth. But then it withers, and you see it yellowing, and then it becomes debris. While in the Hereafter there is severe agony, and forgiveness from God, and acceptance. The life of this world is nothing but enjoyment of vanity.
en.57:21: Race towards forgiveness from your Lord; and a Garden as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers. That is the grace of God; He bestows it on whomever He wills. God is the Possessor of Immense Grace.
en.57:22: No calamity occurs on earth, or in your souls, but it is in a Book, even before We make it happen. That is easy for God.
en.57:23: That you may not sorrow over what eludes you, nor exult over what He has given you. God does not love the proud snob.
en.57:24: Those who are stingy, and induce people to be stingy. Whoever turns away—God is the Independent, the Praiseworthy.
en.57:25: We sent Our messengers with the clear proofs, and We sent down with them the Scripture and the Balance, that humanity may uphold justice. And We sent down iron, in which is violent force, and benefits for humanity. That God may know who supports Him and His messengers invisibly. God is Strong and Powerful.
en.57:26: We sent Noah and Abraham, and established in their line Prophethood and the Scripture. Some of them are guided, but many of them are sinners.
en.57:27: Then We sent in their wake Our messengers, and followed up with Jesus son of Mary, and We gave him the Gospel, and instilled in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy. But as for the monasticism which they invented—We did not ordain it for them—only to seek God’s approval. But they did not observe it with its due observance. So We gave those of them who believed their reward, but many of them are sinful.
en.57:28: O you who believe! Fear God, and believe in His Envoy: He will give you a double portion of His mercy, and will give you a light by which you walk, and will forgive you. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.57:29: That the People of the Scripture may know that they have no power whatsoever over God’s grace, and that all grace is in God’s hand; He gives it to whomever He wills. God is Possessor of Great Grace.
en.58:1: God has heard the statement of she who argued with you concerning her husband, as she complained to God. God heard your conversation. God is Hearing and Seeing.
en.58:2: Those of you who estrange their wives by equating them with their mothers—they are not their mothers. Their mothers are none else but those who gave birth to them. What they say is evil, and a blatant lie. But God is Pardoning and Forgiving.
en.58:3: Those who estrange their wives by equating them with their mothers, then go back on what they said, must set free a slave before they may touch one another. To this you are exhorted, and God is well aware of what you do.
en.58:4: But whoever cannot find the means must fast for two consecutive months before they may touch one another. And if he is unable, then the feeding of sixty needy people. This, in order that you affirm your faith in God and His Envoy. These are the ordinances of God. The unbelievers will have a painful punishment.
en.58:5: Those who oppose God and His Envoy will be subdued, as those before them were subdued. We have revealed clear messages. The unbelievers will have a demeaning punishment.
en.58:6: On the Day when God resurrects them all, and informs them of what they did. God has kept count of it, but they have forgotten it. God is Witness over everything.
en.58:7: Do you not realize that God knows everything in the heavens and everything on earth? There is no secret counsel between three, but He is their fourth; nor between five, but He is their sixth; nor less than that, nor more, but He is with them wherever they may be. Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. God has knowledge of everything.
en.58:8: Have you noted those who were prohibited from conspiring secretly, but then reverted to what they were prohibited from? They conspire to commit sin, and aggression, and defiance of the Envoy. And when they come to you, they greet you with a greeting that God never greeted you with. And they say within themselves, “Why does God not punish us for what we say?” the Inferno is enough for them. They will roast in it. What a miserable destiny!
en.58:9: O you who believe! When you converse secretly, do not converse in sin, and aggression, and disobedience of the Envoy; but converse in virtue and piety; And fear God, to Whom you will be gathered.
en.58:10: Conspiracies are from the Adversary, that he may dishearten those who believe; but he will not harm them in the least, except by leave of God. So let the believers put their trust in God.
en.58:11: O you who believe! When you are told to make room in your gatherings, make room; God will make room for you. And when you are told to disperse, disperse. God elevates those among you who believe, and those given knowledge, many steps. God is Aware of what you do.
en.58:12: O you who believe! When you converse privately with the Envoy, offer something in charity before your conversation. That is better for you, and purer. But if you do not find the means—God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.58:13: Are you reluctant to offer charity before your conversation? If you do not do so, and God pardons you, then perform the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh), and give alms, and obey God and His Envoy. God is Aware of what you do.
en.58:14: Have you considered those who befriended a people with whom God has become angry? They are not of you, nor of them. And they swear to a lie while they know.
en.58:15: God has prepared for them a terrible punishment. Evil is what they used to do.
en.58:16: They took their oaths as a screen, and prevented others from God’s path. They will have a shameful punishment.
en.58:17: Neither their possessions nor their children will avail them anything against God. These are the inhabitants of the Fire, dwelling therein forever.
en.58:18: On the Day when God will resurrect them altogether—they will swear to Him, as they swear to you, thinking that they are upon something. Indeed, they themselves are the liars.
en.58:19: the Adversary has taken hold of them, and so has caused them to forget the remembrance of God. These are the partisans of the Adversary. Indeed, it is the Adversary’s partisans who are the losers.
en.58:20: Those who oppose God and His Envoy are among the lowliest.
en.58:21: God has written: “I will certainly prevail, I and My messengers.” God is Strong and Mighty.
en.58:22: You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day, loving those who oppose God and His Envoy, even if they were their parents, or their children, or their siblings, or their close relatives. These—He has inscribed faith in their hearts, and has supported them with a spirit from Him. And He will admit them into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will dwell forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. These are the partisans of God. Indeed, it is God’s partisans who are the successful.
en.59:1: Glorifying God is all that exists in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Most Wise.
en.59:2: It is He who evicted those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first mobilization. You did not think they would leave, and they thought their fortresses would protect them from God. But God came at them from where they never expected, and threw terror into their hearts. They wrecked their homes with their own hands, and by the hands of the believers. Therefore, take a lesson, O you who have insight.
en.59:3: Had God not decreed exile for them, He would have punished them in this life. But in the Hereafter they will have the punishment of the Fire.
en.59:4: That is because they opposed God and His Envoy. Whoever opposes God—God is stern in retribution.
en.59:5: Whether you cut down a tree, or leave it standing on its trunk, it is by God’s will. He will surely disgrace the sinners.
en.59:6: Whatever God has bestowed upon His Envoy from them; you spurred neither horse nor camel for them, but God gives authority to His messengers over whomever He will. God is Able to do all things.
en.59:7: Whatever God restored to His Envoy from the inhabitants of the villages belongs to God, and to the Envoy, and to the relatives, and to the orphans, and to the poor, and to the wayfarer; so that it may not circulate solely between the wealthy among you. Whatever the Envoy gives you, accept it; and whatever he forbids you, abstain from it. And fear God. God is severe in punishment.
en.59:8: To the poor refugees who were driven out of their homes and their possessions, as they sought the favor of God and His approval, and came to the aid of God and His Envoy. These are the sincere.
en.59:9: And those who, before them, had settled in the homeland, and had accepted faith. They love those who emigrated to them, and find no hesitation in their hearts in helping them. They give them priority over themselves, even if they themselves are needy. Whoever is protected from his natural greed—it is they who are the successful.
en.59:10: And those who came after them, saying, “Our Lord, forgive us, and our brethren who preceded us in faith, and leave no malice in our hearts towards those who believe. Our Lord, You are Clement and Merciful.”
en.59:11: Have you not considered those who act hypocritically? They say to their brethren who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, “If you are evicted, we will leave with you, and will not obey anyone against you; and should anyone fight you, we will certainly support you.” But God bears witness that they are liars.
en.59:12: If they are evicted, they will not leave with them; and if anyone fights them, they will not support them; and if they go to their aid, they will turn their backs and flee; then they will receive no support.
en.59:13: Fear of you is more intense in their hearts than God-consciousness (Taqwā). That is because they are a people who do not understand.
en.59:14: They will not fight you all together except from fortified strongholds, or from behind walls. Their hostility towards each other is severe. You would think they are united, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not understand.
en.59:15: Like those shortly before them. They experienced the consequences of their decisions. For them is a painful punishment.
en.59:16: Like the devil, when he says to the human being, “Disbelieve.” But when he has disbelieved, he says, “I am innocent of you; I fear God, the Lord of the Worlds.”
en.59:17: The ultimate end for both of them is the Fire, where they will dwell forever. Such is the requital for the evildoers.
en.59:18: O you who believe! Fear God, and let every soul consider what it has forwarded for the morrow, and fear God. God is Aware of what you do.
en.59:19: And do not be like those who forgot God, so He made them forget themselves. These are the sinners.
en.59:20: Not equal are the inhabitants of the Fire and the inhabitants of the eternal Gardens. It is the inhabitants of the eternal Gardens who are the winners.
en.59:21: Had We sent this Quran down on a mountain, you would have seen it trembling, crumbling in awe of God. These parables We cite for the people, so that they may reflect.
en.59:22: He is God. There is no god but He, the Knower of secrets and declarations. He is the Compassionate, the Merciful.
en.59:23: He is God; besides Whom there is no god; the Sovereign, the Holy, the Peace-Giver, the Faith-Giver, the Overseer, the Almighty, the Omnipotent, the Overwhelming. Glory be to God, beyond what they associate.
en.59:24: He is God; the Creator, the Maker, the Designer. His are the Most Beautiful Names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him. He is the Majestic, the Wise.
en.6:1: Praise be to God, Who created the heavens and the earth, and made the darkness and the light. Yet those who disbelieve ascribe equals to their Lord.
en.6:2: It is He who created you from clay, then decided a term—a term determined by him. Yet you doubt.
en.6:3: He is God in the heavens and the earth. He knows what you keep secret and what you make public; and He knows what you earn.
en.6:4: Not one of their Lord’s signs comes to them, but they turn away from it.
en.6:5: They denied the truth when it has come to them; but soon will reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.
en.6:6: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them? We had established them on earth more firmly than We established you, and We sent the clouds pouring down abundant rain on them, and We made rivers flow beneath them. But We destroyed them for their sins, and established other civilizations after them.
en.6:7: Had We sent down upon you a book on paper, and they had touched it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said, “This is nothing but plain magic.”
en.6:8: And they say, “Why was an angel not sent down to him.” Had We sent down an angel, the matter would have been settled, and they would not have been reprieved.
en.6:9: Had We made him an angel, We would have made him a man, and confused them when they are already confused.
en.6:10: Messengers before you were ridiculed, but those who mocked them became besieged by what they ridiculed.
en.6:11: Say, “Travel the earth and observe the final fate of the deniers.”
en.6:12: Say, “To whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth?” Say, “To God.” He has inscribed for Himself mercy. He will gather you to the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt. Those who lost their souls do not believe.
en.6:13: To Him belongs whatever rests in the night and the day. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
en.6:14: Say, “Shall I take for myself a protector other than God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, and He feeds and is not fed?” Say, “I am instructed to be the first of those who submit.” And do not be among the idolaters.
en.6:15: Say, “I fear, should I defy my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day.”
en.6:16: Whoever is spared on that Day—He had mercy on him. That is the clear victory.
en.6:17: If God touches you with adversity, none can remove it except He. And if He touches you with good—He is Capable of everything.
en.6:18: He is the Supreme over His servants. He is the Wise, the Expert.
en.6:19: Say, “What thing is more solemn in testimony?” Say, “God is Witness between you and me. This Quran was revealed to me, that I may warn you with it, and whomever it may reach. Do you indeed testify that there are other gods with God?” Say, “I myself do not testify.” Say, “He is but One God, and I am innocent of your idolatry.”
en.6:20: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their own children; but those who have lost their souls do not believe.
en.6:21: Who does greater wrong than someone who fabricates lies against God, or denies His revelations? The evildoers will not succeed.
en.6:22: On the Day when We gather them all together, then say to the idolaters, “Where are your idols, those you used to claim?”
en.6:23: Then their only argument will be to say, “By God, our Lord, we were not idolaters.”
en.6:24: Look how they lied to themselves. And what they invented deserted them.
en.6:25: Among them are those who listen to you; but We place covers over their hearts, to prevent them from understanding it, and heaviness in their ears. Even if they see every sign, they will not believe in it. Until, when they come to you, to argue with you, those who disbelieve will say, “These are nothing but myths of the ancients.”
en.6:26: They keep others from it, and avoid it themselves; but they ruin only their own souls, and they do not realize.
en.6:27: If only you could see, when they are made to stand before the Fire; they will say, “If only we could be sent back, and not reject the revelations of our Lord, and be among the faithful.”
en.6:28: What they used to conceal before will become clear to them. And even if they were sent back, they would revert to what they were forbidden. They are liars.
en.6:29: And they say, “There is nothing but our life in this world, and we will not be resurrected.”
en.6:30: If only you could see, when they are stationed before their Lord. He will say, “Is this not real?” They will say, “Yes indeed, by our Lord.” He will say, “Then taste the torment for having disbelieved.”
en.6:31: Losers are those who deny the encounter with God. Then, when the Hour comes upon them suddenly, they will say, “Alas for us, how we have neglected it.” And they will carry their burdens on their backs—evil is what they carry.
en.6:32: The life of this world is nothing but game and distraction, but the Home of the Hereafter is better for those who are righteous. Do you not understand?
en.6:33: We know that what they say grieves you. It is not you they reject, but it is God's revelations that the wicked deny.
en.6:34: Other messengers before you were rejected, but they endured rejection and persecution until Our help came to them. There can be no change to God’s words. News of the Messengers has already reached you.
en.6:35: If you find their rejection hard to bear, then if you can, seek a tunnel into the earth, or a stairway into the heaven, and bring them a sign. Had God willed, He could have gathered them to guidance. So do not be of the ignorant.
en.6:36: Only those who listen will respond. As for the dead, God will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned.
en.6:37: And they say, “If only a sign could come down to him from his Lord.” Say, “God is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know.”
en.6:38: There is no animal on land, nor a bird flying with its wings, but are communities like you. We neglected nothing in the Scripture. Then to their Lord they will be gathered.
en.6:39: Those who reject Our revelations are deaf and dumb, in total darkness. Whomever God wills, He leaves astray; and whomever He wills, He sets on a straight path.
en.6:40: Say, “Have you considered? if God's punishment came upon you, or the Hour overtook you, would you call upon any other than God, if you are sincere?”
en.6:41: In fact, it is Him you will call upon; and if He wills, he will remove what you called Him for, and you will forget what you idolized.
en.6:42: We sent messengers to communities before you, and We afflicted them with suffering and hardship, that they may humble themselves.
en.6:43: If only, when Our calamity came upon them, they humbled themselves. But their hearts hardened, and the Adversary made their deeds appear good to them.
en.6:44: Then, when they disregarded what they were reminded of, We opened for them the gates of all things. Until, when they delighted in what they were given, We seized them suddenly; and at once, they were in despair.
en.6:45: Thus the last remnant of the people who did wrong was cut off. And praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds.
en.6:46: Say, “Have you considered? If God took away your hearing and your sight, and set a seal on your hearts, what god other than God would restore them to you?” Note how We explain the revelations in various ways, yet they still turn away.
en.6:47: Say, “Have you considered? if God's punishment descended on you suddenly or gradually, would any be destroyed except the wrongdoing people?”
en.6:48: We sent the messengers only as bearers of good news and as warners. Those who believe and reform have nothing to fear, nor shall they grieve.
en.6:49: But as for those who reject Our revelations, torment will afflict them because of their defiance.
en.6:50: Say, “I do not say to you that I possess the treasuries of God, nor do I know the future, nor do I say to you that I am an angel. I only follow what is inspired to me.” Say, “Are the blind and the seeing alike? Do you not think?”
en.6:51: And warn with it those who fear to be gathered before their Lord—they have no protector or intercessor apart from him—perhaps they will grow in piety.
en.6:52: And do not drive away those who call upon their Lord, morning and evening, seeking His attention. You are not accountable for them in any way, nor are they accountable for you in any way. If you drive them away, you would be one of the unjust.
en.6:53: Thus We try some of them by means of others, that they may say, “Are these the ones whom God has favored from among us?” Is God not aware of the appreciative?
en.6:54: When those who believe in Our revelations come to you, say, “Peace be upon you, your Lord has prescribed mercy for Himself. Whoever among you does wrong out of ignorance, and then repents afterwards and reforms—He is Forgiving and Merciful.”
en.6:55: Thus We explain the revelations, and expose the path of the unrighteous.
en.6:56: Say, “I am forbidden from worshiping those you pray to besides God.” Say, “I will not follow your desires; else I would be lost and not be of those guided.”
en.6:57: Say, “I stand on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have rejected Him. I do not possess what you seek me to hasten; the decision belongs solely to God. He states the truth, and He is the Best of Judges.”
en.6:58: Say, “If I possessed what you seek me to hasten, the matter between you and me would have been settled. God is well aware of the unjust.”
en.6:59: With Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except He. And He knows everything on land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but He knows it; and there is not a single grain in the darkness of earth, nor is there anything wet or dry, but is in a clear record.
en.6:60: It is He Who takes you by night, and He knows what you earn by day. Then He raises you up in it, until a fixed term is fulfilled. Then to Him is your return, then He will inform you of what you used to do.
en.6:61: He is the Conqueror over His servants, and He sends guardians over you, until, when death overtakes one of you, Our envoys take him away, and they never fail.
en.6:62: Then they are brought back to God, their True Master. Unquestionably, His is the judgment, and He is the Swiftest of reckoners.
en.6:63: Say, “Who delivers you from the darkness of land and sea?” You call upon Him humbly and inwardly: “If He delivers us from this, We will surely be among the thankful.”
en.6:64: Say, “It is God who delivers you from it, and from every disaster. Yet then you associate others with Him.”
en.6:65: Say, “He is Able to send upon you an affliction, from above you, or from under your feet. Or He can divide you into factions, and make you taste the violence of one another. Note how We explain the revelations, so that they may understand.”
en.6:66: But your people rejected it, though it is the truth. Say, “I am not responsible for you.”
en.6:67: For every happening is a finality, and you will surely know.
en.6:68: When you encounter those who gossip about Our revelations, turn away from them, until they engage in another topic. But should the Adversary make you forget, do not sit after the recollection with the wicked people.
en.6:69: The righteous are in no way accountable for them; it is only a reminder, that they may be careful.
en.6:70: So leave alone those who take their religion for play and pastime, and whom the worldly life has deceived. But remind with it, lest a soul becomes damned on account of what it has earned. It has no helper or intercessor besides God. Even if it offers every equivalent, none will be accepted from it. These are the ones who are delivered to perdition by their actions. They will have a drink of scalding water, and a painful punishment, because they used to disbelieve.
en.6:71: Say, “Shall we invoke besides God something that can neither benefit us nor harm us, and turn back on our heels after God has guided us; like someone seduced by the devils and confused on earth, who has friends calling him to guidance: 'Come to us'?” Say, “The guidance of God is the guidance, and we are commanded to surrender to the Lord of the Universe.”
en.6:72: “And to perform the prayers, and to revere Him; it is to Him that you will be gathered.”
en.6:73: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in truth. On the Day when He says: “Be,” it will be. His saying is the truth, and His is the sovereignty on the Day when the trumpet is blown. The Knower of secrets and declarations. He is the Wise, the Expert.
en.6:74: Abraham said to his father Azar, “Do you take idols for gods? I see that you and your people are in evident error.”
en.6:75: Thus We showed Abraham the empire of the heavens and the earth, that he might be one of those with certainty.
en.6:76: When the night fell over him, he saw a planet. He said, “This is my lord.” But when it set, he said, “I do not love those that set.”
en.6:77: Then, when he saw the moon rising, he said, “This is my lord.” But when it set, he said, “If my Lord does not guide me, I will be one of the erring people.”
en.6:78: Then, when he saw the sun rising, he said, “This is my lord, this is bigger.” But when it set, he said, “O my people, I am innocent of your idolatry.
en.6:79: I have directed my attention towards Him Who created the heavens and the earth—a monotheist—and I am not of the idolaters.”
en.6:80: And his people argued with him. He said, “Do you argue with me about God, when He has guided me? I do not fear what you associate with Him, unless my Lord wills it. My Lord comprehends all things in knowledge. Will you not reconsider?
en.6:81: And why should I fear those you associate with Him, and you do not fear associating others with God for which He sent down to you no authority? Which side is more entitled to security, if you are aware?”
en.6:82: Those who believe, and do not obscure their faith with wrongdoing—those will have security, and they are guided.
en.6:83: That was Our argument which We gave to Abraham against his people. We elevate by degrees whomever We will. Your Lord is Wise and Informed.
en.6:84: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob—each of them We guided. And We guided Noah previously; and from his descendants David, and Solomon, and Job, and Joseph, and Moses, and Aaron. Thus We reward the virtuous.
en.6:85: And Zechariah, and John, and Jesus, and Elias—every one of them was of the upright.
en.6:86: And Ishmael, and Elijah, and Jonah, and Lot—We favored each one of them over all other people.
en.6:87: And of their ancestors, and their descendants, and their siblings—We chose them, and guided them to a straight path.
en.6:88: Such is God’s guidance. He guides with it whomever He wills of His servants. Had they associated, their deeds would have gone in vain.
en.6:89: Those are they to whom We gave the Scripture, and wisdom, and prophethood. If these reject them, We have entrusted them to others who do not reject them.
en.6:90: Those are they whom God has guided, so follow their guidance. Say, “I ask of you no compensation for it; it is just a reminder for all mankind.”
en.6:91: They do not value God as He should be valued, when they say, “God did not reveal anything to any human being.” Say, “Who revealed the Scripture which Moses brought—a light and guidance for humanity?” You put it on scrolls, displaying them, yet concealing much. And you were taught what you did not know—neither you, nor your ancestors. Say, “God;” then leave them toying away in their speculation.
en.6:92: This too is a Scripture that We revealed—blessed—verifying what preceded it, that you may warn the Mother of Cities and all around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and are dedicated to their prayers.
en.6:93: Who does greater wrong than someone who invents falsehood against God, or says, “It was revealed to me,” when nothing was revealed to him, or says, “I will reveal the like of what God revealed”? If only you could see the evildoers in the floods of death, as the divine messengers with arms outstretched: “Give up your souls. Today you are being repaid with the torment of shame for having said about God other than the truth, and for being too proud to accept His revelations.”
en.6:94: “You have come to Us individually, just as We created you the first time, leaving behind you everything We gave you. We do not see with you your intercessors—those you claimed were your partners. The link between you is cut, and what you had asserted has failed you.”
en.6:95: It is God Who splits the grain and the seed. He brings the living from the dead, and He brings the dead from the living. Such is God. So how could you deviate?
en.6:96: It is He Who breaks the dawn. And He made the night for rest, and the sun and the moon for calculation. Such is the disposition of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
en.6:97: And it is He Who created the stars for you, that you may be guided by them in the darkness of land and sea. We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
en.6:98: And it is He who produced you from a single person, then a repository, then a depository. We have detailed the revelations for people who understand.
en.6:99: And it is He who sends down water from the sky. With it We produce vegetation of all kinds, from which We bring greenery, from which We produce grains in clusters. And palm-trees with hanging clusters, and vineyards, and olives, and pomegranates—similar and dissimilar. Watch their fruits as they grow and ripen. Surely in this are signs for people who believe.
en.6:100: Yet they attributed to God partners—the sprites—although He created them. And they invented for Him sons and daughters, without any knowledge. Glory be to Him. He is exalted, beyond what they describe.
en.6:101: Originator of the heavens and the earth—how can He have a son when He never had a companion? He created all things, and He has knowledge of all things.
en.6:102: Such is God, your Lord. There is no god except He, the Creator of all things; so worship Him. He is responsible for everything.
en.6:103: No vision can grasp Him, but His grasp is over all vision. He is the Subtle, the Expert.
en.6:104: “Insights have come to you from your Lord. Whoever sees, it is to the benefit of his soul; and whoever remains blind, it is to its detriment. I am not a guardian over you.”
en.6:105: We thus diversify the revelations, lest they say, “You have studied,” and to clarify them for people who know.
en.6:106: Follow what was revealed to you from your Lord. There is no god but He. And turn away from the polytheists.
en.6:107: Had God willed, they would not have practiced idolatry. We did not appoint you as a guardian over them, and you are not a manager over them.
en.6:108: Do not insult those they call upon besides God, lest they insult God out of hostility and ignorance. We made attractive to every community their deeds. Then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them of what they used to do.
en.6:109: They swear by God, with their most solemn oaths, that if a miracle were to come to them, they would believe in it. Say, “The miracles are only with God.” But how do you know? Even if it did come, they still would not believe.
en.6:110: And We turn away their hearts and their visions, as they refused to believe in it the first time, and We leave them blundering in their rebellion.
en.6:111: Even if We sent down the divine messengers to them, and the dead spoke to them, and We gathered all things before them, they still would not believe, unless God wills; but most of them are ignorant.
en.6:112: Likewise, We have assigned for every messenger of God an enemy—human and jinn devils—inspiring one another with fancy words in order to deceive. But had your Lord willed, they would not have done it. So leave them to their fabrications.
en.6:113: So that the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter may incline to it, and be content with it, and that they may perpetrate whatever they perpetrate.
en.6:114: “Shall I seek a judge other than God, when He is the One who revealed to you the Scripture, explained in detail?” Those to whom We gave the Scripture know that it is the truth revealed from your Lord. So do not be of those who doubt.
en.6:115: The Word of your Lord has been completed, in truth and justice. There is no changing to His words. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
en.6:116: If you were to obey most of those on earth, they would divert you from God’s path. They follow nothing but assumptions, and they only conjecture.
en.6:117: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path, and He knows best the guided ones.
en.6:118: So eat of that over which the Name of God was pronounced, if you indeed believe in His revelations.
en.6:119: And why should you not eat of that over which the Name of God is pronounced, when He has detailed for you what is prohibited for you, unless you are compelled by necessity? Many lead astray with their opinions, through lack of knowledge. Your Lord knows best the transgressors.
en.6:120: So abandon sin, outward and inward. Those who commit sins will be repaid for what they used to perpetrate.
en.6:121: And do not eat from that over which the Name of God was not pronounced, for it is abomination. The devils inspire their followers to argue with you; but if you obey them, you would be polytheists.
en.6:122: Is he who was dead, then We gave him life, and made for him a light by which he walks among the people, like he who is in total darkness, and cannot get out of it? Thus the doings of those who deny the truth are made to appear good to them.
en.6:123: And thus We set up in every city its leading wicked sinners, to conspire in it, but they conspire only against themselves, and they do not realize it.
en.6:124: When a sign comes to them, they say, “We will not believe unless we are given the like of what was given to God’s messengers.” God knows best where to place His message. Humiliation from God and severe torment will afflict the criminals for their scheming.
en.6:125: Whomever God desires to guide, He spreads open his heart to Islam; and whomever He desires to misguide, He makes his heart narrow, constricted, as though he were climbing up the sky. God thus lays defilement upon those who do not believe.
en.6:126: This is the straight path of your Lord. We have explained the revelations in detail for people who recollect.
en.6:127: For them is the Home of Peace with their Lord, and He is their Master—because of what they used to do.
en.6:128: On the Day when He gathers them all together: “O assembly of jinn, you have exploited multitudes of humans.” Their adherents among mankind will say, “Our Lord, we have profited from one another, but we have reached the term that you have assigned for us.” He will say, “The Fire is your dwelling, wherein you will remain, except as God wills. Your Lord is Wise and Informed.
en.6:129: Thus We make some of the evildoers befriend one another, because of what they used to do.
en.6:130: “O assembly of jinn and humans, did there not come to you messengers from among you, relating to you My revelations, and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?” They will say, “We testify against ourselves.” The life of the world seduced them. They will testify against themselves that they were those who deny the truth.
en.6:131: That is because your Lord would not destroy towns for injustice while their inhabitants are unaware.
en.6:132: They all have ranks according to what they did; and your Lord is not unaware of what they do.
en.6:133: Your Lord is the Rich Beyond Need, the Possessor of Mercy. If He wills, he can do away with you, and substitute whomever He wills in your place, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people.
en.6:134: What you are promised is coming, and you cannot thwart it.
en.6:135: Say, “O my people! Work according to your ability, and so will I.” You will come to know to whom will belong the sequel of the abode.” The evildoers will not prevail.
en.6:136: And they set aside for God a share of the crops and the livestock He created, and they say, “This is for God,” according to their claim, “and this is for our idols.” But the share of their idols does not reach God, yet the share of God reaches their idols. Evil is their judgment.
en.6:137: Likewise, their idols entice many idolaters to kill their children, in order to lead them to their ruin, and confuse them in their religion. Had God willed, they would not have done it; so leave them to their fraud.
en.6:138: And they say, “These animals and crops are restricted; none may eat them except those we permit,” by their claims, and animals whose backs are forbidden, and animals over which they do not pronounce the name of God—fabricating lies against Him. He will repay them for what they used to invent.
en.6:139: And they say, “What lies in the wombs of these animals is exclusively for our males, and prohibited to our wives.” But if it is stillborn, they can share in it. He will surely punish them for their allegations. He is Wise and Knowing.
en.6:140: Lost are those who kill their children foolishly, with no basis in knowledge, and forbid what God has provided for them—innovations about God. They have gone astray. They are not guided.
en.6:141: It is He who produces gardens, both cultivated and wild, and date-palms, and crops of diverse tastes, and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of its fruit when it yields, and give its due on the day of its harvest, and do not waste. He does not love the wasteful.
en.6:142: Among the livestock are some for transportation, and some for clothing. Eat of what God has provided for you, and do not follow the footsteps of the Adversary. He is to you an outright enemy.
en.6:143: Eight pairs: two of the sheep, and two of the goats. Say, “Did He forbid the two males, or the two females, or what the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you are truthful.”
en.6:144: And two of the camels, and two of the cattle. Say, “Did He forbid the two males, or the two females, or what the wombs of the two females contain? Were you present when God enjoined this upon you?” Who does greater wrong than he who invents lies and attributes them to God, in order to mislead people without knowledge? God does not guide the wicked people.
en.6:145: Say, “In what was revealed to me, I find nothing forbidden to a consumer who eats it, except carrion, or spilled blood, or the flesh of swine—because it is impure—or a sinful offering dedicated to other than God. But if someone is compelled by necessity, without being deliberate or malicious—your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.6:146: For the Jews We forbade everything with claws. As of cattle and sheep: We forbade them their fat, except what adheres to their backs, or the entrails, or what is mixed with bone. This is how We penalized them for their inequity. We are indeed truthful.
en.6:147: If they accuse you of lying, say, “Your Lord is Possessor of infinite mercy, but His wrath cannot be averted from the guilty people.”
en.6:148: The polytheists will say, “Had God willed, we would not have practiced idolatry, nor would have our forefathers, nor would we have prohibited anything.” Likewise those before them lied, until they tasted Our might. Say, “Do you have any knowledge that you can produce for us? You follow nothing but conjecture, and you only guess.”
en.6:149: Say, “To God belongs the conclusive argument. Had He willed, He would have guided you all.”
en.6:150: Say, “Produce your witnesses who would testify that God has prohibited this.” If they testify, do not testify with them. And do not follow the whims of those who deny Our revelation, and those who do not believe in the Hereafter, and those who equate others with their Lord.
en.6:151: Say, “Come, let me tell you what your Lord has forbidden you: that you associate nothing with Him; that you honor your parents; that you do not kill your children because of poverty—We provide for you and for them; that you do not come near indecencies, whether outward or inward; and that you do not kill the soul which God has sanctified—except in the course of justice. All this He has enjoined upon you, so that you may understand.”
en.6:152: And do not come near the property of the orphan, except with the best intentions, until he reaches maturity. And give full weight and full measure, equitably. We do not burden any soul beyond its capacity. And when you speak, be fair, even if it concerns a close relative. And fulfill your covenant with God. All this He has enjoined upon you, so that you may take heed.
en.6:153: This is My path, straight, so follow it. And do not follow the other paths, lest they divert you from His path. All this He has enjoined upon you, that you may refrain from wrongdoing.
en.6:154: Then We gave Moses the Scripture, perfect for the virtuous, and explaining everything clearly, and a beacon, and mercy, that they may believe in the encounter with their Lord.
en.6:155: This too is a blessed Scripture that We revealed; so follow it, and be righteous, that you may receive mercy.
en.6:156: Lest you say, “The Scripture was revealed to two parties before us, and we were unaware of their teachings.”
en.6:157: Or lest you say, “Had the Scripture been revealed to us, we would have been better guided than they.” Clarification has come to you from your Lord, and guidance, and mercy. Who then does greater wrong than he who gives the lie to God's messages, and turns away from them? We will repay those who turn away from Our messages with the worst kind of punishment, because of their turning away.
en.6:158: Are they waiting for anything but for the divine messengers to come to them, or for your Lord to arrive, or for some of your Lord’s signs to come? On the Day when some of your Lord’s signs come, no soul will benefit from its faith unless it had believed previously, or had earned goodness through its faith. Say, “Wait, we too are waiting.”
en.6:159: As for those who divided their religion and became sects—you have nothing to do with them. Their case rests with God; then He will inform them of what they used to do.
en.6:160: Whoever comes up with a good deed will have ten times its like; and whoever comes up with an evil deed will be repaid only with its equivalent—they will not be wronged.
en.6:161: Say, “My Lord has guided me to a straight path, an upright religion, the creed of Abraham the Monotheist, who was not a polytheist.”
en.6:162: Say, “My devotional prayer (Ṣalāh) and my worship, and my life and my death, are devoted to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
en.6:163: No associate has He. Thus I am commanded, and I am the first of those who submit.
en.6:164: Say, “Am I to seek a Lord other than God, when He is the Lord of all things?” No soul gets except what it is due, and no soul bears the burdens of another. Then to your Lord is your return, then He will inform you regarding your disputes.
en.6:165: It is He who made you successors on the earth, and raised some of you in ranks over others, in order to test you through what He has given you. Your Lord is Quick in retribution, and He is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.60:1: O you who believe! Do not take My enemies and your enemies for supporters, offering them affection, when they have disbelieved in what has come to you of the Truth. They have expelled the Envoy, and you, because you believed in God, your Lord. If you have mobilized to strive for My cause, seeking My approval, how can you secretly love them? I know what you conceal and what you reveal. Whoever among you does that has strayed from the right way.
en.60:2: Whenever they encounter you, they treat you as enemies, and they stretch their hands and tongues against you with malice. They wish that you would disbelieve.
en.60:3: Neither your relatives nor your children will benefit you on the Day of Resurrection. He will separate between you. God is Observant of what you do.
en.60:4: You have had an excellent example in Abraham and those with him; when they said to their people, “We are quit of you, and what you worship apart from God. We denounce you. Enmity and hatred has surfaced between us and you, forever, until you believe in God alone.” Except for the words of Abraham to his father, “I will ask forgiveness for you, though I have no power from God to do anything for you.” “Our Lord, in You we trust, and to You we repent, and to You is the ultimate resort.
en.60:5: Our Lord, do not make us a target for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord. You are indeed the Mighty and Wise.”
en.60:6: There is an excellent example in them for you—for anyone who seeks God and the Last Day. But whoever turns away—God is the Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised.
en.60:7: Perhaps God will plant affection between you and those of them you consider enemies. God is Capable. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.60:8: As for those who have not fought against you for your religion, nor expelled you from your homes, God does not prohibit you from dealing with them kindly and equitably. God loves the equitable.
en.60:9: But God prohibits you from befriending those who fought against you over your religion, and expelled you from your homes, and aided in your expulsion. Whoever takes them for friends—these are the evildoers.
en.60:10: O you who believe! When believing women come to you emigrating, test them. God is Aware of their faith. And if you find them to be faithful, do not send them back to the unbelievers. They are not lawful for them, nor are they lawful for them. But give them what they have spent. You are not at fault if you marry them, provided you give them their compensation. And do not hold on to ties with unbelieving women, but demand what you have spent, and let them demand what they have spent. This is the rule of God; He rules among you. God is Knowing and Wise.
en.60:11: If any of your wives desert you to the unbelievers, and you decide to penalize them, give those whose wives have gone away the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear God, in whom you are believers.
en.60:12: O messenger of God! If believing women come to you, pledging allegiance to you, on condition that they will not associate anything with God, nor steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor commit perjury as to parenthood, nor disobey you in anything righteous, accept their allegiance and ask God’s forgiveness for them. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.60:13: O you who believe! Do not befriend people with whom God has become angry, and have despaired of the Hereafter, as the faithless have despaired of the occupants of the graves.
en.61:1: Everything in the heavens and the earth praises God. He is the Almighty, the Wise.
en.61:2: O you who believe! Why do you say what you do not do?
en.61:3: It is most hateful to God that you say what you do not do.
en.61:4: God loves those who fight in His cause, in ranks, as though they were a compact structure.
en.61:5: When Moses said to his people, “O my people, why do you hurt me, although you know that I am God’s Envoy to you?” And when they swerved, God swerved their hearts. God does not guide the sinful people.
en.61:6: And when Jesus son of Mary said, “O Children of Israel, I am God’s Envoy to you, confirming what preceded me of the Torah, and announcing good news of a messenger who will come after me, whose name is Ahmad.” But when he showed them the miracles, they said, “This is obvious sorcery.”
en.61:7: And who is a greater wrongdoer than he who attributes falsehoods to God, when he is being invited to Islam? God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
en.61:8: They want to extinguish God’s Light with their mouths; but God will complete His Light, even though the those who deny the truth dislike it.
en.61:9: It is He who sent His Envoy with the guidance and the true religion, to make it prevail over all religions, even though the idolaters dislike it.
en.61:10: O you who believe! Shall I inform you of a trade that will save you from a painful torment?
en.61:11: That you believe in God and His Envoy, and strive in the cause of God with your possessions and yourselves. That is best for you, if you only knew.
en.61:12: He will forgive you your sins; and will admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow, and into beautiful mansions in the Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme success.
en.61:13: And something else you love: support from God, and imminent victory. So give good news to the believers.
en.61:14: O you who believe! Be supporters of God, as Jesus son of Mary said to the disciples, “Who are my supporters towards God?” The disciples said, “We are God's supporters.” So a group of the Children of Israel believed, while another group disbelieved. We supported those who believed against their foe, so they became dominant.
en.62:1: Everything in the heavens and the earth glorifies God the Sovereign, the Holy, the Almighty, the Wise.
en.62:2: It is He who sent among the unlettered a messenger from themselves; reciting His revelations to them, and purifying them, and teaching them the Scripture and wisdom; although they were in obvious error before that.
en.62:3: And others from them, who have not yet joined them. He is the Glorious, the Wise.
en.62:4: That is God’s grace, which He grants to whomever He wills. God is Possessor of limitless grace.
en.62:5: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah, but then failed to uphold it, is like the donkey carrying works of literature. Miserable is the example of the people who denounce God’s revelations. God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
en.62:6: Say, “O you who follow Judaism; if you claim to be the chosen of God, to the exclusion of the rest of mankind, then wish for death if you are sincere.”
en.62:7: But they will not wish for it, ever, due to what their hands have advanced. God knows well the evildoers.
en.62:8: Say, “The death from which you flee will catch up with you; then you will be returned to the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, and He will inform you of what you used to do.”
en.62:9: O you who believe! When the call is made for devotional prayer (Ṣalāh) on Congregation Day, hasten to the remembrance of God, and drop all business. That is better for you, if you only knew.
en.62:10: Then, when the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh) is concluded, disperse through the land, and seek God’s bounty, and remember God much, so that you may prosper.
en.62:11: Yet whenever they come across some business, or some entertainment, they scramble towards it, and leave you standing. Say, “What is with God is better than entertainment and business; and God is the Best of providers.”
en.63:1: When the the dissemblers come to you, they say, “We bear witness that you are God’s Envoy.” God knows that you are His Envoy, and God bears witness that the the dissemblers are liars.
en.63:2: They treat their oaths as a cover, and so they repel others from God’s path. Evil is what they do.
en.63:3: That is because they believed, and then disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed, and they cannot understand.
en.63:4: When you see them, their appearance impresses you. And when they speak, you listen to what they say. They are like propped-up timber. They think every shout is aimed at them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. God condemns them; how deluded they are!
en.63:5: And when it is said to them, “Come, the Envoy of God will ask forgiveness for you,” they bend their heads, and you see them turning away arrogantly.
en.63:6: It is the same for them, whether you ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them; God will not forgive them. God does not guide the sinful people.
en.63:7: It is they who say: “Do not spend anything on those who side with God’s Envoy, unless they have dispersed.” To God belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth, but the the dissemblers do not understand.
en.63:8: They say, “If we return to the City, the more powerful therein will evict the weak.” But power belongs to God, and His Envoy, and the believers; but the the dissemblers do not know.
en.63:9: O you who believe! Let neither your possessions nor your children distract you from the remembrance of God. Whoever does that—these are the losers.
en.63:10: And give from what We have provided for you, before death approaches one of you, and he says, “My Lord, if only You would delay me for a short while, so that I may be charitable, and be one of the virtuous.”
en.63:11: But God will not delay a soul when its time has come. God is Informed of what you do.
en.64:1: Everything in the heavens and the earth praises God. To Him belongs the Kingdom, and to Him all praise is due, and He is Able to do all things.
en.64:2: It is He who created you. Some of you are unbelievers, and some of you are believers. And God perceives what you do.
en.64:3: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He designed you, and designed you well, and to Him is the final return.
en.64:4: He knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and He knows what you conceal and what you reveal. And God knows what is within the hearts.
en.64:5: Has the news not reached you, of those who disbelieved before? They tasted the ill consequences of their conduct, and a painful torment awaits them.
en.64:6: That is because their messengers came to them with clear explanations, but they said, “Are human beings going to guide us?” So they disbelieved and turned away. But God is in no need. God is Independent and Praiseworthy.
en.64:7: Those who disbelieve claim that they will not be resurrected. Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, you will be resurrected; then you will be informed of everything you did; and that is easy for God.”
en.64:8: So believe in God and His Envoy, and the Light which We sent down. God is Aware of everything you do.
en.64:9: The Day when He gathers you for the Day of Gathering—that is the Day of Mutual Exchange. Whoever believes in God and acts with integrity, He will remit his misdeeds, and will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow, to dwell therein forever. That is the supreme achievement.
en.64:10: But as for those who disbelieve and denounce Our revelations—these are the inmates of the Fire, dwelling therein forever; and what a miserable fate!
en.64:11: No disaster occurs except by God’s leave. Whoever believes in God, He guides his heart. God is Aware of everything.
en.64:12: So obey God, and obey the Envoy. But if you turn away—it is only incumbent on Our Envoy to deliver the clear message.
en.64:13: God, there is no god but He; and in God let the believers put their trust.
en.64:14: O you who believe! Among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon, and overlook, and forgive—God is Forgiver and Merciful.
en.64:15: Your possessions and your children are a test, but with God is a splendid reward.
en.64:16: So be conscious of God as much as you can, and listen, and obey, and give for your own good. He who is protected from his stinginess—these are the prosperous.
en.64:17: If you lend God a good loan, He will multiply it for you, and will forgive you. God is Appreciative and Forbearing.
en.64:18: The Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, the Almighty, the Wise.
en.65:1: O messenger of God! If any of you divorce women, divorce them during their period of purity, and calculate their term. And be pious before God, your Lord. And do not evict them from their homes, nor shall they leave, unless they have committed a proven adultery. These are the limits of God—whoever oversteps God’s limits has wronged his own soul. You never know; God may afterwards bring about a new situation.
en.65:2: Once they have reached their term, either retain them honorably, or separate from them honorably. And call to witness two just people from among you, and give upright testimony for God. By that is exhorted whoever believes in God and the Last Day. And whoever fears God—He will make a way out for him.
en.65:3: And will provide for him from where he never expected. Whoever relies on God—He will suffice him. God will accomplish His purpose. God has set a measure to all things.
en.65:4: As for those of your women who have reached menopause, if you have any doubts, their term shall be three months—and also for those who have not yet menstruated. As for those who are pregnant, their term shall be until they have delivered. Whoever fears God—He will make things easy for him.
en.65:5: This is the ordinance of God, which He sent down to you. Whoever fears God—He will remit his sins, and will amplify his reward.
en.65:6: Allow them to reside where you reside, according to your means, and do not harass them in order to make things difficult for them. If they are pregnant, spend on them until they give birth. And if they nurse your infant, give them their payment. And conduct your relation in amity. But if you disagree, then let another woman nurse him.
en.65:7: The wealthy shall spend according to his means; and he whose resources are restricted shall spend according to what God has given him. God never burdens a soul beyond what He has given it. God will bring ease after hardship.
en.65:8: How many a town defied the command of its Lord and His messengers? So We held it strictly accountable, and We punished it with a dreadful punishment.
en.65:9: It tasted the result of its decisions, and the outcome of its decisions was perdition.
en.65:10: God has prepared for them a severe retribution. So beware of God, O you who possess intellect and have faith. God has sent down to you a Reminder.
en.65:11: A messenger who recites to you God’s Verses, clear and distinct, that he may bring those who believe and work righteousness from darkness into light. Whoever believes in God and acts with integrity, He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow, therein to abide forever. God has given him an excellent provision.
en.65:12: God is He Who created seven heavens, and their like of earth. The command descends through them, so that you may know that God is Capable of everything, and that God Encompasses everything in knowledge.
en.66:1: O messenger of God! Why do you prohibit what God has permitted for you, seeking to please your wives? God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.66:2: God has decreed for you the dissolution of your oaths. God is your Master. He is the All-Knowing, the Most Wise.
en.66:3: The messenger of God told something in confidence to one of his wives. But when she disclosed it, and God made it known to him; he communicated part of it, and he avoided another part. Then, when he informed her of it, she said, “Who informed you of this?” He said, “The All-Knowing, the All-Informed, informed me.”
en.66:4: If you repent to God, then your hearts have listened. But if you band together against him, then God is his Ally, as is Gabriel, and the virtuous believers. In addition, the divine messengers will assist him.
en.66:5: Perhaps, if he divorces you, his Lord will give him in exchange wives better than you: submissive, believing, obedient, penitent, devout, fasting—previously married, or virgins.
en.66:6: O you who believe! Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire, whose fuel is people and stones. Over it are angels, fierce and powerful. They never disobey God in anything He commands them, and they carry out whatever they are commanded.
en.66:7: O you who disbelieved! Make no excuses today. You are being repaid for what you used to do.
en.66:8: O you who believe! Repent to God with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remit your sins, and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow, on the Day when God will not disappoint the messenger of God and those who believed with him. Their light streaming before them, and to their right, they will say, “Our Lord, complete our light for us, and forgive us; You are capable of all things.”
en.66:9: O messenger of God! Strive hard against the those who deny the truth and the the dissemblers, and be stern with them. Their abode is the Inferno. What a miserable destination!
en.66:10: God illustrates an example of those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants, but they betrayed them. They availed them nothing against God, and it was said, “Enter the Fire with those who are entering.”
en.66:11: And God illustrates an example of those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, “My Lord, build for me, with you, a house in the eternal Gardens, and save me from Pharaoh and his works, and save me from the wrongdoing people.”
en.66:12: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her womb, and so We breathed into her of Our Spirit; and she believed in the truth of her Lord’s Words and His Books, and was one of the devout.
en.67:1: Blessed is He in whose hand is the sovereignty, and Who has power over everything.
en.67:2: He who created death and life—to test you—as to which of you is better in conduct. He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
en.67:3: He who created seven heavens in layers. You see no discrepancy in the creation of the Compassionate. Look again. Can you see any cracks?
en.67:4: Then look again, and again, and your sight will return to you dazzled and exhausted.
en.67:5: We have adorned the lower heaven with lanterns, and made them missiles against the devils; and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
en.67:6: For those who reject their Lord, there is the torment of the Inferno. What an evil destination!
en.67:7: When they are thrown into it, they will hear it roaring, as it seethes.
en.67:8: It almost bursts with fury. Every time a batch is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, “Has no warner come to you?”
en.67:9: They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved, and said, ‘God did not send down anything; you are very much mistaken.’”
en.67:10: And they will say, “Had we listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the inmates of the Blaze.”
en.67:11: So they will acknowledge their sins. So away with the inmates of the Blaze.
en.67:12: As for those who fear their Lord in secret—for them is forgiveness and a great reward.
en.67:13: Whether you keep your words secret, or declare them—He is Aware of the inner thoughts.
en.67:14: Would He not know, He Who created? He is the Refined, the Expert.
en.67:15: It is He who made the earth manageable for you, so travel its regions, and eat of His provisions. To Him is the Resurgence.
en.67:16: Are you confident that the One in heaven will not cause the earth to collapse beneath you as it spins?
en.67:17: Or are you confident that the One in Heaven will not unleash against you a violent storm? Then you will know what My warning is like.
en.67:18: Those before them also denied the truth; and how was My disapproval?
en.67:19: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings, and folding them? None holds them except the Compassionate. He is Perceiver of everything.
en.67:20: Or who is this who is a force for you to protect you against the Compassionate? The those who deny the truth are in nothing but delusion.
en.67:21: Or who is this that will provide for you, if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in defiance and aversion.
en.67:22: Is he who walks bent on his own design better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?
en.67:23: Say, “It is He who produced you; and made for you the hearing, and the vision, and the organs. But rarely do you give thanks.”
en.67:24: Say, “It is He who scattered you on earth, and to Him you will be rounded up.”
en.67:25: And they say, “When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?”
en.67:26: Say, “Knowledge is with God, and I am only a clear warner.”
en.67:27: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn gloomy, and it will be said, “This is what you used to call for.”
en.67:28: Say, “Have you considered? Should God make me perish, and those with me; or else He bestows His mercy on us; who will protect the those who deny the truth from an agonizing torment?”
en.67:29: Say, “He is the Compassionate. We have faith in Him, and in Him we trust. Soon you will know who is in evident error.”
en.67:30: Say, “Have you considered? If your water drains away, who will bring you pure running water?”
en.68:1: Noon. By the pen, and by what they inscribe.
en.68:2: By the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.
en.68:3: In fact, you will have a reward that will never end.
en.68:4: And you are of a great moral character.
en.68:5: You will see, and they will see.
en.68:6: Which of you is the afflicted.
en.68:7: Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best the well-guided.
en.68:8: So do not obey the deniers.
en.68:9: They would like you to compromise, so they would compromise.
en.68:10: And do not obey any vile swearer.
en.68:14: Just because he has money and children.
en.68:15: When Our Verses are recited to him, he says, “Myths of the ancients!”
en.68:16: We will brand him on the muzzle.
en.68:17: We tested them, as We tested the owners of the garden, when they vowed to harvest it in the morning.
en.68:19: But a calamity from your Lord went around it while they slept.
en.68:20: And in the morning it was as if picked.
en.68:21: In the morning, they called to one another.
en.68:22: “Go early to your plantation, if you are going to harvest.”
en.68:23: So off they went, murmuring to one another.
en.68:24: “No poor person is to enter it upon you today.”
en.68:25: And early they went, resolved in intent.
en.68:26: But when they saw it, they said, “We were wrong.
en.68:28: The most reasonable of them said, “Did I not say to you, ‘if only you would glorify?’”
en.68:29: They said, “Glory to our Lord—We were indeed in the wrong.”
en.68:30: Then they turned to one another, blaming one another.
en.68:31: They said, “Woe to us—we were indeed domineering.
en.68:32: Perhaps our Lord will give us a better substitute for it. We are turning to our Lord.”
en.68:33: Such is the punishment; but the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
en.68:34: For the virtuous are Gardens of Delight with their Lord.
en.68:35: Shall We treat the Muslims like the villains?
en.68:36: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
en.68:37: Or do you have a scripture in which you study.
en.68:38: Wherein there is whatever you choose?
en.68:39: Or do you have oaths from Us, binding until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you demand?
en.68:40: Ask them, which of them will guarantee that.
en.68:41: Or do they have partners? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful.
en.68:42: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called to bow down, but they will be unable.
en.68:43: Their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. They were invited to bow down when they were sound.
en.68:44: So leave Me to those who reject this discourse; We will proceed against them gradually, from where they do not know.
en.68:45: And I will give them respite. My plan is firm.
en.68:46: Or do you ask them for a fee, so they are burdened with debt?
en.68:47: Or do they know the future, and so they write it down?
en.68:48: So wait patiently for the Decision of your Lord, and do not be like the Fellow of the Fish who cried out in despair.
en.68:49: Were it not for his Lord’s favor that reached him, he would have been thrown into the wilderness, fully despised.
en.68:50: But his Lord chose him, and made him one of the virtuous.
en.68:51: Those who disbelieve almost stab you with their glances when they hear the message, and say, “He is crazy!”
en.68:52: But it is no less than a reminder to all the Worlds.
en.69:3: What will make you understand what the Reality is?
en.69:4: Thamood and Aad denied the Catastrophe.
en.69:5: As for Thamood, they were annihilated by the Overwhelming.
en.69:6: And as for Aad; they were annihilated by a furious, roaring wind.
en.69:7: He unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days, in succession. You could see the people tossed around, as though they were stumps of hollow palm-trees.
en.69:8: Can you see any remnant of them?
en.69:9: Then Pharaoh came, and those before him, and the Overturned Cities steeped in sin.
en.69:10: But they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an overpowering grip.
en.69:11: When the waters overflowed, We carried you in the cruising ship.
en.69:12: To make it a lesson for you—so that retaining ears may retain it.
en.69:13: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded a single time.
en.69:14: And the earth and the mountains are lifted up, and crushed, with a single crush.
en.69:15: On that Day, the Event will come to pass.
en.69:16: And the heaven will crack; so on that Day it will be frail.
en.69:17: And the divine messengers will be ranged around its borders, while eight will be carrying the Throne of your Lord above them that Day.
en.69:18: On that Day you will be exposed, and no secret of yours will remain hidden.
en.69:19: As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, “Here, take my book and read it.
en.69:20: I knew I would be held accountable.”
en.69:21: So he will be in pleasant living.
en.69:24: “Eat and drink merrily for what you did in the days gone by.”
en.69:25: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, “I wish I was never given my book.
en.69:26: And never knew what my account was.
en.69:27: If only it was the end.
en.69:29: My power has vanished from me.”
en.69:31: Then scorch him in the Blaze.
en.69:32: Then in a chain which length is seventy cubits tie him up.
en.69:33: For he would not believe in God the Great.
en.69:34: Nor would he advocate the feeding of the destitute.
en.69:35: So he has no friend here today.
en.69:38: Indeed, I swear by what you see.
en.69:39: And by what you do not see.
en.69:40: It is the speech of a noble messenger.
en.69:41: And it is not the speech of a poet—little do you believe.
en.69:42: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer—little do you take heed.
en.69:43: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
en.69:44: Had he falsely attributed some statements to Us.
en.69:45: We would have seized him by the right arm.
en.69:47: And none of you could have restrained Us from him.
en.69:48: Surely, it is a message for the virtuous.
en.69:49: And We know that some of you will reject it.
en.69:50: And it is surely a source of grief for the unbelievers.
en.69:51: Yet it is the absolute truth.
en.69:52: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.
en.7:2: A Scripture was revealed to you, so let there be no anxiety in your heart because of it. You are to warn with it—and a reminder for the believers.
en.7:3: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord, and do not follow other masters beside Him. Little you recollect.
en.7:4: How many a town have We destroyed? Our might came upon them by night, or while they were napping.
en.7:5: When Our might came upon them, their only cry was, “We were indeed evildoers.”
en.7:6: We will question those to whom messengers were sent, and We will question the messengers.
en.7:7: We will narrate to them with knowledge, for We were never absent.
en.7:8: The scales on that Day will be just. Those whose weights are heavy—it is they who are the successful.
en.7:9: But as for those whose weights are light—it is they who have lost their souls, because they used to mistreat Our revelations.
en.7:10: We have established you firmly on earth, and made for you in it livelihood—but rarely do you give thanks.
en.7:11: We created you, then We shaped you, then We said to the divine messengers, “Bow down before Adam;” so they bowed down, except for the Adversary; he was not of those who bowed down.
en.7:12: He said, “What prevented you from bowing down when I have commanded you?” He said, “I am better than he; You created me from fire, and You created him from mud.”
en.7:13: He said, “Get down from it! It is not for you to act arrogantly in it. Get out! You are one of the lowly!”
en.7:14: He said, “Give me respite, until the Day they are resurrected.”
en.7:15: He said, “You are of those given respite.”
en.7:16: He said, “Because you have lured me, I will waylay them on Your straight path.
en.7:17: Then I will come at them from before them, and from behind them, and from their right, and from their left; and you will not find most of them appreciative.”
en.7:18: He said, “Get out of it, despised and vanquished. Whoever among them follows you—I will fill up the Inferno with you all.
en.7:19: And you, Adam, inhabit the Garden of Paradise, you and your wife, and eat whatever you wish; but do not approach this tree, lest you become sinners.”
en.7:20: But the Adversary whispered to them, to reveal to them their nakedness, which was invisible to them. He said, “Your Lord has only forbidden you this tree, lest you become angels, or become immortals.”
en.7:21: And he swore to them, “I am a sincere advisor to you.”
en.7:22: So he lured them with deceit. And when they tasted the tree, their nakedness became evident to them, and they began covering themselves with the leaves of the Garden of Paradise. And their Lord called out to them, “Did I not forbid you from this tree, and say to you that the Adversary is a sworn enemy to you?”
en.7:23: They said, “Our Lord, we have done wrong to ourselves. Unless You forgive us, and have mercy on us, we will be among the losers.”
en.7:24: He said, “Fall, some of you enemies to one another. On earth you will have residence and livelihood for a while.”
en.7:25: He said, “In it you will live, and in it you will die, and from it you will be brought out.”
en.7:26: O children of Adam! We have provided you with clothing to cover your bodies, and for luxury. But the clothing of piety—that is best. These are some of God’s revelations, so that they may take heed.
en.7:27: O Children of Adam! Do not let the Adversary seduce you, as he drove your parents out of the Garden of Paradise, stripping them of their garments, to show them their nakedness. He sees you, him and his clan, from where you cannot see them. We have made the devils friends of those who do not believe.
en.7:28: And when they commit an indecency, they say, “We found our parents doing this, and God has commanded us to do it.” Say, “God does not command indecencies. Are you attributing to God what you do not know?”
en.7:29: Say, “My Lord commands justice, and to stand devoted at every place of worship. So call upon Him, and dedicate your faith to Him alone. Just as He originated you, so you will return.”
en.7:30: Some He has guided, and some have deserved misguidance. They have adopted the devils for patrons rather than God, and they assume that they are guided.
en.7:31: O Children of Adam! Dress properly at every place of worship, and eat and drink, but do not be excessive. He does not love the excessive.
en.7:32: Say, “Who forbade God’s finery which He has produced for His servants, and the delights of livelihood?” Say, “They are for those who believe, in this present world, but exclusively theirs on the Day of Resurrection.” We thus detail the revelations for people who know.
en.7:33: Say, “My Lord has forbidden immoralities—both open and secret—and sin, and unjustified aggression, and that you associate with God anything for which He revealed no sanction, and that you say about God what you do not know.”
en.7:34: For every nation is an appointed time. When their time has come, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor can they advance it.
en.7:35: O Children of Adam! When messengers from among you come to you, relating to you My revelations—whoever practices piety and reforms—upon them shall be no fear, nor shall they grieve.
en.7:36: But as for those who reject Our revelations, and are too proud to accept them—these are the inmates of the Fire, where they will remain forever.
en.7:37: Who does greater wrong than he who invents lies about God, or denies His revelations? These—their share of the decree will reach them. Until, when Our envoys come to them, to take their souls away, they will say, “Where are they whom you used to pray to besides God?” They will say, “They have abandoned us,” and they will testify against themselves that they were faithless.
en.7:38: He will say, “Join the crowds of jinn and humans who have gone into the Fire before you.” Every time a crowd enters, it will curse its sister-crowd. Until, when they are all in it, the last of them will say to the first of them, “Our Lord, these are the ones who misled us, so inflict on them a double punishment in the Fire.” He will say, “Each will have a double, but you do not know.”
en.7:39: The first of them will say to the last of them, “You have no advantage over us, so taste the torment for what you used to earn.”
