en.7:40: Those who reject Our revelations and are too arrogant to uphold them—the doors of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter the eternal Gardens, until the camel passes through the eye of the needle. Thus We repay the guilty.
en.7:41: For them is a couch of hell, and above them are sheets of fire. Thus We repay the evildoers.
en.7:42: As for those who believe and do righteous works—We never burden any soul beyond its capacity—these are the inhabitants of the Garden of Paradise; abiding therein eternally.
en.7:43: We will remove whatever rancor is in their hearts. Rivers will flow beneath them. And they will say, “Praise be to God, who has guided us to this. Had God not guided us, we would never be guided. The messengers of our Lord did come with the truth.” And it will be proclaimed to them, “This is the Garden of Paradise you are made to inherit, on account of what you used to do.”
en.7:44: And the inhabitants of the Garden of Paradise will call out to the inmates of the Fire, “We found what our Lord promised us to be true; did you find what your Lord promised you to be true?” They will say, “Yes.” Thereupon a caller will announce in their midst, “The curse of God is upon the evildoers.”
en.7:45: “Those who hinder from the path of God, and seek to distort it, and who deny the Hereafter.”
en.7:46: And between them is a partition, and on the Elevations are men who recognize everyone by their features. They will call to the inhabitants of the Garden of Paradise, “Peace be upon you.” They have not entered it, but they are hoping.
en.7:47: And when their eyes are directed towards the inmates of the Fire, they will say, “Our Lord, do not place us among the wrongdoing people.”
en.7:48: And the dwellers of the Elevations will call to men they recognize by their features, saying, “Your hoardings did not avail you, nor did your arrogance.”
en.7:49: “Are these the ones you swore God will not touch with mercy?” “Enter the Garden of Paradise; you have nothing to fear, and you will not grieve.”
en.7:50: The inmates of the Fire will call on the inhabitants of the Garden of Paradise, “Pour some water over us, or some of what God has provided for you.” They will say, “God has forbidden them for the those who deny the truth.”
en.7:51: Those who took their religion lightly, and in jest, and whom the worldly life deceived. Today We will ignore them, as they ignored the meeting on this Day of theirs, and they used to deny Our revelations.
en.7:52: We have given them a Scripture, which We detailed with knowledge—guidance and mercy for people who believe.
en.7:53: Are they waiting for anything but its fulfillment? The Day its fulfillment comes true, those who disregarded it before will say, “The messengers of our Lord did come with the truth. Have we any intercessors to intercede for us? Or, could we be sent back, to behave differently from the way we behaved before?” They ruined their souls, and what they used to invent has failed them.
en.7:54: Your Lord is God; He who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then established Himself on the Throne. The night overtakes the day, as it pursues it persistently; and the sun, and the moon, and the stars are subservient by His command. His is the creation, and His is the command. Blessed is God, Lord of all beings.
en.7:55: Call upon your Lord humbly and privately. He does not love the aggressors.
en.7:56: And do not corrupt on earth after its reformation, and pray to Him with fear and hope. God’s mercy is close to the doers of good.
en.7:57: It is He who sends the wind ahead of His mercy. Then, when they have gathered up heavy clouds, We drive them to a dead land, where We make water come down, and with it We bring out all kinds of fruits. Thus We bring out the dead—perhaps you will reflect.
en.7:58: As for the good land, it yields its produce by the leave of its Lord. But as for the bad, it produces nothing but hardship and misery. Thus We explain the revelations in various ways for people who are thankful.
en.7:59: We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people! Worship God; you have no god other than Him. I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day.”
en.7:60: The dignitaries among his people said, “We see that you are in obvious error.”
en.7:61: He said, “O my people, I am not in error, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.”
en.7:62: “I deliver to you the messages of my Lord, and I advise you, and I know from God what you do not know.”
en.7:63: “Do you wonder that a reminder has come to you from your Lord, through a man from among you, to warn you, and to lead you to righteousness, so that you may attain mercy?”
en.7:64: But they called him a liar. So We saved him and those with him in the Ark, and We drowned those who rejected Our revelations. They were blind people.
en.7:65: And to Aad, their brother Hud. He said, “O my people! Worship God; you have no god other than Him. Will you not take heed?”
en.7:66: The elite of his people who disbelieved said, “We see foolishness in you, and we think that you are a liar.”
en.7:67: He said, “O my people! There is no foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.
en.7:68: “I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am a trustworthy adviser to you.”
en.7:69: “Are you surprised that a reminder has come to you from your Lord, through a man from among you, to warn you? Remember how He made you successors after the people of Noah, and increased you greatly in stature. And remember God’s blessings, so that you may prosper.”
en.7:70: They said, “Did you come to us to make us worship God alone, and abandon what our ancestors used to worship? Then bring us what you threaten us with, if you are truthful.”
en.7:71: He said, “Condemnation and wrath have befallen you from your Lord. Are you arguing with me over names, which you and your ancestors invented, for which God sent down no authority? Just wait; I am waiting with you.”
en.7:72: So We saved him and those with him, by mercy from Us, and We cut off the roots of those who rejected Our revelations and were not believers.
en.7:73: And to Thamood, their brother Saleh. He said, “O my people! Worship God; you have no god other than Him. Clarification has come to you from your Lord. This she-camel of God is a sign for you. So leave her to graze on God’s earth, and do her no harm, lest a painful penalty seizes you.”
en.7:74: “And remember how He made you successors after Aad, and settled you in the land. You make for yourselves mansions on its plains, and carve out dwellings in the mountains. So remember God’s benefits, and do not roam the earth corruptingly.”
en.7:75: The elite of his people, who were arrogant, said to the common people who had believed, “Do you know that Saleh is sent from his Lord?” They said, “We are believers in what he was sent with.”
en.7:76: Those who were arrogant said, “We reject what you believe in.”
en.7:77: So they hamstrung the she-camel, and defied the command of their Lord, and said, “O Saleh, bring upon us what you threaten us with, if you are one of the messengers.”
en.7:78: Whereupon the quake overtook them, and they became lifeless bodies in their homes.
en.7:79: Then he turned away from them, and said, “O my people, I have delivered to you the message of my Lord, and I have advised you, but you do not like those who give advice.”
en.7:80: And Lot, when he said to his people, “Do you commit lewdness no people anywhere have ever committed before you?”
en.7:81: “You lust after men rather than women. You are an excessive people.”
en.7:82: And his people's only answer was to say, “Expel them from your town; they are purist people.”
en.7:83: But We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who lagged behind.
en.7:84: And We rained down on them a rain; note the consequences for the sinners.
en.7:85: And to Median, their brother Shuaib. He said, “O my people, worship God; you have no god other than Him. A clear proof has come to you from your Lord. Give full measure and weight, and do not cheat people out of their rights, and do not corrupt the land once it has been set right. This is better for you, if you are believers.”
en.7:86: “And do not lurk on every path, making threats and turning away from the path of God those who believe in Him, seeking to distort it. And remember how you were few, and how He made you numerous. So note the consequences for the corrupters.”
en.7:87: “Since some of you believed in what I was sent with, and some did not believe, be patient until God judges between us; for He is the Best of Judges.”
en.7:88: The arrogant elite among his people said, “O Shuaib, We will evict you from our town, along with those who believe with you, unless you return to our religion.” He said, “Even if we are unwilling?”
en.7:89: “We would be fabricating falsehood against God, if we were to return to your religion, after God has saved us from it. It is not for us to return to it, unless God, our Lord, wills. Our Lord embraces all things in knowledge. In God we place our trust. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, for You are the Best of Deciders.”
en.7:90: The elite of his people who disbelieved said, “If you follow Shuaib, you will be losers.”
en.7:91: Thereupon, the quake struck them; and they became lifeless bodies in their homes.
en.7:92: Those who rejected Shuaib—as if they never prospered therein. Those who rejected Shuaib—it was they who were the losers.
en.7:93: So he turned away from them, and said, “O my people, I have delivered to you the messages of my Lord, and I have advised you, so why should I grieve over a disbelieving people?”
en.7:94: We did not send any messenger of God to any town but We afflicted its people with misery and adversity, so that they may humble themselves.
en.7:95: Then We substituted prosperity in place of hardship. Until they increased in number, and said, “Adversity and prosperity has touched our ancestors.” Then We seized them suddenly, while they were unaware.
en.7:96: Had the people of the towns believed and turned righteous, We would have opened for them the blessings of the heaven and the earth; but they rejected the truth, so We seized them by what they were doing.
en.7:97: Do the people of the towns feel secure that Our might will not come upon them by night, while they sleep?
en.7:98: Do the people of the towns feel secure that Our might will not come upon them by day, while they play?
en.7:99: Do they feel safe from God’s plan? None feel safe from God’s plan except the losing people.
en.7:100: Is it not guidance for those who inherit the land after its inhabitants, that if We willed, We could strike them for their sins? And seal up their hearts, so that they would not hear?
en.7:101: These towns—We narrate to you some of their tales. Their messengers came to them with the clear signs, but they would not believe in what they had rejected previously. Thus God seals the hearts of the those who deny the truth.
en.7:102: We found most of them untrue to their covenants; We found most of them corrupt.
en.7:103: Then, after them, We sent Moses with Our miracles to Pharaoh and his establishment, but they denounced them. So consider the end of the evildoers.
en.7:104: Moses said, “O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.”
en.7:105: “It is only proper that I should not say about God anything other than the truth. I have come to you with clear evidence from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with me.”
en.7:106: He said, “If you brought a miracle, then present it, if you are truthful.”
en.7:107: So he threw his staff, and it was an apparent serpent.
en.7:108: And He pulled out his hand, and it was white to the onlookers.
en.7:109: The notables among Pharaoh’s people said, “This is really a skilled magician.”
en.7:110: “He wants to evict you from your land, so what do you recommend?”
en.7:111: They said, “Put him off, and his brother, and send heralds to the cities.”
en.7:112: “And let them bring you every skillful magician.”
en.7:113: The magicians came to Pharaoh, and said, “Surely there is a reward for us, if we are the victors.”
en.7:114: He said, “Yes, and you will be among my favorites.”
en.7:115: They said, “O Moses! Either you throw, or we are the ones to throw.”
en.7:116: He said, “You throw!” And when they threw, they beguiled the eyes of the people, and intimidated them, and produced a mighty magic.
en.7:117: And We inspired Moses: “Throw your staff.” And at once, it swallowed what they were faking.
en.7:118: So the truth came to pass, and what they were producing came to nothing.
en.7:119: There they were defeated, and utterly reduced.
en.7:120: And the magicians fell to their knees.
en.7:121: They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the Worlds.”
en.7:123: Pharaoh said, “Did you believe in Him before I have given you permission? This is surely a conspiracy you schemed in the city, in order to expel its people from it. You will surely know.”
en.7:124: “I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will crucify you all.”
en.7:125: They said, “It is to our Lord that we will return.”
en.7:126: “You are taking vengeance on us only because we have believed in the signs of our Lord when they have come to us.” “Our Lord! Pour out patience upon us, and receive our souls in submission.”
en.7:127: The chiefs of Pharaoh's people said, “Will you let Moses and his people cause trouble in the land, and forsake you and your gods?” He said, “We will kill their sons, and spare their women. We have absolute power over them.”
en.7:128: Moses said to his people, “Seek help in God, and be patient. The earth belongs to God. He gives it in inheritance to whomever He wills of His servants, and the future belongs to the virtuous.”
en.7:129: They said, “We were persecuted before you came to us, and after you came to us.” He said, “Perhaps your Lord will destroy your enemy, and make you successors in the land; then He will see how you behave.”
en.7:130: And We afflicted the people of Pharaoh with barren years, and with shortage of crops, that they may take heed.
en.7:131: When something good came their way, they said, “This is ours.” And when something bad happened to them, they ascribed the evil omen to Moses and those with him. In fact, their omen is with God, but most of them do not know.
en.7:132: And they said, “No matter what sign you bring us, to bewitch us with, we will not believe in you.”
en.7:133: So We let loose upon them the flood, and the locusts, and the lice, and the frogs, and blood—all explicit signs—but they were too arrogant. They were a sinful people.
en.7:134: Whenever a plague befell them, they would say, “O Moses, pray to your Lord for us, according to the covenant He made with you. If you lift the plague from us, we will believe in you, and let the Children of Israel go with you.”
en.7:135: But when We lifted the plague from them, for a term they were to fulfill, they broke their promise.
en.7:136: So We took vengeance on them, and drowned them in the sea—because they rejected Our signs, and paid no heed to them.
en.7:137: And We made the oppressed people inherit the eastern and western parts of the land, which We had blessed. Thus the fair promise of your Lord to the Children of Israel was fulfilled, because of their endurance. And We destroyed what Pharaoh and his people had built, and what they had harvested.
en.7:138: And We delivered the Children of Israel across the sea. And when they came upon a people who were devoted to some statues of theirs, they said, “O Moses, make for us a god, as they have gods.” He said, “You are truly an ignorant people.”
en.7:139: “What these people are concerned with is perdition, and their deeds are based on falsehoods.”
en.7:140: He said, “Shall I seek for you a god other than God, when He has favored you over all other people?”
en.7:141: Remember how We saved you from Pharaoh’s people, who subjected you to the worst of sufferings—killing your sons and sparing your women. In that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.
en.7:142: And We appointed to Moses thirty nights, and completed them with ten; and thus the time appointed by his Lord was forty nights. And Moses said to his brother Aaron: “Take my place among my people, and be upright, and do not follow the way of the mischief-makers.”
en.7:143: And when Moses came to Our appointment, and his Lord spoke to him, he said, “My Lord, allow me to look and see You.” He said, “You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it stays in its place, you will see Me.” But when his Lord manifested Himself to the mountain, He turned it into dust, and Moses fell down unconscious. Then, when he recovered, he said, “Glory be to you, I repent to you, and I am the first of the believers.”
en.7:144: He said, “O Moses, I have chosen you over all people for My messages and for My Words. So take what I have given you, and be one of the thankful.”
en.7:145: And We inscribed for him in the Tablets all kinds of enlightenments, and decisive explanation of all things. “Hold fast to them, and exhort your people to adopt the best of them. I will show you the fate of the sinners.”
en.7:146: I will turn away from My revelations those who behave proudly on earth without justification. Even if they see every sign, they will not believe in it; and if they see the path of rectitude, they will not adopt it for a path; and if they see the path of error, they will adopt it for a path. That is because they denied Our revelations, and paid no attention to them.
en.7:147: Those who deny Our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter—their deeds will come to nothing. Will they be repaid except according to what they used to do?
en.7:148: In his absence, the people of Moses adopted a calf made from their ornaments—a body which lowed. Did they not see that it could not speak to them, nor guide them in any way? They took it for worship. They were in the wrong.
en.7:149: Then, when they regretted, and realized that they had erred, they said, “Unless our Lord extends His mercy to us, and forgives us, we will be among the losers.”
en.7:150: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, he said, “What an awful thing you did in my absence. Did you forsake the commandments of your Lord so hastily?” And he threw down the tablets; and he took hold of his brother’s head, dragging him towards himself. He said, “Son of my mother, the people have overpowered me, and were about to kill me; so do not allow the enemies to gloat over me, and do not count me among the unjust people.”
en.7:151: He said, “My Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us into Your mercy; for you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
en.7:152: Those who idolized the calf have incurred wrath from their Lord, and humiliation in this life. We thus requite the innovators.
en.7:153: As for those who commit sins, and then repent afterwards and believe—your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.7:154: When the anger abated in Moses, he took up the tablets. In their transcript is guidance and mercy for those in awe of their Lord.
en.7:155: And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment. When the tremor shook them, he said, “My Lord, had You willed, You could have destroyed them before, and me too. Will you destroy us for what the fools among us have done? This is but Your test—with it You misguide whomever You will, and guide whomever You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are the Best of Forgivers.”
en.7:156: “And inscribe for us goodness in this world, and in the Hereafter. We have turned to You.” He said, “My punishment—I inflict it upon whomever I will, but My mercy encompasses all things. I will specify it for those who act righteously and practice regular charity, and those who believe in Our signs.”
en.7:157: Those who follow the Envoy, the Unlettered messenger of God, whom they find mentioned in the Torah and the Gospel in their possession. He directs them to righteousness, and deters them from evil, and allows for them all good things, and prohibits for them wickedness, and unloads the burdens and the shackles that are upon them. Those who believe in him, and respect him, and support him, and follow the light that came down with him—these are the successful.
en.7:158: Say, “O people, I am the Envoy of God to you all—He to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. There is no god but He. He gives life and causes death.” So believe in God and His Envoy, the Unlettered messenger of God, who believes in God and His words. And follow him, that you may be guided.
en.7:159: Among the people of Moses is a community that guides by truth, and thereby does justice.
en.7:160: We divided them into twelve tribal communities. And We inspired Moses, when his people asked him for something to drink: “Strike the rock with your staff.” Whereupon twelve springs gushed from it. Each group recognized its drinking-place. And We shaded them with clouds, and We sent down upon them manna and quails: “Eat of the good things We have provided for you.” They did not wrong Us, but they used to wrong their own selves.
en.7:161: And it was said to them, “Settle this town, and eat therein whatever you wish, and speak modestly, and enter the gate in humility—We will forgive your sins, and will promote the virtuous.”
en.7:162: But the wicked among them substituted other words for the words given to them; so We sent down upon them a plague from the sky, because of their wrongdoing.
en.7:163: Ask them about the town by the sea, when they violated the Sabbath. When they observed the Sabbath, their fish would come to them abundantly. But when they violated the Sabbath, their fish would not come to them. Thus We tried them because they disobeyed.
en.7:164: And when a group of them said, “Why do you counsel a people whom God will annihilate, or punish with a severe punishment?” They said, “As an excuse to your Lord, and so that they may become righteous.”
en.7:165: Then, when they neglected what they were reminded of, We saved those who prohibited evil, and We seized those who did wrong with a terrible punishment, because of their sinfulness.
en.7:166: Then, when they rebelled against the commands to refrain, We said to them, “Be despicable apes.”
en.7:167: Your Lord has announced that, He would send against them, until the Day of Resurrection, those who would inflict terrible suffering upon them. Your Lord is swift in retribution, yet He is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.7:168: And We scattered them into communities on earth. Some of them righteous, and some of them short of that. And We tested them with fortunes and misfortunes, so that they may return.
en.7:169: They were succeeded by generations who inherited the Scripture and chose the materials of this world, saying, “We will be forgiven.” And should similar materials come their way, they would again seize them. Did they not make a covenant to uphold the Scripture, and to not say about God except the truth? Did they not study its contents? But the Home of the Hereafter is better for the cautious; will you not understand?
en.7:170: Those who adhere to the Scripture, and practice devotional prayer (Ṣalāh)—We will not waste the reward of the reformers.
en.7:171: And when We suspended the mountain over them, as if it was an umbrella, and they thought it would fall on them: “Hold fast to what We have given you, and remember what it contains, so that you may be saved.”
en.7:172: And when Your Lord summoned the descendants of Adam, and made them testify about themselves. “Am I not your Lord?” They said, “Yes, we testify.” Thus you cannot say on the Day of Resurrection, “We were unaware of this.”
en.7:173: Nor can you Say, “Our ancestors practiced idolatry before; and we are their descendants who came after them; will you destroy us for what the falsifiers did?”
en.7:174: We thus elaborate the revelations, so that they may return.
en.7:175: And relate to them the story of him to whom We delivered Our signs, but he detached himself from them, so the Adversary went after him, and he became one of the perverts.
en.7:176: Had We willed, We could have elevated him through them; but he clung to the ground, and followed his desires. His metaphor is that of a dog: if you chase it, it pants; and if you leave it alone, it pants. Such is the metaphor of the people who deny Our signs. So tell the tale, so that they may ponder.
en.7:177: Evil is the metaphor of the people who reject Our signs and wrong themselves.
en.7:178: Whomever God guides is the guided one. And whomever He sends astray—these are the losers.
en.7:179: We have destined for the Inferno multitudes of jinn and humans. They have hearts with which they do not understand. They have eyes with which they do not see. They have ears with which they do not hear. These are like cattle. In fact, they are further astray. These are the heedless.
en.7:180: To God belong the Most Beautiful Names, so call Him by them, and disregard those who blaspheme His names. They will be repaid for what they used to do.
en.7:181: Among those We created is a community—they guide by truth, and do justice thereby.
en.7:182: As for those who reject Our messages, We will gradually lead them from where they do not know.
en.7:183: And I will encourage them. My plan is firm.
en.7:184: Do they not think? There is no madness in their friend. He is but a plain warner.
en.7:185: Have they not observed the government of the heavens and the earth, and all the things that God created, and that their time may have drawn near? Which message, besides this, will they believe in?
en.7:186: Whomever God misguides has no guide. And He leaves them blundering in their transgression.
en.7:187: They ask you about the Hour, “When will it come?” Say, “Knowledge of it rests with my Lord. None can reveal its coming except He. It weighs heavily on the heavens and the earth. It will not come upon you except suddenly.” They ask you as if you are responsible for it. Say, “Knowledge of it rests with God,” but most people do not know.
en.7:188: Say, “I have no control over any benefit or harm to myself, except as God wills. Had I known the future, I would have acquired much good, and no harm would have touched me. I am only a warner, and a herald of good news to a people who believe.”
en.7:189: It is He who created you from a single person, and made from it its mate, that he may find comfort with her. Then, when he has covered her, she conceives a light load, and she carries it around. But when she has grown heavy, they pray to God their Lord, “if You give us a good child, we will be among the thankful.”
en.7:190: But when He has given them a good child, they attribute partners to Him in what He has given them. God is exalted above what they associate.
en.7:191: Do they idolize those who create nothing, and are themselves created?
en.7:192: And can neither help them, nor help their own selves?
en.7:193: And if you invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is the same for you, whether you invite them, or remain silent.
en.7:194: Those you call upon besides God are servants like you. So call upon them, and let them answer you, if you are truthful.
en.7:195: Do they have feet with which they walk? Or do they have hands with which they strike? Or do they have eyes with which they see? Or do they have ears with which they hear? Say, “Call upon your partners, then plot against me, and do not wait.”
en.7:196: “My Master is God, He Who sent down the Scripture, and He takes care of the virtuous.”
en.7:197: Those you call upon besides Him cannot help you, nor can they help themselves.
en.7:198: And if you call them to guidance, they will not hear. And you see them looking at you, yet they do not see.
en.7:199: Be tolerant, and command decency, and avoid the ignorant.
en.7:200: And when a suggestion from the Adversary assails you, take refuge with God. He is Hearing and Knowing.
en.7:201: Those who are righteous—when an impulse from the Adversary strikes them, they remind themselves, and immediately see clearly.
en.7:202: But their brethren lead them relentlessly into error, and they never stop short.
en.7:203: If you do not produce a miracle for them, they say, “Why don’t you improvise one.” Say, “I only follow what is inspired to me from my Lord.” These are insights from your Lord, and guidance, and mercy, for a people who believe.
en.7:204: When the Quran is recited, listen to it, and pay attention, so that you may experience mercy.
en.7:205: And remember your Lord within yourself, humbly and fearfully, and quietly, in the morning and the evening, and do not be of the neglectful.
en.7:206: Those who are in the presence of your Lord are not too proud to worship Him. They recite His praises, and to Him they bow down.
en.70:1: A questioner questioned the imminent torment.
en.70:2: For the those who deny the truth; none can repel it.
en.70:3: From God, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
en.70:4: Unto Him the divine messengers and the Spirit ascend on a Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
en.70:5: So be patient, with sweet patience.
en.70:8: On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass.
en.70:9: And the mountains will be like tufted wool.
en.70:10: No friend will care about his friend.
en.70:11: They will be shown each other. The criminal wishes he would be redeemed from the punishment of that Day by his children.
en.70:12: And his spouse, and his brother.
en.70:13: And his family that sheltered him.
en.70:14: And everyone on earth, in order to save him.
en.70:15: By no means! It is a Raging Fire.
en.70:17: It invites him who once turned his back and fled.
en.70:20: Touched by adversity, he is fretful.
en.70:21: Touched by good, he is ungenerous.
en.70:23: Those who are constant at their prayers.
en.70:24: And those in whose wealth is a rightful share.
en.70:25: For the beggar and the deprived.
en.70:26: And those who affirm the Day of Judgment.
en.70:27: And those who fear the punishment of their Lord.
en.70:28: Their Lord’s punishment is not to be taken for granted.
en.70:29: And those who guard their chastity.
en.70:30: Except from their spouses or those living under their control, for then they are free of blame.
en.70:31: But whoever seeks to go beyond that—these are the transgressors.
en.70:32: And those who honor their trusts and their pledges.
en.70:33: And those who stand by their testimonies.
en.70:34: And those who are dedicated to their prayers.
en.70:35: These will be honored in Gardens.
en.70:36: What is with those who disbelieve, stretching their necks towards you.
en.70:37: From the right, and from the left, banding together?
en.70:38: Is every one of them aspiring to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?
en.70:39: No indeed! We created them from what they know.
en.70:40: I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests, that We are Able.
en.70:41: To replace them with better than they, and We are not to be outdone.
en.70:42: So leave them to blunder and play, until they meet their Day which they are promised.
en.70:43: The Day when they will emerge from the tombs in a rush, as though they were hurrying towards a target.
en.70:44: Their eyes cast down; overwhelmed by humiliation. This is the Day which they were promised.
en.71:1: We sent Noah to his people: “Warn your people before there comes upon them a painful punishment.”
en.71:2: He said, “O my people, I am to you a clear warner.
en.71:3: Worship God and reverence Him, and obey me.
en.71:4: And He will forgive you of your sins, and reprieve you until a stated term. God’s term cannot be deferred once it has arrived, if you only knew.”
en.71:5: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day.
en.71:6: But my call added only to their flight.
en.71:7: Whenever I called them to Your forgiveness, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and wrapped themselves in their garments, and insisted, and became more and more arrogant.
en.71:9: Then I appealed to them publicly, and I spoke to them privately.
en.71:10: I said, ‘Ask your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving.
en.71:11: He will let loose the sky upon you in torrents.
en.71:12: And provide you with wealth and children, and allot for you gardens, and allot for you rivers.
en.71:13: What is the matter with you, that you do not appreciate God’s Greatness?
en.71:14: Although He created you in stages.
en.71:15: Do you not realize that God created seven heavens in layers?
en.71:16: And He set the moon in their midst for light, and He made the sun a lamp.
en.71:17: And God germinated you from the earth like plants.
en.71:18: Then He will return you into it, and will bring you out again.
en.71:19: And God made the earth a spread for you.
en.71:20: That you may travel its diverse roads.’”
en.71:21: Noah said, “My Lord, they have defied me, and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in perdition.”
en.71:23: And they said, “Do not give up your gods; do not give up Wadd, nor Souwa, nor Yaghoos, and Yaooq, and Nassr.
en.71:24: They have misled many, so do not increase the evildoers except in confusion.”
en.71:25: Because of their wrongs, they were drowned, and were hurled into a Fire. They did not find apart from God any helpers.
en.71:26: Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave of the unbelievers a single dweller on earth.
en.71:27: If You leave them, they will mislead your servants, and will breed only wicked unbelievers.
en.71:28: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and anyone who enters my home in faith, and all the believing men and believing women; and do not increase the evildoers except in perdition.”
en.72:1: Say, “It was revealed to me that a band of jinn listened in, and said, ‘We have heard a wondrous Quran.
en.72:2: It guides to rectitude, so we have believed in it; and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.
en.72:3: And Exalted is the Grandeur of our Lord—He never had a mate, nor a child.
en.72:4: But the fools among us used to say nonsense about God.
en.72:5: And we thought that humans and jinn would never utter lies about God.
en.72:6: Some individual humans used to seek power through some individual jinn, but they only increased them in confusion.
en.72:7: They thought, as you thought, that God would never resurrect anyone.
en.72:8: We probed the heaven, and found it filled with stern guards and projectiles.
en.72:9: We used to take up positions to listen in; but whoever listens now finds a projectile in wait for him.
en.72:10: We do not know whether ill is intended for those on earth, or if their Lord intends goodness for them.
en.72:11: Some of us are righteous, but some of us are less than that; we follow divergent paths.
en.72:12: We realized that we cannot defeat God on earth, and that we cannot escape Him by fleeing.
en.72:13: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord fears neither loss, nor burden.
en.72:14: Among us are those who are submitting, and among us are the compromisers. As for those who have submitted—it is they who pursue rectitude.
en.72:15: But as for the compromisers—they will be firewood for the Inferno.’”
en.72:16: Had they kept true to the Path, We would have given them plenty water to drink.
en.72:17: To test them with it. Whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will direct him to torment ever mounting.
en.72:18: The places of worship are for God. So do not call, besides God, upon anyone else.
en.72:19: And when the servant of God got up calling on Him, they almost fell on him in a mass.
en.72:20: Say, “I pray only to my Lord, and I never associate anyone with Him.”
en.72:21: Say, “It is not in my power to harm you, nor to bring you to right conduct.”
en.72:22: Say, “No one can protect me from God, and I will not find any refuge except with Him.
en.72:23: Except for a proclamation from God and His messages. He who defies God and His Envoy—for him is the Fire of the Inferno, in which they will dwell forever.”
en.72:24: Until, when they see what they were promised, they will know who is weaker in helpers, and fewer in numbers.
en.72:25: Say, “I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Lord will extend it for a period.”
en.72:26: The Knower of the Invisible; He does not disclose His Invisible to anyone.
en.72:27: Except to a Envoy of His choosing. He then dispatches guards before him and behind him.
en.72:28: That He may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses what they have, and has tallied everything by number.
en.73:2: Stay up during the night, except a little.
en.73:3: For half of it, or reduce it a little.
en.73:4: Or add to it; and chant the Quran rhythmically.
en.73:5: We are about to give you a heavy message.
en.73:6: The vigil of night is more effective, and better suited for recitation.
en.73:7: In the daytime, you have lengthy work to do.
en.73:8: So remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.
en.73:9: Lord of the East and the West. There is no god but He, so take Him as a Trustee.
en.73:10: And endure patiently what they say, and withdraw from them politely.
en.73:11: And leave Me to those who deny the truth, those of luxury, and give them a brief respite.
en.73:12: With Us are shackles, and a Fierce Fire.
en.73:13: And food that chokes, and a painful punishment.
en.73:14: On the Day when the earth and the mountains tremble, and the mountains become heaps of sand.
en.73:15: We have sent to you a messenger, a witness over you, as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
en.73:16: But Pharaoh defied the Envoy, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.
en.73:17: So how will you, if you persist in unbelief, save yourself from a Day which will turn the children gray-haired?
en.73:18: The heaven will shatter thereby. His promise is always fulfilled.
en.73:19: This is a reminder. So whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.
en.73:20: Your Lord knows that you stay up nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, along with a group of those with you. God designed the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to sustain it, so He has pardoned you. So read of the Quran what is possible for you. He knows that some of you may be ill; and others travelling through the land, seeking God’s bounty; and others fighting in God’s cause. So read of it what is possible for you, and observe the prayers, and give regular charity, and lend God a generous loan. Whatever good you advance for yourselves, you will find it with God, better and generously rewarded. And seek God’s forgiveness, for God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.74:6: And show no favor seeking gain.
en.74:7: And be constant for your Lord.
en.74:9: That Day will be a difficult day.
en.74:10: For the those who deny the truth—not easy.
en.74:11: Leave Me to him whom I created alone.
en.74:15: Then he wants Me to add yet more!
en.74:16: By no means! He was stubborn towards Our revelations.
en.74:19: May he perish, how he analyzed.
en.74:20: Again: may he perish, how he analyzed.
en.74:23: Then he turned back and was proud.
en.74:24: And said, “This is nothing but magic from the past.
en.74:25: This is nothing but the word of a mortal.”
en.74:26: I will roast him in Saqar.
en.74:27: But what will explain to you what Saqar is?
en.74:31: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and caused their number to be a stumbling block for those who disbelieve; so that those given the Scripture may attain certainty; and those who believe may increase in faith; and those given the Scripture and the believers may not doubt; and those in whose hearts is sickness and the unbelievers may say, “What did God intend by this parable?” Thus God leads astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. None knows the soldiers of your Lord except He. This is nothing but a reminder for the mortals.
en.74:33: And the night as it retreats.
en.74:34: And the morning as it lights up.
en.74:35: It is one of the greatest.
en.74:37: To whomever among you wishes to advance, or regress.
en.74:38: Every soul is hostage to what it has earned.
en.74:39: Except for those on the Right.
en.74:43: They will say, “We were not of those who prayed.
en.74:44: Nor did we feed the destitute.
en.74:45: And we used to indulge with those who indulge.
en.74:46: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment.
en.74:47: Until the Inevitable came upon us.”
en.74:48: But the intercession of intercessors will not help them.
en.74:49: Why are they turning away from the Reminder?
en.74:50: As though they were panicked donkeys.
en.74:52: Yet every one of them desires to be given scrolls unrolled.
en.74:53: No indeed! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
en.74:55: So whoever wills, shall remember it.
en.74:56: But they will not remember, unless God wills. He is the Source of Righteousness, and the Source of Forgiveness.
en.75:1: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
en.75:2: And I swear by the blaming soul.
en.75:3: Does man think that We will not reassemble his bones?
en.75:4: Yes indeed; We are Able to reconstruct his fingertips.
en.75:5: But man wants to deny what is ahead of him.
en.75:6: He asks, “When is the Day of Resurrection?”
en.75:9: And the sun and the moon are joined together.
en.75:10: On that Day, man will say, “Where is the escape?”
en.75:11: No indeed! There is no refuge.
en.75:12: To your Lord on that Day is the settlement.
en.75:13: On that Day man will be informed of everything he put forward, and everything he left behind.
en.75:14: And man will be evidence against himself.
en.75:15: Even as he presents his excuses.
en.75:16: Do not wag your tongue with it, to hurry on with it.
en.75:17: Upon Us is its collection and its recitation.
en.75:18: Then, when We have recited it, follow its recitation.
en.75:19: Then upon Us is its explanation.
en.75:20: Alas, you love the fleeting life.
en.75:22: Faces on that Day will be radiant.
en.75:24: And faces on that Day will be gloomy.
en.75:25: Realizing that a back-breaker has befallen them.
en.75:26: Indeed, when it has reached the breast-bones.
en.75:27: And it is said, “Who is the healer?”
en.75:28: And He realizes that it is the parting.
en.75:29: And leg is entwined with leg.
en.75:30: To your Lord on that Day is the drive.
en.75:32: But he denied and turned away.
en.75:33: Then he went to his family, full of pride.
en.75:35: Then again: Woe to you; and woe.
en.75:36: Does man think that he will be left without purpose?
en.75:37: Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen?
en.75:38: Then he became a clot. And He created and proportioned?
en.75:39: And made of him the two sexes, the male and the female?
en.75:40: Is He not Able to revive the dead?
en.76:1: Has there come upon man a period of time when he was nothing to be mentioned?
en.76:2: We created man from a liquid mixture, to test him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
en.76:3: We guided him to the way, be he appreciative or unappreciative.
en.76:4: We have prepared for the faithless chains, and yokes, and a Searing Fire.
en.76:5: But the virtuous will drink from a cup whose mixture is aroma.
en.76:6: A spring from which the servants of God will drink, making it gush abundantly.
en.76:7: They fulfill their vows, and dread a Day whose ill is widespread.
en.76:8: And they feed, for the love of Him, the poor, and the orphan, and the captive.
en.76:9: “We only feed you for the sake of God. We want from you neither compensation, nor gratitude.
en.76:10: We dread from our Lord a frowning grim Day.”
en.76:11: So God will protect them from the ills of that Day, and will grant them radiance and joy.
en.76:12: And will reward them for their patience with a Garden and silk.
en.76:13: Reclining therein on the thrones; experiencing therein neither sun, nor frost.
en.76:14: Its shade hovering over them, and its fruit brought low within reach.
en.76:15: Passing around them are vessels of silver, and cups of crystal.
en.76:16: Crystal of silver—they measured them exactly.
en.76:17: They will be served therein with a cup whose flavor is Zanjabeel.
en.76:19: Passing among them are eternalized youths. If you see them, you would think them sprinkled pearls.
en.76:20: Wherever you look, you see bliss, and a vast kingdom.
en.76:21: Upon them are garments of green silk, and satin. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Lord will offer them a pure drink.
en.76:22: “This is a reward for you. Your efforts are well appreciated.”
en.76:23: It is We who sent down the Quran upon you—a gradual revelation.
en.76:24: So be patient for the decision of your Lord, and do not obey the sinner or the blasphemer among them.
en.76:25: And mention the Name of your Lord, morning and evening.
en.76:26: And for part of the night, prostrate yourself to Him, and glorify Him long into the night.
en.76:27: As for these: they love the fleeting life, and leave behind a Heavy Day.
en.76:28: We created them, and strengthened their frame; and whenever We will, We can replace them with others like them.
en.76:29: This is a reminder; so whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.
en.76:30: Yet you cannot will, unless God wills. God is Knowing and Wise.
en.76:31: He admits into His mercy whomever He wills. But as for the evildoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
en.77:7: Surely what you are promised will happen.
en.77:10: And the mountains are blown away.
en.77:12: Until which day is it deferred?
en.77:14: And what will teach you what the Day of Decision is?
en.77:15: Woe on that Day to the liars.
en.77:16: Did We not destroy the ancients?
en.77:17: Then succeeded them with the others?
en.77:18: This is how We deal with the guilty.
en.77:19: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
en.77:20: Did We not create you from an insignificant fluid?
en.77:21: Then lodged it in a secure place?
en.77:23: We measured precisely. We are the best to measure.
en.77:24: Woe on that Day to the falsifiers.
en.77:25: Did We not make the earth a homestead?
en.77:26: For the living and the dead?
en.77:27: And set on it lofty mountains, and given you pure water to drink?
en.77:28: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
en.77:29: “Proceed to what you used to deny.”
en.77:30: “Proceed to a shadow of three different masses.”
en.77:31: Offering no shade, and unavailing against the flames.
en.77:33: As if they were yellow camels.
en.77:34: Woe on that Day to the liars.
en.77:35: This is a Day when they will not speak.
en.77:36: And they will not be allowed to apologize.
en.77:37: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
en.77:38: This is the Day of Separation; We have gathered you, together with the ancients.
en.77:39: So if you have a strategy, use it against Me.
en.77:40: Woe on that Day to the falsifiers.
en.77:41: The righteous will be amidst shades and fountains.
en.77:43: “Eat and drink pleasantly, for what you used to do.”
en.77:44: This is how We reward the doers of good.
en.77:45: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
en.77:46: “Eat and enjoy yourselves a little; you are indeed criminals.”
en.77:47: Woe on that Day to the liars.
en.77:48: And when it is said to them, “Kneel”, they do not kneel.
en.77:49: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
en.77:50: In what message, beyond this, will they believe?
en.78:1: What are they asking one another about?
en.78:5: Most certainly, they will find out.
en.78:6: Did We not make the earth a cradle?
en.78:9: And made your sleep for rest?
en.78:10: And made the night a cover?
en.78:11: And made the day for livelihood?
en.78:12: And built above you seven strong ones?
en.78:14: And brought down from the clouds pouring water?
en.78:15: To produce with it grains and vegetation?
en.78:17: The Day of Sorting has been appointed.
en.78:18: The Day when the Trumpet is blown, and you will come in droves.
en.78:19: And the sky is opened up, and becomes gateways.
en.78:20: And the mountains are set in motion, and become a mirage.
en.78:21: the Inferno is lying in ambush.
en.78:23: Where they will remain for eons.
en.78:24: They will taste therein neither coolness, nor drink.
en.78:25: Except boiling water, and freezing hail.
en.78:27: For they were not anticipating any reckoning.
en.78:28: And they denied Our signs utterly.
en.78:29: But We have enumerated everything in writing.
en.78:30: So taste! We will increase you only in suffering.
en.78:31: But for the virtuous there is triumph.
en.78:35: They will hear therein neither gossip, nor lies.
en.78:36: A reward from your Lord, a fitting gift.
en.78:37: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them—The Most Merciful—none can argue with Him.
en.78:38: On the Day when the Spirit and the divine messengers stand in row. They will not speak, unless it be one permitted by the Most Merciful, and he will say what is right.
en.78:39: That is the Day of Reality. So whoever wills, let him take a way back to his Lord.
en.78:40: We have warned you of a near punishment—the Day when a person will observe what his hands have produced, and the faithless will say, “O, I wish I were dust.”
en.79:6: On the Day when the Quake quakes.
en.79:7: And is followed by the Successor.
en.79:8: Hearts on that Day will be pounding.
en.79:10: They say, “Are we to be restored to the original condition?
en.79:11: When we have become hollow bones?”
en.79:12: They say, “This is a losing proposition.”
en.79:13: But it will be only a single nudge.
en.79:15: Has the story of Moses reached you?
en.79:16: When His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
en.79:18: And say, “Do you care to be cleansed?
en.79:19: And I will guide you to your Lord, and you will turn reverent.”
en.79:20: He showed him the Greatest Miracle.
en.79:22: Then turned his back, and tried.
en.79:24: He said, “I am your Lord, the most high.”
en.79:25: So God seized him with an exemplary punishment, in the last and in the first.
en.79:26: In this is a lesson for whoever fears.
en.79:27: Are you more difficult to create, or the heaven? He constructed it.
en.79:28: He raised its masses, and proportioned it.
en.79:29: And He dimmed its night, and brought out its daylight.
en.79:30: And the earth after that He spread.
en.79:31: And from it, He produced its water and its pasture.
en.79:33: A source of enjoyment for you and for your animals.
en.79:34: But when the Great Cataclysm arrives.
en.79:35: A Day when man will remember what he has endeavored.
en.79:36: And the Inferno will be displayed to whoever sees.
en.79:37: As for him who was defiant.
en.79:38: And preferred the life of this world.
en.79:39: Then the Inferno is the shelter.
en.79:40: But as for him who feared the Standing of his Lord, and restrained the self from desires.
en.79:41: Then the eternal Gardens is the shelter.
en.79:42: They ask you about the Hour, “When will it take place?”
en.79:43: You have no knowledge of it.
en.79:44: To your Lord is its finality.
en.79:45: You are just a warner for whoever dreads it.
en.79:46: On the Day when they witness it—as though they only stayed an evening, or its morning.
en.8:1: They ask you about the bounties. Say, “The bounties are for God and the Envoy.” So be mindful of God, and settle your differences, and obey God and His Envoy, if you are believers.
en.8:2: The believers are those whose hearts tremble when God is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited to them, they strengthen them in faith, and upon their Lord they rely.
en.8:3: Those who perform the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh); and from Our provisions to them, they spend.
en.8:4: These are the true believers. They have high standing with their Lord, and forgiveness, and a generous provision.
en.8:5: Even as your Lord brought you out of your home with the truth, some believers were reluctant.
en.8:6: Arguing with you about the truth after it was made clear, as if they were being driven to death as they looked on.
en.8:7: God has promised you one of the two groups—that it would be yours—but you wanted the unarmed group to be yours. God intends to prove the truth with His words, and to uproot the those who deny the truth.
en.8:8: In order to confirm the truth and nullify falsehood, even though the guilty dislike it.
en.8:9: When you appealed to your Lord for help, He answered you, “I am reinforcing you with one thousand angels in succession.”
en.8:10: God only made it a message of hope, and to set your hearts at rest. Victory comes only from God. God is Mighty and Wise.
en.8:11: He made drowsiness overcome you, as a security from Him. And He sent down upon you water from the sky, to cleanse you with it, and to rid you of the Adversary’s pollution, and to fortify your hearts, and to strengthen your foothold.
en.8:12: Your Lord inspired the divine messengers: “I am with you, so support those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. So strike above the necks, and strike off every fingertip of theirs.”
en.8:13: That is because they opposed God and His Envoy. Whoever opposes God and His Envoy—God is severe in retribution.
en.8:14: “Here it is; so taste it.” For the those who deny the truth there is the suffering of the Fire.
en.8:15: O you who believe! When you meet those who disbelieve on the march, never turn your backs on them.
en.8:16: Anyone who turns his back on them on that Day, except while maneuvering for battle, or to join another group, has incurred wrath from God, and his abode is the Inferno—what a miserable destination!
en.8:17: It was not you who killed them, but it was God who killed them. And it was not you who launched when you launched, but it was God who launched. That He may bestow upon the believers an excellent reward. God is Hearing and Knowing.
en.8:18: Such is the case. God will undermine the strategy of the those who deny the truth.
en.8:19: If you desire a verdict, the verdict has come to you. And if you desist, it would be best for you. And if you return, We will return; and your troops, however numerous, will not benefit you. God is with the believers.
en.8:20: O you who believe! Obey God and His Envoy, and do not turn away from him when you hear.
en.8:21: And be not like those who say, “We hear,” when they do not hear.
en.8:22: The worst of animals to God are the deaf and dumb—those who do not reason.
en.8:23: Had God recognized any good in them, He would have made them hear; and had He made them hear, they would have turned away defiantly.
en.8:24: O you who believe! Respond to God and to the Envoy when He calls you to what will revive you. And know that God stands between a man and his heart, and that to Him you will be gathered.
en.8:25: And beware of discord which does not afflict the evildoers among you exclusively; and know that God is severe in retribution.
en.8:26: And remember when you were few, oppressed in the land, fearing that people may capture you; but He sheltered you, and supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things—so that you may be thankful.
en.8:27: O you who believe! Do not betray God and the Envoy, nor betray your trusts, while you know.
en.8:28: And know that your possessions and your children are a test, and that God possesses an immense reward.
en.8:29: O you who believe! If you remain conscious of God, He will give you a criterion, and will remit from you your sins, and will forgive you. God is possessor of infinite grace.
en.8:30: When the those who deny the truth plotted against you, to imprison you, or kill you, or expel you. They planned, and God planned, but God is the Best of planners.
en.8:31: And when Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “We have heard. Had we wanted, we could have said the like of this; these are nothing but myths of the ancients.”
en.8:32: And they said, “Our God, if this is the truth from You, then rain down on us stones from the sky, or visit us with a painful affliction.”
en.8:33: But God would not punish them while you are amongst them. And God would not punish them as long as they seek forgiveness.
en.8:34: Yet why should God not punish them, when they are turning others away from the Sacred Mosque, although they are not its custodians? Its rightful custodians are the God-conscious; but most of them do not know.
en.8:35: Their devotional prayer (Ṣalāh) at the House was nothing but whistling and clapping—so taste the punishment for your blasphemy.
en.8:36: Those who disbelieve spend their wealth to repel from God’s path. They will spend it, then it will become a source of sorrow for them, and then they will be defeated. Those who disbelieve will be herded into the Inferno.
en.8:37: That God may distinguish the bad from the good, and heap the bad on top of one another, and pile them together, and throw them in the Inferno. These are the losers.
en.8:38: Say to those who disbelieve: if they desist, their past will be forgiven. But if they persist—the practice of the ancients has passed away.
en.8:39: Fight them until there is no more persecution, and religion becomes exclusively for God. But if they desist—God is Seeing of what they do.
en.8:40: And if they turn away, know that God is your Protector. The Best Protector, and the Best Supporter.
en.8:41: And know that whatever spoils you gain, to God belongs its fifth, and to the Envoy, and the relatives, and the orphans, and the poor, and to the wayfarer, provided you believe in God and in what We revealed to Our servant on the Day of Distinction, the day when the two armies met. God is Capable of everything.
en.8:42: Recall when you were on the nearer bank, and they were on the further bank, and the caravan was below you. Had you planned for this meeting, you would have disagreed on the timing, but God was to carry out a predetermined matter, so that those who perish would perish by clear evidence, and those who survive would survive by clear evidence. God is Hearing and Knowing.
en.8:43: God made them appear in your dream as few. Had He made them appear as many, you would have lost heart, and disputed in the matter. But God saved the situation. He knows what the hearts contain.
en.8:44: When you met, He made them appear as few in your eyes, and made you appear fewer in their eyes, so that God may conclude a predetermined matter. To God all matters revert.
en.8:45: O you who believe! When you meet a force, stand firm, and remember God much, so that you may prevail.
en.8:46: And obey God and His Envoy, and do not dispute, lest you falter and lose your courage. And be steadfast. God is with the steadfast.
en.8:47: And do not be like those who left their homes boastfully, showing off before the people, and barring others from the path of God. God comprehends what they do.
en.8:48: the Adversary made their deeds appear good to them, and said, “You cannot be defeated by any people today, and I am at your side.” But when the two armies came in sight of one another, he turned on his heels, and said, “I am innocent of you; I see what you do not see; I fear God; God is severe in punishment.”
en.8:49: The the dissemblers and those in whose hearts is sickness said, “Their religion has deluded these people.” But whoever puts his trust in God—God is Mighty and Wise.
en.8:50: If only you could see, as the divine messengers take away those who disbelieve, striking their faces and their backs: “Taste the agony of the Burning.”
en.8:51: “That is because of what your hands have committed, and because God is not unjust to the servants.”
en.8:52: Like the behavior of the people of Pharaoh, and those before them. They rejected the signs of God, so God seized them for their sins. God is Powerful, Severe in punishment.
en.8:53: That is because God would never change a blessing He has bestowed on a people unless they change what is within themselves, and because God is Hearing and Knowing.

en.8:55: The worst of creatures in God's view are those who disbelieve. They have no faith.
en.8:56: Those of them with whom you made a treaty, but they violate their agreement every time. They are not righteous.
en.8:57: If you confront them in battle, make of them a fearsome example for those who follow them, that they may take heed.
en.8:58: If you fear treachery on the part of a people, break off with them in a like manner. God does not like the treacherous.
en.8:59: Let not the those who deny the truth assume that they are ahead. They will not escape.
en.8:60: And prepare against them all the power you can muster, and all the cavalry you can mobilize, to terrify thereby God’s enemies and your enemies, and others besides them whom you do not know, but God knows them. Whatever you spend in God’s way will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.
en.8:61: But if they incline towards peace, then incline towards it, and put your trust in God. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
en.8:62: If they intend to deceive you—God is sufficient for you. It is He who supported you with His aid, and with the believers.
en.8:63: And He united their hearts. Had you spent everything on earth, you would not have united their hearts, but God united them together. He is Mighty and Wise.
en.8:64: O messenger of God! Count on God, and on the believers who have followed you.
en.8:65: O messenger of God! Rouse the believers to battle. If there are twenty steadfast among you, they will defeat two hundred; and if there are a hundred of you, they will defeat a thousand of those who disbelieve; because they are a people who do not understand.
en.8:66: God has now lightened your burden, knowing that there is weakness in you. If there are a hundred steadfast among you, they will defeat two hundred; and if there are a thousand of you, they will defeat two thousand by God’s leave. God is with the steadfast.
en.8:67: It is not for a messenger of God to take prisoners before he has subdued the land. You desire the materials of this world, but God desires the Hereafter. God is Strong and Wise.
en.8:68: Were it not for a predetermined decree from God, an awful punishment would have afflicted you for what you have taken.
en.8:69: So consume what you have gained, legitimate and wholesome; and remain conscious of God. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.8:70: O messenger of God! Say to those you hold prisoners, “If God finds any good in your hearts, He will give you better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you. God is Forgiving and Merciful.”
en.8:71: But if they intend to betray you, they have already betrayed God, and He has overpowered them. God is Knowing and Wise.
en.8:72: Those who believed, and emigrated, and struggled in God’s cause with their possessions and their persons, and those who provided shelter and support—these are allies of one another. As for those who believed, but did not emigrate, you owe them no protection, until they have emigrated. But if they ask you for help in religion, you must come to their aid, except against a people with whom you have a treaty. God is Seeing of what you do.
en.8:73: As for those who disbelieve, they are allies of one another. Unless you do this, there will be turmoil in the land, and much corruption.
en.8:74: Those who believed, and emigrated, and struggled for God’s cause, and those who gave shelter and support—these are the true believers. They will have forgiveness, and a bountiful provision.
en.8:75: As for those who believed afterwards, and emigrated and struggled with you—these belong with you. But family members are nearer to one another in the Scripture of God. God is Cognizant of everything.

en.9:1: A declaration of immunity from God and His Envoy to the polytheists with whom you had made a treaty.
en.9:2: So travel the land for four months, and know that you cannot escape God, and that God will disgrace the those who deny the truth.
en.9:3: And a proclamation from God and His Envoy to the people on the day of the Greater Pilgrimage, that God has disowned the polytheists, and so did His Envoy. If you repent, it will be better for you. But if you turn away, know that you cannot escape God. And announce to those who disbelieve a painful punishment.
en.9:4: Except for those among the polytheists with whom you had made a treaty, and did not violate any of its terms, nor aided anyone against you. So fulfill the treaty with them to the end of its term. God loves the virtuous.
en.9:5: When the Sacred Months have passed, kill the polytheists wherever you find them. And capture them, and besiege them, and lie in wait for them at every ambush. But if they repent, and perform the prayers, and pay the alms, then let them go their way. God is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
en.9:6: And if anyone of the polytheists asks you for protection, give him protection so that he may hear the Word of God; then escort him to his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know.
en.9:7: How can there be a treaty with the polytheists on the part of God and His Envoy, except for those with whom you made a treaty at the Sacred Mosque? As long as they are upright with you, be upright with them. God loves the God-conscious.
en.9:8: How? Whenever they overcome you, they respect neither kinship nor treaty with you. They satisfy you with lip service, but their hearts refuse, and most of them are immoral.
en.9:9: They traded away God's revelations for a cheap price, so they barred others from His path. How evil is what they did.
en.9:10: Towards a believer they respect neither kinship nor treaty. These are the transgressors.
en.9:11: But if they repent, and perform the prayers, and give the obligatory charity, then they are your brethren in faith. We detail the revelations for a people who know.
en.9:12: But if they violate their oaths after their pledge, and attack your religion, then fight the leaders of disbelief—they have no faith—so that they may desist.
en.9:13: Will you not fight a people who violated their oaths, and planned to exile the Envoy, and initiated hostilities against you? Do you fear them? It is God you should fear, if you are believers.
en.9:14: Fight them. God will punish them at your hands, and humiliate them, and help you against them, and heal the hearts of a believing people.
en.9:15: And He will remove the anger of their hearts. God redeems whomever He wills. God is Knowledgeable and Wise.
en.9:16: Or do you think that you will be left alone, without God identifying which of you will strive, and take no supporters apart from God, His Envoy, and the believers? God is well Aware of what you do.
en.9:17: It is not for the polytheists to attend God’s places of worship while professing their disbelief. These—their works are in vain, and in the Fire they will abide.
en.9:18: The only people to attend God’s places of worship are those who believe in God and the Last Day, and pray regularly, and practice regular charity, and fear none but God. These are most likely to be guided.
en.9:19: Do you consider giving water to pilgrims and maintaining the Sacred Mosque the same as believing in God and the Last Day and striving in God’s path? They are not equal in God’s sight. God does not guide the unjust people.
en.9:20: Those who believe, and emigrate, and strive in God’s path with their possessions and their persons, are of a higher rank with God. These are the winners.
en.9:21: Their Lord announces to them good news of mercy from Him, and acceptance, and gardens wherein they will have lasting bliss.
en.9:22: Abiding therein forever. With God is a great reward.
en.9:23: O you who believe! Do not ally yourselves with your parents and your siblings if they prefer disbelief to belief. Whoever of you allies himself with them—these are the evildoers.
en.9:24: Say, “If your parents, and your children, and your siblings, and your spouses, and your relatives, and the wealth you have acquired, and a business you worry about, and homes you love, are more dear to you than God, and His Envoy, and the struggle in His cause, then wait until God executes His judgment.” God does not guide the sinful people.
en.9:25: God has given you victory in numerous regions; but on the day of Hunayn, your great number impressed you, but it availed you nothing; and the land, as spacious as it was, narrowed for you; and you turned your backs in retreat.
en.9:26: Then God sent down His serenity upon His Envoy, and upon the believers; and He sent down troops you did not see; and He punished those who disbelieved. Such is the recompense of the those who deny the truth.
en.9:27: Then, after that, God will relent towards whomever He wills. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.9:28: O you who believe! The polytheists are polluted, so let them not approach the Sacred Mosque after this year of theirs. And if you fear poverty, God will enrich you from His grace, if He wills. God is Aware and Wise.
en.9:29: Fight those who do not believe in God, nor in the Last Day, nor forbid what God and His Envoy have forbidden, nor abide by the religion of truth—from among those who received the Scripture—until they pay the due tax, willingly or unwillingly.
en.9:30: The Jews said, “Ezra is the son of God,” and the Christians said, “The Messiah is the son of God.” These are their statements, out of their mouths. They emulate the statements of those who blasphemed before. May God assail them! How deceived they are!
en.9:31: They have taken their rabbis and their priests as lords instead of God, as well as the Messiah son of Mary. Although they were commanded to worship none but The One God. There is no god except He. Glory be to Him; High above what they associate with Him.
en.9:32: They want to extinguish God’s light with their mouths, but God refuses except to complete His light, even though the those who deny the truth dislike it.
en.9:33: It is He who sent His Envoy with the guidance and the religion of truth, in order to make it prevail over all religions, even though the idolaters dislike it.
en.9:34: O you who believe! Many of the rabbis and priests consume people's wealth illicitly, and hinder from God’s path. Those who hoard gold and silver, and do not spend them in God’s cause, inform them of a painful punishment.
en.9:35: On the Day when they will be heated in the Fire of the Inferno, then their foreheads, and their sides, and their backs will be branded with them: “This is what you hoarded for yourselves; so taste what you used to hoard.”
en.9:36: The number of months, according to God, is twelve months—in the decree of God—since the Day He created the heavens and the earth, of which four are sacred. This is the correct religion. So do not wrong yourselves during them. And fight the polytheists collectively, as they fight you collectively, and know that God is with the virtuous.
en.9:37: Postponement is an increase in disbelief—by which those who disbelieve are led astray. They allow it one year, and forbid it another year, in order to conform to the number made sacred by God, thus permitting what God has forbidden. The evil of their deeds seems good to them. God does not guide the disbelieving people.
en.9:38: O you who believe! What is the matter with you, when it is said to you, “Mobilize in the cause of God,” you cling heavily to the earth? Do you prefer the present life to the Hereafter? The enjoyment of the present life, compared to the Hereafter, is only a little.
en.9:39: Unless you mobilize, He will punish you most painfully, and will replace you with another people, and you will not harm Him at all. God has power over all things.
en.9:40: If you do not help him, God has already helped him, when those who disbelieved expelled him, and he was the second of two in the cave. He said to his friend, “Do not worry, God is with us.” And God made His tranquility descend upon him, and supported him with forces you did not see, and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, while the Word of God is the Highest. God is Mighty and Wise.
en.9:41: Mobilize, light or heavy, and strive with your possessions and your lives in the cause of God. That is better for you, if you only knew.
en.9:42: Had the gain been immediate, and the journey shorter, they would have followed you; but the distance seemed too long for them. Still they swear by God: “Had we been able, we would have marched out with you.” They damn their own souls, and God knows that they are lying.
en.9:43: May God pardon you! Why did you give them permission before it became clear to you who are the truthful ones, and who are the liars?
en.9:44: Those who believe in God and the Last Day do not ask you for exemption from striving with their possessions and their lives. God is fully aware of the virtuous.
en.9:45: Only those who do not believe in God and the Last Day ask you for exemption. Their hearts are full of doubts, so they waver in their doubts.
en.9:46: Had they wanted to mobilize, they would have made preparations for it; but God disliked their participation, so he held them back, and it was said, “Stay behind with those who stay behind.”
en.9:47: Had they mobilized with you, they would have added only to your difficulties, and they would have spread rumors in your midst, trying to sow discord among you. Some of you are avid listeners to them. God is Aware of the evildoers.
en.9:48: They tried to cause conflict before, and they hatched plots against you, until the truth prevailed, and the command of God became evident—in spite of their dislike.
en.9:49: Among them is he who says, “Excuse me, and do not trouble me.” In fact, they sunk into trouble. In fact, the Inferno will engulf the those who deny the truth.
en.9:50: If something good happens to you, it upsets them; and if a calamity befalls you, they say, “We took our precautions in advance,” and they depart, happy.
en.9:51: Say, “Nothing will happen to us except what God has ordained for us; He is our Protector.” In God let the faithful put their trust.
en.9:52: Say, “Are you expecting for us anything other than one of the two excellences? As for us: we are expecting that God will afflict you with a punishment from Himself, or at our hands. So wait, we are waiting with you.”
en.9:53: Say, “Whether you spend willingly or unwillingly, it will not be accepted from you. You are evil people.”
en.9:54: What prevents the acceptance of their contributions is nothing but the fact that they disbelieved in God and His Envoy, and that they do not approach the devotional prayer (Ṣalāh) except lazily, and that they do not spend except grudgingly.
en.9:55: Let neither their possessions nor their children impress you. God intends to torment them through them in this worldly life, and that their souls depart while they are those who deny the truth.
en.9:56: They swear by God that they are of you. But they are not of you. They are divisive people.
en.9:57: Were they to find a shelter, or a cave, or a hideout, they would go to it, rushing.
en.9:58: And among them are those who criticize you in regard to charities. If they are given some of it, they become pleased; but if they are not given any, they grow resentful.
en.9:59: If only they were content with what God and His Envoy have given them, and said, “God is sufficient for us; God will give us of His bounty, and so will His Envoy; to God we eagerly turn.”
en.9:60: Charities are for the poor, and the destitute, and those who administer them, and for reconciling hearts, and for freeing slaves, and for those in debt, and in the path of God, and for the traveler in need—an obligation from God. God is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
en.9:61: And among them are those who insult the messenger of God, and say, “He is all ears.” Say, “He listens for your own good. He believes in God, and trusts the believers, and is mercy for those of you who believe.” Those who insult the Envoy of God will have a painful penalty.
en.9:62: They swear to you by God to please you. But it is more proper for them to please God and His Envoy, if they are believers.
en.9:63: Do they not know that whoever opposes God and His Envoy, will have the Fire of the Inferno, abiding in it forever? That is the supreme disgrace.
en.9:64: The the dissemblers worry lest a chapter may be revealed about them, informing them of what is in their hearts. Say, “Go on mocking; God will bring out what you fear.”
en.9:65: If you ask them, they will say, “We were just joking and playing.” Say, “Were you making jokes about God, His revelations, and His Envoy?”
en.9:66: Do not apologize. You have disbelieved after your belief. If We pardon some of you, We will punish others, because they are guilty.
en.9:67: The hypocrite men and hypocrite women are of one another. They advocate evil, and prohibit righteousness, and withhold their hands. They forgot God, so He forgot them. The the dissemblers are the sinners.
en.9:68: God has promised the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the those who deny the truth, the Fire of the Inferno, abiding therein forever. It is their due. And God has cursed them. They will have a lasting punishment.
en.9:69: Like those before you. They were more powerful than you, and had more wealth and children. They enjoyed their share, and you enjoyed your share, as those before you enjoyed their share. And you indulged, as they indulged. It is they whose works will fail in this world and in the Hereafter. It is they who are the losers.
en.9:70: Have they not heard the stories of those before them? The people of Noah, and Aad, and Thamood; and the people of Abraham, and the inhabitants of Median, and the Overturned Cities? Their messengers came to them with the clear proofs. God never wronged them, but they used to wrong their own selves.
en.9:71: The believing men and believing women are friends of one another. They advocate virtue, forbid evil, perform the prayers, practice charity, and obey God and His Envoy. These—God will have mercy on them. God is Noble and Wise.
en.9:72: God promises the believers, men and women, gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, and fine homes in the Gardens of Eden. But approval from God is even greater. That is the supreme achievement.
en.9:73: O messenger of God! Strive against the those who deny the truth and the the dissemblers, and be stern with them. Their abode is the Inferno—what a miserable destination!
en.9:74: They swear by God that they said nothing; but they did utter the word of blasphemy, and they renounced faith after their submission. And they plotted what they could not attain. They were resentful only because God and His Envoy have enriched them out of His grace. If they repent, it would be best for them; but if they turn away, God will afflict them with a painful punishment—in this life and in the Hereafter—and they will have on earth no protector and no savior.
en.9:75: Among them are those who promised God: “If He gives us of His bounty, we will donate and be among the upright.”
en.9:76: But when He has given them of His bounty, they became stingy with it, and turned away in aversion.
en.9:77: So He penalized them with hypocrisy in their hearts, until the Day they face Him—because they broke their promise to God, and because they used to lie.
en.9:78: Do they not know that God knows their secrets and their conspiracies? And that God is the Knower of the unseen?
en.9:79: Those who criticize the believers who give charity voluntarily, and ridicule those who find nothing to give except their own efforts—God ridicules them. They will have a painful punishment.
en.9:80: Whether you ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them—even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times, God will not forgive them. That is because they disbelieved in God and His Envoy. God does not guide the immoral people.
en.9:81: Those who stayed behind rejoiced at their staying behind the Envoy of God. And they hated to strive with their wealth and their lives in God’s way. And they said, “Do not venture out in the heat.” Say, “The Fire of the Inferno is much hotter, if they only understood.”
